prs.title: docs(runtime): simplify CSI delivery around resident Workspaces
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Converges #14758 on the resident Workspace Read/Write/Edit runtime already merged in #14340. A history-preserving merge incorporates main at `e715a1af9ecd2aad4543b63d8bb2dd335e31ca04` and withdraws this PR's Go node components, node-evidence protocols, source persistence, migration, fixtures and dedicated CI. The final diff against that main baseline contains only four Markdown documents; main's existing production implementation and fixes are retained.

The first release trusts the administrator, Kubernetes control plane, host and qualified ACK Disk CSI. Sequential Sessions reuse the original Pod, PVC and files. Close settles and revokes the logical context and releases its Runtime Session while the binding stays `READY` and storage stays `RESERVED`. Missing or changed original runtime identities and uncertain execution or release outcomes block handoff and preserve the reservation. Existing configuration, public Session APIs, Runtime Broker, worker protocols and database schema remain the implementation contract.

## Why it's needed

The resident runtime already supplies the first-release behavior. Delivering it does not require the stronger host-confinement proof or a custom containerd/shim installation pursued by the former node-evidence candidate. This revision makes the trusted-platform boundary, ACK Disk CSI limitations, failure behavior and outstanding acceptance work explicit.

#14761 and #14765 remain on their original code and remain Draft. The simplified #14758 no longer supplies their node-evidence prerequisite; those proposals need an independent dependency redesign before landing and are not dependencies of this first release. The former candidate at `1656cf02fd8419ce7baf608adcfb21a2d28a3dfc` remains in commit history, with no force push.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Confirm the complete diff against the incorporated main baseline contains only documentation and that both the former PR head and main are ancestors of the new head. There should be no PR-only Go package, production-code change, migration or workflow change in the final diff.
2. Compare the English and Chinese design and deployment guidance. Confirm support is limited to `diskplugin.csi.alibabacloud.com`, `ReadWriteOncePod`, `Filesystem` and `ext4`, with matching registered disk serial and the existing identity, mount, authorization, idempotency and generation checks preserved.
3. Review the acceptance requirements for A→close→B file handoff on the original runtime, concurrent admission and retries, refusal of old contexts, idle application/Broker restart, uncertain execution/release, and missing or replaced Pod/container/storage identities. The required outcome is retained ownership and blocked admission whenever completion is uncertain; automatic replacement, ownership transfer and uncertain-effect replay are not authorized.

Locally completed: Prettier checks for all four documents, whitespace checks, validation of 12 local Markdown references, bilingual structure/technical-identifier checks and two clean full-diff self-audit passes. Existing focused resident admission, logical-close and provisioner coverage was inspected without adding duplicate tests. No Node/Maven runtime tests, real MySQL acceptance, independent-process acceptance or ACK cluster qualification were run for this documentation revision; those runtime results remain pending and historical candidate results are not carried forward.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — documentation-only final diff; no UI or TUI change. The checks above establish documentation consistency and the tree boundary, not deployment acceptance.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ Documentation checks only; runtime not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ Not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS 26.7.1, Node.js 22.22.3 and Python 3.9.6 for local static documentation checks. No database, runtime processes or cloud resources were exercised by this revision.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the first release trusts the qualified platform rather than independently proving continuous host confinement. A lost or ambiguous original runtime keeps the Workspace unavailable and storage reserved; resident Pod/node/storage costs continue after Session close.
- Not validated / out of scope: real MySQL concurrency/recovery, independent-process restart/recovery and target ACK qualification remain pending, with component/H2 evidence recorded separately. Shell, MCP, Hooks, physical retirement, volume reuse, automatic replacement and uncertain-effect replay are deferred. This revision does not deploy or qualify the runtime.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no change to main's public APIs, worker protocols, configuration or schema, and no new migration. The removed node-evidence increment was a Draft candidate; #14761 and #14765 cannot rely on the simplified PR as their implementation prerequisite.

The complete design and deployment guidance are synchronized in both languages: [English design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c6820459026adf3619c9080b5b73cacc52922998/docs/design/2026-10-14-k2-resident-workspace.md), [Chinese design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c6820459026adf3619c9080b5b73cacc52922998/docs/design/2026-10-14-k2-resident-workspace.zh-CN.md), [English deployment guide](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c6820459026adf3619c9080b5b73cacc52922998/deploy/k2-resident/README.md) and [Chinese deployment guide](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c6820459026adf3619c9080b5b73cacc52922998/deploy/k2-resident/README.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Related: #13395, #13526, #14340, #14761 and #14765. No issue is closed by this documentation revision.

prs.title: test(managed-agent): crash the approval result-commit barrier
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a fifth packaged fault arm to the G3 Step 3 approval gates: the runner holds the post-tool model round as soon as the approved tool result commits, then crashes the replacement Harness. The next generation must reissue the exact saved request (deep-equal), retract the published prefix, and finish with one settled execution, one file effect and one terminal.

It also wires the arm into the `hosted-failover-e2e` job (20 arms, 215-minute ceiling) and updates the bilingual Step 3 design and the server README.

## Why it's needed

A5 lists five barriers. The arms merged in #14687 cover the decision, the partial prepare and the two lost replies, but not result commit. Without this arm, a recovery that reissued a rewritten request or left the held prefix visible would still pass CI.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `npm run test:e2e:managed-harness-restart-approval-after-result` in the `Hosted failover E2E / Java 21` job and confirm it stays green. Then remove the deep-equal reissue assertion or the transcript assertion and confirm the arm fails instead of passing on a weaker check. Locally, run the runner and CI-contract suites.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test and CI only. Local evidence: the four script suites (`managed-agent-server-e2e`, `hosted-process-ci`, `managed-agent-gate-workflow`, `sdk-java-workflow`) pass 254 tests; `npm run typecheck` and ESLint are clean after `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

The packaged arm needs the Linux CLI bundle, the server jar and a runner-private `mysqld`; it was not run on this macOS host. Its first `hosted-failover-e2e` run is the end-to-end witness.

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests and typecheck locally. The packaged arm is delegated to the `hosted-failover-e2e` CI job.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the transcript assertion assumes result-commit recovery retracts the held prefix, and the deep-equal assertion assumes the reissue reuses the saved request byte-for-byte. Either assumption failing is the finding this arm exists to surface.
- Not validated / out of scope: the packaged arm has not run locally. A lost load reply, a failed cleanup followed by another crash, a committed terminal that was not delivered, and a payable checkpoint without its terminal write still have no packaged arm (#14481).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; test, CI and documentation only.

## Linked Issues

Part of #14481.

prs.title: test(managed-agent): gate the FG11f lost-ack publication fault (FG11f)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the first FG11f fault gate: an automation wake turn whose public Shell capture is published, with the object store's acknowledgement dropped after the bytes landed. The gate asserts what the store actually guarantees rather than what a retry might do — the committed capture is kept, the largest stored object is this run's bytes, the `OBJECT_PUT` operation settles from what the store recorded, the Shell runs once, and the run settles once.

The fixture change is what unblocks it. The storage guard was registered only on Linux, so on macOS a public Shell wake turn was refused with `workspace_unavailable` before its fault arm could ever fire. Registration now follows the same condition as the guard itself. The case also runs with `durable-local-process` and verified workspace recovery on, and the auth filter widened to `/api/agent/web-shell/*` for this class's cases.

## Why it's needed

Nothing in CI answers what happens to the Shell output a wake turn publishes when the object store misbehaves. The shared OSS stub accepts every object and has no fault arms, and the only real-bucket gate is opt-in and outside CI. A lost acknowledgement is the case that matters: the bytes are durable, the caller cannot tell a committed write from a lost one, and a store that rewrote the object or re-ran the Shell would look correct to a readability-only check.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff.** The diff raises the shared failsafe fork budget that every other hosted gate runs inside (8925 → 9133 s at this head, with the `hosted-harness-mysql` job ceiling moving with it), because one more cell now runs in that fork. It also flips `durable-local-process` and `verified-workspace-recovery-enabled` on for this case, and widens the fixture's auth filter to `/api/agent/web-shell/*` for every FG11 case in the class. Those are test-fixture changes only; no production code is touched.
- **Not validated / out of scope.** `fail-before-write` and `timeout` ship fault injection but cannot be selected until the follow-up wires them — the design documents continue to call them scoped. The publisher-death slice is untouched. The new case is also skipped by this PR's own CI: the tier resolves to `fast`, and the hosted fault-gates job is gated on `tier != 'fast'`, so the green reported below is a local run against real MySQL rather than a CI reproduction.
- **Breaking changes / migration.** None. No production source, schema or API moves.

## Linked Issues

References #14446 (the FG11 tracker) without a closing keyword: this lands one arm of one slice, not the tracker.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The gate needs real MySQL, a built bundle and Node 22. Run the single method through the hosted automation profile with those system properties; expect one test to pass in roughly 40–100 seconds. The case boots Spring with the packaged Harness, creates a definition whose tools name the hosted workspace Shell, answers the wake turn's permission action, fires an automation, and injects the lost acknowledgement on the physical put.

A reviewer can confirm the properties independently by reading the retention store's reconcile branch: it opens the object, compares length and digest, writes a `proof: "original_object"` receipt and settles `RETURNED` without issuing a second physical put. The gate's assertions are written against that behaviour, so a store that rewrote the object would fail the byte assertions while a store that re-ran the Shell would fail the execution count.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the same case terminated in `workspace_unavailable` within 47 ms, before any fault arm ran, because the guard's registration was missing on macOS — a call-stack marker put the refusal at the guard's own verification step. After: the case reaches the fault arm and asserts the settlement properties above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A  |

Measured locally: `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Time elapsed: 41.14 s` against MySQL 8.0.46 and Node 22, plus `scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` 64/64 after the merges and the budget recomposition.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增第一条 FG11f 故障门禁：automation wake turn 发布公开 Shell 抓取结果时，对象存储的 ack 在字节落盘之后丢失。断言钉住 store 真正保证的性质，而不是它从不驱动的重试——已提交的抓取保留、最大留存对象就是本次运行的字节、`OBJECT_PUT` 操作按 store 记录结算、Shell 只执行一次、run 恰好结算一次。

夹具改动是解锁条件。存储闸原先只在 Linux 注册，因此在 macOS 上公开 Shell 的 wake turn 在故障臂触发前就以 `workspace_unavailable` 被拒。现在注册条件与 guard 自身的启用条件一致。该用例还开启了 `durable-local-process` 与 verified workspace recovery，并把鉴权 filter 扩到 `/api/agent/web-shell/*`（仅影响本类用例）。

## 为什么需要

CI 里没有任何东西回答「wake turn 发布的 Shell 输出撞上对象存储故障会怎样」。共享 OSS 桩接受任何写入且没有故障臂，唯一的真实 bucket 门是可选项且在 CI 之外。丢失 ack 是最关键的一种：字节已经持久化，调用方分不清已提交与已丢失，而重写对象或重跑 Shell 的 store 在「只查可读性」的断言下会显得完全正确。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或取舍。** 本 diff 抬高了所有 hosted gate 共用的 failsafe fork 预算（当前 head 8925 → 9133 s，`hosted-harness-mysql` job 上限同步上调），因为该 fork 里多跑一个 cell。同时为该用例打开 `durable-local-process` 与 `verified-workspace-recovery-enabled`，并把夹具鉴权 filter 扩到 `/api/agent/web-shell/*`（影响本类所有 FG11 用例）。这些都是测试夹具改动，不触碰生产代码。
- **未验证 / 超出范围。** `fail-before-write` 与 `timeout` 已带故障注入，但在后续 PR 接线之前无法被选中——设计文档仍把它们记为已定界未实现。publisher-death 未触碰。本用例在本 PR 的 CI 中也会被跳过：tier 解析为 `fast`，而 hosted fault gates job 的条件是 `tier != 'fast'`，所以下面报告的绿色是本机对真实 MySQL 的实跑，不是 CI 复现。
- **破坏性变更 / 迁移。** 无。生产源码、schema、API 均未移动。

## 关联 Issue

引用 #14446（FG11 tracker），不使用关闭关键字：本 PR 只交付其中一个切片的其中一条臂。

## 评审方式

需要真实 MySQL、构建好的 bundle 与 Node 22，用 hosted automation profile 跑单个方法，预期 40–100 秒内通过。用例会启动 Spring 与打包 Harness，建立以 hosted workspace Shell 为工具的 definition，应答 wake turn 的权限请求，触发 automation，并在物理 put 上注入丢失的 ack。

可独立核验的路径：读 retention store 的对账分支——它打开对象、比对长度与摘要、写入 `proof: "original_object"` 回执并在不发起第二次物理 put 的情况下结算 `RETURNED`。断言即按此行为编写：重写对象的 store 会挂字节断言，重跑 Shell 的 store 会挂执行次数断言。

## 证据（Before & After）

修复前：同一用例在 47 ms 内以 `workspace_unavailable` 终止，故障臂一次都没跑到——调用栈标记把拒绝点定在 guard 自身的注册校验上（macOS 缺少注册）。修复后：用例进入故障臂并断言上述结算性质。

## 平台

本机 macOS 实跑：`Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Time elapsed: 41.14 s`（MySQL 8.0.46 + Node 22）；合并与预算重算后 `scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` 64/64。

</details>

prs.title: fix(review): accept the Step 6 findings artifact as --new-findings
prs.body:
## What this PR does

`qwen review presubmit` now accepts the canonical findings artifact the review's own Step 6 writes, instead of only the minimal hand-written anchor list. The artifact is a report object whose entries carry `file` and, for a pattern aggregate, a `locations[]` array; both are normalized into the `(path, line)` anchors the gate works with, and an aggregate expands into one anchor per site. The hand-written list keeps working, and it stays the way to attach a source range or to state by hand which findings are carried into this round.

Two follow-on repairs come with it. The report presubmit writes when it cannot read the file now names both accepted shapes, so a run that gets it wrong can fix it mechanically instead of guessing. And the review skill's Step 7 text now says the artifact is accepted as-is — deleting the transcription step the issue asks for, because that step is what produced the failure in the first place: the skill told the model to write the anchor list over the artifact.

## Why it's needed

A high-effort `/review` run passed the findings artifact to the presubmit step, since that is the file the skill's own example wrote the anchor list into. Presubmit refused the WHOLE file, the report came back with `findingsFileInvalid` and `downgradeApprove` and a reason that only said "regenerate it", and a second run with a hand-built list was needed before the downgrade was safe to hand on. Had the first report gone unread, a spurious downgrade would have capped an otherwise clean verdict.

The artifact already names every location the overlap check and the drift check need — it even names the files of the body-only Criticals the hand-built list had to have added by hand. Rejecting its shape was the parser working as designed, pointed at the wrong shape.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Unit level (fastest): the parser and the report are pinned by cases that feed the artifact's real shape — a report object, a standalone `file`/`line` entry, a pattern aggregate, a deferral — and by cases that still refuse a file that cannot be read as a location. Run `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/commands/review/presubmit.test.ts src/commands/review/presubmit.aone.test.ts`, then `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/skills/bundled/review/SKILL.test.ts`.

End to end, the behavior the issue reports: write a findings artifact shaped like the one Step 6 produces, then run the gate against a live commit and read the two fields that fired.

```bash
npm run build && npm run bundle
cat > /tmp/findings.json <<'JSON'
{"findings":[
 {"id":"R2-1","severity":"Critical","confidence":"high","source":"review","summary":"a defect","failureScenario":"it fires once","file":"packages/cli/src/commands/review/presubmit.ts","line":100},
 {"id":"R2-2","severity":"Suggestion","confidence":"high","source":"review","summary":"the same pattern twice","failureScenario":"it fires at both sites","locations":[{"file":"packages/cli/src/commands/review/submit.ts","line":20},{"file":"packages/cli/src/commands/review/findings.ts","line":30}]}
],"counts":{"total":2},"outcomesRecorded":false}
JSON
node dist/cli.js review presubmit <pr-number> <head-sha> <owner>/<repo> /tmp/presubmit.json --new-findings /tmp/findings.json
jq '{findingsFileInvalid, downgradeApprove, downgradeReasons}' /tmp/presubmit.json
```

Expected (after): `findingsFileInvalid: false` and no malformed-file entry in `downgradeReasons`, on a PR whose CI is green. Before this patch the same command reports `findingsFileInvalid: true` and `downgradeApprove: true` with the "the --new-findings file was malformed — …" reason, which is the defect.

A second thing worth confirming in the same report: when the PR head has advanced, the files named by the artifact's entries — including a body-only Critical that carries a `file` and no `line` — are the set `headDrift.anchorsAtRisk` is decided against.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before the patch, against the new test file, seven cases fail for the reported reason:

```
 ❯ src/commands/review/presubmit.test.ts (132 tests | 7 failed)
 FAIL presubmitCommand > takes the canonical findings artifact as --new-findings without downgrading (#9218)
      AssertionError: expected true to be false // Object.is equality   (findingsFileInvalid)
 FAIL parseFindingsFile > the canonical findings artifact (#9218) > normalizes [{"id":"R3-2",…,"file":"src/a.ts","line":42,…}]
      AssertionError: expected null to deeply equal [ Array(1) ]        (whole file refused)
 FAIL parseFindingsFile > the canonical findings artifact (#9218) > accepts the report object `qwen review findings --out` writes
 FAIL presubmitCommand > surfaces a malformed findings file (flag + downgrade) even with no drift
      AssertionError: expected 'the --new-findings file was malformed…' to contain '{path, line}'
```

After the patch:

```
 ✓ src/commands/review/presubmit.aone.test.ts (33 tests) 505ms
 ✓ src/commands/review/presubmit.test.ts (132 tests) 1759ms
      Tests  165 passed (165)
 ✓ src/skills/bundled/review/SKILL.test.ts (74 tests) 217ms
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local Windows checkout, Node 24.19.0, unit tests only (`vitest`). No sandbox or container run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the artifact names every finding, including the ones that never post inline, so the file set the drift gate intersects against is now wider than a hand-built list would be. A drift touching such a file rules the anchors at risk where a minimal list might have read disjoint — the conservative direction the gate already takes for every posted finding, but it can cost a restart on a PR that keeps moving. Ids ride through unchanged, so the id-matched re-post exemption still joins.
- Not validated / out of scope: no live `/review` run against a real PR in this branch. The coverage is the parser, the report, and the skill text, pinned by unit tests; the end-to-end recipe above is for the reviewer.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The change is additive — a file that parsed before parses to the same anchor list, and the minimal shape keeps its exact behavior, its id check included.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #9218. Sibling of #9215, which fixed the compose-side defect from the same dogfood run and does not touch this path.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

`qwen review presubmit` 现在接受 review 自身 Step 6 写出的规范化 findings 产物，而不再只认手写的最小锚点列表。该产物是一个报告对象，条目以 `file` 记录位置，聚合类条目则带 `locations[]` 数组；两者都会被归一化成该门禁使用的 `(path, line)` 锚点，聚合条目按每个位置展开成一条。手写列表继续可用，并且仍是附加 `start_line`、或手工标明哪些 finding 是本轮继承的唯一方式。

另外附带两处修补。presubmit 在无法读取该文件时写出的报告，现在会同时给出两种可接受的形状，跑错的一方能机械地修正而无需猜测。review skill 的 Step 7 文本现在说明产物可直接传入——这正是本 issue 要求删除的手工转写步骤，因为该步骤本身就是失败的来源：skill 让模型把锚点列表写到了产物路径上。

## 为什么需要

一次 high effort 的 `/review` 运行把 findings 产物传给了 presubmit 步骤，因为 skill 自己的示例正是把锚点列表写进这个文件。presubmit 拒绝了整个文件，报告返回 `findingsFileInvalid` 与 `downgradeApprove`，理由只写了 "regenerate it"，随后需要用手工构造的列表再跑一次，降级标志才能安全地继续往下交。若第一次报告没有被仔细阅读，一个本不该出现的降级会封顶一个本来干净的裁决。

该产物本来就带有 overlap 检查与 drift 检查所需的全部位置——连只能进正文的 Critical 的文件也在其中，而手写列表必须人工补上这些文件。拒绝它的形状属于解析器按设计工作，只是对准了错误的形状。

## 审阅测试计划

### 如何验证

单元层（最快）：解析器与报告由以下用例固定——覆盖产物的真实形状（报告对象、独立的 `file`/`line` 条目、聚合条目、延迟条目），以及仍然拒绝"无法读作位置"的文件的用例。先执行 `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/commands/review/presubmit.test.ts src/commands/review/presubmit.aone.test.ts`，再执行 `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/skills/bundled/review/SKILL.test.ts`。

端到端，即本 issue 报告的行为：写一个与 Step 6 产物同形状的文件，然后对着真实 commit 运行该门禁，读取那两个被触发的字段（命令见英文部分的代码块）。

预期（打上本补丁后）：在 CI 为绿的 PR 上，`findingsFileInvalid` 为 `false`，`downgradeReasons` 中不再出现 malformed-file 条目。打补丁前，同一条命令会报告 `findingsFileInvalid: true` 且 `downgradeApprove: true`，理由为 "the --new-findings file was malformed — …"，这就是缺陷本身。

同一份报告里还有一点值得确认：当 PR head 已前进时，`headDrift.anchorsAtRisk` 判定所用的文件集合，正是产物各条目（包括只有 `file`、没有 `line` 的正文 Critical）所命名的那些文件。

### 证据（修改前与修改后）

打补丁前，针对新增测试文件，七条用例按报告的原因失败（输出见英文部分）；打补丁后，`presubmit.test.ts` 132 条、`presubmit.aone.test.ts` 33 条、`SKILL.test.ts` 74 条全部通过。

### 测试环境

|     操作系统     | 状态 |
| :--------------: | :--: |
|      🍏 macOS      |  ⚠️  |
|     🪟 Windows     |  ✅  |
|      🐧 Linux      |  ⚠️  |

环境：Windows 本地检出，Node 24.19.0，仅单元测试（`vitest`），未运行沙箱或容器。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：产物会命名每一个 finding，包括从不内联发布的那些，因此 drift 门禁所交集的文件集合比手写列表更宽。当 drift 触及这类文件时会判定锚点存在风险，而最小列表可能读出不相交——这是该门禁对所有已发布 finding 一贯采用的保守方向，但会让持续变动的 PR 多付一次重启的代价。id 原样透传，重发的 id 豁免仍然成立。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：本分支没有对真实 PR 跑过完整的 `/review`。覆盖范围是解析器、报告与 skill 文本，均由单元测试固定；端到端步骤留给审阅者执行。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。改动是纯增量——此前能解析的文件解析结果完全相同，最小形状保留其原有行为，包括其 id 校验。

## 关联 issue

Fixes #9218。与 #9215 属于同一批 dogfood 运行暴露的兄弟范围；后者修复 compose 侧缺陷，不改动本路径。

</details>

prs.title: test(managed-agent): reject Hook store commits (FG13b)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Stack layer 1/3. Adds the FG13b store-failure seam and its first two cells.

- `StoreFaultGate` (test-only) gains four Hook phases: `HOOK_INTENT`, `HOOK_DISPATCH_STARTED`, `HOOK_SETTLED`, `HOOK_PLAN_SETTLED`. It matches a `hook_execution` record by `hookExecutionId` and separates the plan marker by `hookId == "__plan__"`.
- The Hook IT registers `FaultingExtensionRecordStore` through a test `@Configuration`, so every commit still runs in the real transaction.
- `fg13bHookIntentStoreRejectionDispatchesNothingOnMySql` rejects the intent commit; `fg13bHookDispatchStoreRejectionDispatchesNothingOnMySql` rejects the `dispatch_started` commit. Both assert the injection fired and no command ran. The IT's teardown clears the static gate.
- The model stub learns `FG13_STORE_INTENT` and `FG13_STORE_DISPATCH`.
- Shared fork budget: two cells at +150 s each → healthy 8751, fork 9351, Verify 166 min, job 269 min.
- `.github/workflows/.size-baseline` raises `sdk-java.yml` from 99942 to 104138. The file is the budget ledger; `main` already sat 3843 bytes over the old baseline, and the two FG13b entries add 353. The gate allows a justified baseline update, and the growth is real.

The remaining three cells (result commit, plan result commit, registration settle) are planned in the design document and follow in this PR.

## Why it's needed

FG13b requires rejecting each Hook durable commit inside the real Session store transaction. A rejection before `dispatch_started` must leave zero physical calls; a later rejection must settle from the worker's receipt without a second execution.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the `hosted-harness-mysql` profile on a Linux host with MySQL 8.4 and a delegated cgroup v2 root. The two new cases are `fg13bHookIntentStoreRejectionDispatchesNothingOnMySql` and `fg13bHookDispatchStoreRejectionDispatchesNothingOnMySql`.

Mutation witnesses:

- Arm the wrong phase: `attempts` stays zero and the wait times out.
- Match only the MCP domains: the Hook commit is never rejected, so the command runs and `hook.call` is non-empty.
- Let the commit through after arming: the same `hook.call` assertion fails.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only. The Hosted lane has not run on this head.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status                                                                                            |
| :--------: | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ `test-compile`, the CI checkstyle execution, the hosted-process meta test (64 passed), Prettier |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A — Linux-only gate                                                                             |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ The Hosted lane has not run on this head                                                        |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the two cells add 300 s to the shared fork (8751 / 9351, Verify 166, job 269). The baseline bump is ledger growth, not a new gate.
- Not validated / out of scope: the other three FG13b cells, and the Hosted lane on this head.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.
- Design documents: [English](docs/design/2026-10-20-hosted-hook-store-fault-gates-b.md) and [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-hosted-hook-store-fault-gates-b.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Part of #14449 (FG13b).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

堆叠层 1/3：FG13b 的存储故障注入缝与前两格。

- `StoreFaultGate`（仅测试用）新增四个 Hook phase：`HOOK_INTENT`、`HOOK_DISPATCH_STARTED`、`HOOK_SETTLED`、`HOOK_PLAN_SETTLED`；按 `hookExecutionId` 匹配，用 `hookId == "__plan__"` 区分 plan marker。
- Hook IT 通过测试用 `@Configuration` 注册 `FaultingExtensionRecordStore`，每次提交仍在真实事务中执行。
- `fg13bHookIntentStoreRejectionDispatchesNothingOnMySql` 拒绝 intent 提交；`fg13bHookDispatchStoreRejectionDispatchesNothingOnMySql` 拒绝 `dispatch_started` 提交。两者都断言注入确实触发、命令未运行；teardown 清理静态故障门。
- 模型桩补上 `FG13_STORE_INTENT` 与 `FG13_STORE_DISPATCH`。
- 共享 fork 预算：两格各 +150 秒 → healthy 8751、fork 9351、Verify 166 分钟、job 269 分钟。
- `.github/workflows/.size-baseline` 把 `sdk-java.yml` 从 99942 抬到 104138：该文件是预算台账，main 本身已超旧基线 3843 字节，本分支两格再添 353；门禁允许在有理由时更新基线，增长是真实的。

其余三格（结果提交、plan 结果提交、注册结算）在设计文档中列为计划，随后加入本 PR。

## 为什么需要

FG13b 要求在真实 Session store 事务内拒绝 Hook 的每一次持久化提交。`dispatch_started` 之前的拒绝必须零物理调用；更晚的拒绝必须按 worker 回执结算，绝不二次执行。

## 评审测试计划

在 Linux、MySQL 8.4 与委派 cgroup v2 根上跑 `hosted-harness-mysql` profile；两个新用例即上列名称。变异见证：arm 错 phase（`attempts` 恒 0、等待超时）、只匹配 MCP 域（命令照跑，`hook.call` 非空）、arm 后放行提交（同一断言失败）。

## 风险与范围

两格给共享 fork 增加 300 秒（8751 / 9351、Verify 166、job 269）；基线调整属台账增长，不是新增门禁。其余三格与 Hosted 车道本 head 的取证不在本提交内。

## 关联 Issue

#14449（FG13b）的一部分。

</details>

prs.title: feat(memory): opt-in extraction cadence after a no-op run
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the default-off internal experiment `QWEN_CODE_MEMORY_EXTRACT_NOOP_SKIP_TURNS` (0–3). After a completed extraction successfully accesses memory and saves nothing, up to N following turns skip extraction while pending history stays within 20 entries and the prompt stays below the compaction warning tier. A main-agent memory write disarms the cadence and invalidates older extraction outcomes.

The experiment retains the bounded skipped-history slice. If a later long turn evicts it from the captured 40-entry tail, the next extraction includes that slice alongside the tail; failed extraction also retains it for retry. The persisted cursor remains indexed against raw history, with no migration. ACP session close flushes pending turns within its remaining close budget. The variable is unset by default, preserving the existing once-per-turn behavior.

## Why it's needed

[#13004](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13004) measured roughly 9–10k input tokens per extractor launch even when nothing was saved. This experiment tests whether fewer launches can reduce that overhead while preserving memory quality. It does not claim a demonstrated real-model saving or enable the policy by default.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- With the experiment off, confirm extraction keeps its existing cadence. With N=2, a completed read-only noop can skip two ordinary turns; a failed read or a run that saved memory must not arm it.
- Introduce a durable preference on a skipped turn, then complete a tool-heavy turn that pushes it beyond the captured tail. Confirm that preference reaches extraction and is saved; check failure followed by close-time retry as well.
- Let the main agent write memory while an older extraction is running, then finish the older extraction with a noop. Confirm the next turn extracts normally.
- Close an ACP session while a turn is pending. Confirm the memory is persisted before close returns; overlapping or stale flush requests must not duplicate extraction or replay another session/project.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Controlled-provider tests exercised the actual ACP process, memory tools, outgoing model requests and persisted files. At baseline `505adabd9d`, a skipped preference was absent after a tool-heavy turn even though the cursor advanced to 55; at `6e7e4deb6d732a9a9c9a5c26c4c16c8d2a3164bc`, the same preference reaches the extractor and is persisted. The in-flight noop race likewise changes from skipping the following turn to extracting it. Failed reads do not arm the cadence. See the separate local verification comment for the full evidence and checks.

An earlier real `qwen3.8-flash` feature-toggle pair at `bdc6f5ccb9` did not establish savings: six matched turns produced 5 versus 6 extractor launches and 41,519 versus 73,000 extractor tokens including cached input. Model tool choices and memory quality differed, so those figures are not a causal regression estimate or current-head performance acceptance.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22, local source entrypoint through ACP, isolated configuration/runtime/memory directories. Current repair acceptance uses a loopback scripted provider; earlier real-model evidence is labeled separately.

## Risk & Scope

- Memory extraction may be delayed by up to N turns. ACP close waits for a best-effort flush; a timeout bounds waiting, not the lifetime of an extraction that has already started.
- Compaction, `/clear`, `/resume`, `/branch`, relocation, the OpenTUI switch and process exit do not flush skipped turns. Those losses, the process-global cache-safe slot, and the close/hold ordering remain follow-ups in #13612.
- Crash recovery, replay, default-on rollout and real-model quality/cost acceptance remain outside this change. One long turn can still exceed the existing captured tail; this repair preserves the earlier skipped slice, without promising full extraction of every entry in that long turn.
- No new user setting, dependency, persisted format or cursor migration. The shared fork result adds an optional successful-read observation; the existing attempted-tool signal used by the cursor keeps its meaning.
- Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/6e7e4deb6d732a9a9c9a5c26c4c16c8d2a3164bc/docs/design/auto-memory/structured-auto-memory-recall-design.md), [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/6e7e4deb6d732a9a9c9a5c26c4c16c8d2a3164bc/docs/design/auto-memory/structured-auto-memory-recall-design.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Refs #13004, #13612

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增默认关闭的内部实验 `QWEN_CODE_MEMORY_EXTRACT_NOOP_SKIP_TURNS`（0–3）。某次提取完成、成功访问过记忆且没有保存内容后，后续最多 N 轮可以跳过提取，前提是未处理历史不超过 20 条，且 prompt 低于压缩告警线。主 agent 写入记忆会解除跳过，并使更早提取的结论失效。

实验保留有界的被跳过历史片段。如果后续长轮次把它挤出捕获的 40 条尾部，下一次提取会把该片段补入尾部上下文；提取失败也会保留它供重试。持久游标继续使用原始历史下标，无需迁移。ACP 会话关闭会在剩余预算内冲刷积压轮次。环境变量默认不设置，保留现有逐轮提取行为。

## 为什么需要

[#13004](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13004) 实测每次提取即使零产出，也约消耗 9–10k 输入 token。本实验验证减少启动次数能否在保持记忆质量的前提下减少开销；尚未证明真实模型节省，也不默认开启。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 关闭实验时确认提取频率保持原样；N=2 时，成功读取记忆的零产出提取可以跳过后续两轮普通对话。读取失败或保存过记忆的运行不能启用跳过。
- 在被跳过的轮次引入长期偏好，随后执行足以把它挤出尾部的工具密集轮次。确认偏好进入提取并保存；同时检查提取失败后在关闭时重试。
- 让主 agent 在旧提取运行期间写入记忆，再让旧提取以零产出结束。确认下一轮正常提取。
- 有积压轮次时关闭 ACP 会话，确认关闭返回前记忆已落盘；重叠或过期的冲刷不能重复提取，也不能重放其他会话或项目。

### 证据（前后对比）

受控 provider 测试驱动了真实 ACP 进程、记忆工具、模型出站请求和落盘文件。在基线 `505adabd9d`，工具密集轮次后，被跳过的偏好没有保存，游标却已前进到 55；在 `6e7e4deb6d732a9a9c9a5c26c4c16c8d2a3164bc`，同一偏好进入提取器并成功保存。旧零产出提取的竞态也从“下一轮被跳过”变成正常提取。读取失败不会启用跳过。完整证据和检查见单独的本地验证评论。

此前在 `bdc6f5ccb9` 上用真实 `qwen3.8-flash` 做过开关对照，但没有证明节省：六轮相同输入，提取启动为 5 对 6 次，提取 token 为 41,519 对 73,000（含缓存输入）。模型工具选择和记忆质量不同，不能把这些数字当作因果回归判断或当前 head 的性能验收。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :-- | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ |

### 环境（可选）

Node 22，通过 ACP 运行本地源码，配置、运行和记忆目录均隔离。当前修复验收使用本机脚本化 provider；此前真实模型证据单独注明。

## 风险与范围

- 记忆提取可能延后最多 N 轮。ACP 关闭等待一次尽力冲刷；超时限制等待时间，不终止已经启动的提取。
- 压缩、`/clear`、`/resume`、`/branch`、切目录、OpenTUI 切换和进程退出不冲刷积压轮次。这些丢失边界、进程共享 cache-safe 槽位，以及关闭与 holds 的顺序，仍由 #13612 跟进。
- 崩溃恢复、重放、默认开启和真实模型质量/成本验收不在本次范围。单个长轮次仍可能超过现有尾部；本次修复保全此前被跳过的片段，不承诺提取该长轮次中的每一条内容。
- 不新增用户设置、依赖、持久化格式或游标迁移。共享 fork 结果增加可选的成功读取观测；游标原有的工具尝试信号保持含义不变。
- 设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/6e7e4deb6d732a9a9c9a5c26c4c16c8d2a3164bc/docs/design/auto-memory/structured-auto-memory-recall-design.md)、[中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/6e7e4deb6d732a9a9c9a5c26c4c16c8d2a3164bc/docs/design/auto-memory/structured-auto-memory-recall-design.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #13004, #13612

prs.title: feat(web-shell): show background shell task runtime details
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds captured output tails, output size and last-write time, resident memory, start/end times, and copy actions to background shell task details. Short command titles remain stable after refresh and restoration. A read-only runtime endpoint is available through REST, ACP, and the TypeScript SDK.

## Why it's needed

Long-running background shells currently show lifecycle metadata and an output-file path, leaving users unable to inspect their output from the panel. Runtime reads are kept separate from the task list, so only the open detail panel pays for output reads and process sampling. Cross-session panels read their original session, failed reads offer retry, and Stop waits for the backend terminal state before fetching the final tail.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open a running background shell with a long executable path. Confirm its tab uses a short title while the panel keeps the full command; fresh task snapshots must preserve that title. Output, file size/last-write time, resident memory and start time should be visible, and command/path copy actions should copy the full value.
2. Let the task complete, then repeat with Stop. Confirm the backend outcome, end time and final output are shown. After Stop is accepted while the backend is still running, the Stop action stays disabled until the real terminal state arrives.
3. Restore a shell tab belonging to another session. Runtime and Stop requests must target the source session. A transient stopping-status failure must recover on a later poll.
4. Fail a runtime read, then use Try again. Confirm output recovers without reopening the tab. Successful tail text must remain visible if only file metadata fails; empty output and unavailable task details must have distinct messages.

Validation: full repository build, bundle and typecheck (including integration types), changed-file ESLint/Prettier, and six Chromium browser scenarios passed. Expanded package-unit results and any baseline test failures are documented in the separate E2E report comment.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the shell panel exposed lifecycle metadata and an output-file path without an output preview. The screenshots below show the actual current Web Shell App using a **Mock daemon**. They verify rendering and source-session routing; they do not verify real Git operations or natural file metadata failure.

| Running after fresh snapshots | Natural completion with final output |
| --- | --- |
| ![Mock daemon: running task and stable short title](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/8bf3834d40c7962bc8540f94c8dbf3d397f075b6/shell-task-detail/running-title.png) | ![Mock daemon: completed task with final output](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/8bf3834d40c7962bc8540f94c8dbf3d397f075b6/shell-task-detail/running-completed.png) |

| Stop accepted, backend still running | Backend terminal state and final output |
| --- | --- |
| ![Mock daemon: Stop pending](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/8bf3834d40c7962bc8540f94c8dbf3d397f075b6/shell-task-detail/stop-pending.png) | ![Mock daemon: Stop final output](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/8bf3834d40c7962bc8540f94c8dbf3d397f075b6/shell-task-detail/stop-final-output.png) |

Screenshots are stored on a separate fork asset branch at fixed commit `8bf3834d40c7962bc8540f94c8dbf3d397f075b6`; no images are included in the implementation branch.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Unit checks, build/types, Chromium E2E |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Local Node.js, actual Vite Web Shell App and Chromium with controlled Mock daemon responses. A separate actual OS child-process/registry check reproduced delayed SIGTERM output; browser evidence does not claim a complete real shell backend test.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: RSS is informational, can count shared pages more than once and may describe only a sandbox wrapper. Process sampling is bounded; unavailable probes omit memory. This cross-package addition merits maintainer review of the session-runtime boundary.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows PowerShell cold-start timing, BusyBox ps, mobile browsers, CPU metrics and full ANSI rendering. Final output sampling follows backend terminal reporting; existing promoted-shell/platform cancellation semantics are unchanged. Nonblocking cleanup suggestions are recorded in a separate PR comment.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: additive runtime endpoint and SDK methods; no migration required. Unknown, evicted or non-shell task IDs return `runtime: null`.

Design: [English](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/37fff51a2f578dcfc0e0590c7aefe43c8972baac/docs/design/2026-10-19-shell-task-detail-runtime.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/37fff51a2f578dcfc0e0590c7aefe43c8972baac/docs/design/2026-10-19-shell-task-detail-runtime.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

为后台 shell 任务详情添加捕获输出尾部、输出大小和最后写入时间、常驻内存、开始/结束时间，以及复制操作。命令短标题在刷新和恢复后保持稳定。只读 runtime 接口同时通过 REST、ACP 和 TypeScript SDK 提供。

## 为什么需要

长时间运行的后台 shell 目前只显示生命周期信息和输出文件路径，用户无法在面板中查看输出。runtime 查询与任务列表分离，只有打开的详情面板才触发文件读取和进程采样。跨会话面板读取原会话，查询失败时支持重试；停止任务后等待后端返回终态，再读取最终尾部。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 打开一个可执行文件路径较长的运行中后台 shell。确认标签页使用短标题，面板保留完整命令，任务快照刷新后标题保持不变。应能看到输出、文件大小/最后写入时间、常驻内存和开始时间；命令和路径的复制操作应复制完整值。
2. 让任务自然完成，再用另一个任务测试停止。确认显示后端实际结果、结束时间和最终输出。停止请求被接受而后端仍在运行时，停止操作应保持禁用，直到真正进入终态。
3. 恢复属于其他会话的 shell 标签页。runtime 和停止请求必须发往原会话；停止期间的状态查询临时失败后，应在下一次轮询恢复。
4. 让 runtime 查询失败，再点击重试。确认无需重新打开标签页即可恢复输出。仅文件信息读取失败时，成功读到的尾部应保持可见；空输出与任务详情不可用应使用不同文案。

验证：整个仓库构建、打包、类型检查（包含集成测试类型）、改动文件 ESLint/Prettier，以及六个 Chromium 浏览器场景均通过。扩大后的包单测结果及基线测试失败情况记录在独立 E2E 报告评论中。

### 证据（前后对照）

改动前：shell 面板显示生命周期信息和输出文件路径，没有输出预览。上方截图来自当前实际 Web Shell App，使用**模拟 daemon**，验证渲染和原会话请求归属，不作为真实 Git 操作或自然文件信息读取失败的证据。

第一组左图展示任务快照刷新后保持短标题、输出信息及运行中常驻内存；右图展示自然完成后的最终输出。第二组左图展示停止请求已接受、后端尚未结束时的禁用状态；右图展示后端终态及最终输出。

截图存放于 fork 的独立素材分支，使用固定 commit `8bf3834d40c7962bc8540f94c8dbf3d397f075b6` 的链接；图片不进入实现分支。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 单测、构建/类型检查、Chromium E2E |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境（可选）

本地 Node.js、实际 Vite Web Shell App 和 Chromium，daemon 响应由受控模拟服务提供。另有实际系统子进程与 registry 检查复现 SIGTERM 延迟输出；浏览器证据不代表完整真实 shell 后端验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：RSS 仅供参考，共享页可能被重复计数，沙箱内可能只反映包装进程。采样有时间和缓冲上限，探针不可用时省略内存。本次跨包新增能力需要维护者关注会话 runtime 边界。
- 未验证或范围外：Windows PowerShell 冷启动耗时、BusyBox ps、移动端浏览器、CPU 指标和完整 ANSI 渲染。最终输出采样遵循后端终态报告，既有的前台提升任务及各平台停止语义保持不变。非阻塞整理建议记录在独立 PR 评论中。
- 兼容性或迁移：新增 runtime 接口与 SDK 方法，无需迁移。未知、已淘汰或非 shell 的任务 ID 返回 `runtime: null`。

设计：[English](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/37fff51a2f578dcfc0e0590c7aefe43c8972baac/docs/design/2026-10-19-shell-task-detail-runtime.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/37fff51a2f578dcfc0e0590c7aefe43c8972baac/docs/design/2026-10-19-shell-task-detail-runtime.zh-CN.md)。两个版本完整且同步。

## 关联 Issue

无。

</details>

prs.title: feat(runtime): coordinate original CSI physical retirement progress
prs.body:
## What this PR does

After the settled original generation-1/epoch-1 owner reaches application DRAINED, retain an immutable physical-retirement plan, original-source stop intent, UID/resourceVersion-qualified normal Pod-deletion attempts, actual bounded replies and continuous original-source STOPPED/UNPUBLISHED observations. Persist each attempt before transmission and keep unknown outcomes unknown; the same resourceVersion is attempted once, with at most eight distinct attempts. Reconstructing the store preserves the plan and progress while the binding, active slot and physical holder stay fenced.

This is slice (5) of the [five-slice plan](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13526#issuecomment-6263767753). It stacks on #14758 at `1656cf02fd8419ce7baf608adcfb21a2d28a3dfc` and can be reviewed alongside slice (4). Merge after slice (3), then rebase onto main and reconcile migration numbering with the actual landing order.

## Why it's needed

The existing application retirement refuses source-associated owners and has no durable physical coordination. This change admits retirement only after verifying the exact original PUBLISHED source, keeps existing inventory/2 bytes intact and pins source-associated retirement in a separate inventory/3. A deletion response or Pod absence never proves physical completion; UNPUBLISHED grants no release or reuse authority.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/5535175e0f1b087a498a2822a092d8d1e85788ee/docs/design/2026-10-20-k2-physical-retirement-progress.md) / [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/5535175e0f1b087a498a2822a092d8d1e85788ee/docs/design/2026-10-20-k2-physical-retirement-progress.zh-CN.md).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- For an original source-associated owner, application retirement should reach DRAINED before a physical plan can be saved. Replaying the plan or reconstructing the store should return the same identity and retained progress. Binding and physical holder remain DRAINING, and the active slot retains the original binding.
- Deletion should send the saved original UID/resourceVersion preconditions with a 30-second grace period and Background propagation. Transport loss must leave an unknown attempt; retrying the same resourceVersion must not send again. Actual 200/202/404/409 replies must not manufacture STOPPED or UNPUBLISHED.
- Only an extending journal from the pinned original source may advance observations. Changed source incarnation, Pod UID, node boot, plan, protection, credentials, malformed schema or corrupt retained bytes should refuse without advancing progress.
- Existing owners should retain inventory/2 compatibility. Source-associated history and release remain refused; public CLI help exposes no physical-retirement operation.

Validation: the complete Java unit/H2 suite ran 5,259 tests with zero failures/errors and 18 platform/profile skips. That invocation then failed Checkstyle on one extra blank line in a test; after its removal, `mvn -DskipTests -Dgpg.skip=true verify` passed both Checkstyle checks and SpotBugs (zero bugs/errors). No production or test logic changed between those runs. The selected disposable MySQL 8.4 integration ran 150 tests with zero failures/errors/skips. Root build/typecheck/bundle, 81 prerequisite-workflow meta-tests, scoped ESLint and Prettier passed. The final rebase and design-pin update preserve the tested Java subtree byte-for-byte.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for TUI. The global baseline and built CLI expose no public physical-retirement command. Private Java component/integration evidence and its fixture boundaries are documented in the separate E2E report.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Local Java/H2/MySQL, built worker and loopback HTTP |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Native CSI deployment not tested |

### Environment (optional)

JDK 21, Maven 3.9.16, disposable local MySQL 8.4.11, built Core/CLI worker and loopback HTTP fixtures.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: immutable source/application identity must remain consistent across every progress write. A crash after attempt persistence can leave that resourceVersion permanently unknown; another attempt requires a different resourceVersion.
- Not validated / out of scope: real Kubernetes deletion, successful source TLS authentication, native CSI unmount, installation/cold boot, process or host restart, final physical release, released-history reads, volume reuse and public selection. The MySQL physical segment uses rewritten journal fixtures and a mocked reply; a fresh store object is not a process restart.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: append V14 for physical progress and preserve V1–V13. Existing inventory/2 bytes remain unchanged; source owners use a distinct version. Keep Draft pending prerequisite landing, CI and maintainer review.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13526. Depends on #14758.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 本 PR 做什么

已正常结算的原始 generation-1/epoch-1 owner 达到应用 DRAINED 后，持久化不可变的物理退役计划、原 source 停止意图、限定原 Pod UID/resourceVersion 的正常删除尝试、实际有界回复，以及原 source 连续的 STOPPED/UNPUBLISHED 观察。每次尝试先保存再发送，未知结果保持未知；同一 resourceVersion 只尝试一次，最多八个不同版本。重新构造 store 后保留同一计划与进度，binding、active slot 和物理 holder 继续保持隔离。

这是[五块拆分计划](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13526#issuecomment-6263767753)的第 (5) 块，基于 #14758 的 `1656cf02fd8419ce7baf608adcfb21a2d28a3dfc`，可以与第 (4) 块并行评审。第 (3) 块合并后再合并本块，届时 rebase 到 main，并按实际落地顺序核对 migration 编号。

### 为什么需要

已有应用退役拒绝关联 source 的 owner，也没有持久化物理协调。本变更只在验证确切原始 PUBLISHED source 后允许退役，保持既有 inventory/2 字节不变，并用独立的 inventory/3 固定关联 source 的退役证据。删除回复或 Pod 消失不能证明物理完成；UNPUBLISHED 不授予释放或复用权限。

设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/5535175e0f1b087a498a2822a092d8d1e85788ee/docs/design/2026-10-20-k2-physical-retirement-progress.md) / [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/5535175e0f1b087a498a2822a092d8d1e85788ee/docs/design/2026-10-20-k2-physical-retirement-progress.zh-CN.md)。

### 评审验证计划

- 原始关联 source 的 owner 必须先达到应用 DRAINED，才可以保存物理计划。重复计划或重新构造 store 应返回同一身份和保留进度；binding 与物理 holder 继续 DRAINING，active slot 保留原 binding。
- 删除应发送保存的原 UID/resourceVersion 前置条件、30 秒宽限期和 Background propagation。传输丢失保留未知尝试；同一 resourceVersion 重试不再次发送。实际 200/202/404/409 回复不能制造 STOPPED 或 UNPUBLISHED。
- 只有固定原 source 的连续扩展 journal 才能推进观察。source incarnation、Pod UID、node boot、计划、protection 或 credential 变化，以及 schema 错误或保留字节损坏，都应拒绝且不推进进度。
- 既有 owner 保持 inventory/2 兼容。关联 source 的历史读取与释放保持拒绝；公开 CLI 帮助不暴露物理退役操作。

验证：完整 Java unit/H2 套件执行 5,259 项，零失败/错误，18 项因平台或 profile 跳过。该次调用随后因测试中一处多余空行未通过 Checkstyle；删除空行后，`mvn -DskipTests -Dgpg.skip=true verify` 通过两项 Checkstyle 与 SpotBugs（零 bug/error）。两次运行之间没有产品或测试逻辑变化。选定的可销毁 MySQL 8.4 集成执行 150 项，零失败/错误/跳过。根 build/typecheck/bundle、81 项前置 workflow meta-test、范围内 ESLint 与 Prettier 通过。最终 rebase 与设计 pin 更新后，受测 Java 子树逐字节一致。

### 前后证据

无 TUI 变更。全局基线和构建后的 CLI 均不暴露公开物理退役命令。私有 Java 组件/集成证据及其夹具边界见独立 E2E 报告。

### 测试平台与环境

| OS | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 本地 Java/H2/MySQL、构建后的 worker 和 loopback HTTP |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试原生 CSI 部署 |

环境：JDK 21、Maven 3.9.16、独占可销毁的本地 MySQL 8.4.11、构建后的 Core/CLI worker 和 loopback HTTP 夹具。

### 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：每次进度写入都必须保持不可变 source/application 身份一致。尝试持久化后发生崩溃，会让该 resourceVersion 永久保留未知结果；再次尝试需要不同的 resourceVersion。
- 未验证或不在范围：真实 Kubernetes 删除、成功的 source TLS 认证、原生 CSI unmount、安装/冷启动、进程或宿主重启、最终物理释放、释放后历史读取、卷复用和公开选择。MySQL 物理阶段使用重写的 journal 夹具与 mock 回复；新 store 对象不代表进程重启。
- 兼容性与迁移：只追加物理进度 V14，保留 V1–V13。既有 inventory/2 字节不变，source owner 使用独立版本。在前置 PR 落地、CI 和维护者审查完成前保留 Draft。

### 关联

Refs #13526；依赖 #14758。

</details>

prs.title: fix(ui): bottom-align short VP content so blank space is at top
prs.body:
## What this PR does

In VP mode (`useTerminalBuffer`, default on), when the conversation fits within the viewport the content was top-aligned, leaving a blank gap between the last message and the composer (reported in #9300, happens in every session). This bottom-aligns short bottom-stuck content: blank space moves to the TOP and the latest message sits directly above the composer, matching standard chat TUIs.

Implementation: in `VirtualizedList`, when `isStickingToBottom` and content fits (`maxScroll === 0`), compute `bottomAlignGap = scrollableContainerHeight - totalHeight`, render it as a leading spacer, and keep the root at full `containerHeight` so there is room. Overflow (`maxScroll > 0`) and scrolled-away cases are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

#9300: default-on VP mode showed a large blank area between the last message and the composer in every session (short conversations and collapsed thinking blocks). High-frequency, default-on visual regression on the primary surface — worth a quick fix.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/components/shared/VirtualizedList.test.tsx` — 32 tests pass, including the 3 updated to the new bottom-aligned layout.
2. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/components/MainContent.test.tsx packages/cli/src/ui/components/shared/ScrollableList.test.tsx` — 36 pass (no layout regression).
3. Manual (iTerm2, VP mode): start a short session — content should sit at the bottom above the composer with blank at top; collapse a thinking block (Ctrl+O) — released space appears at top, not between content and composer.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: content top-aligned, blank gap between last message and composer. After: content bottom-aligned, blank at top. (Needs a live terminal to visually confirm; unit tests pin the new frame layout.)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️ needs manual confirm (reported on iTerm2) |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ (unit tests) |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: changes the short-content layout from top-aligned/collapsed to bottom-aligned; three tests that pinned the old collapse behavior were updated to the new expectation. Scrolling/overflow math is untouched (`scrollableContainerHeight` unchanged).
- Not validated / out of scope: live iTerm2 visual confirmation (reporter's environment); height-overestimation cases where `totalHeight >= containerHeight` (those already bottom-show via `clampedScrollTop = maxScroll`).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #9300

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

VP 模式（默认开启）下，当会话内容高度小于视口时，内容顶部对齐，导致最后一条消息与输入框之间出现大片空白（#9300，每个 session 都出现）。本 PR 将短的、贴底的内容改为底部对齐：空白移到顶部，最新消息紧贴输入框上方，与主流 chat TUI 一致。

实现：`VirtualizedList` 中当 `isStickingToBottom` 且内容放得下（`maxScroll === 0`）时，计算 `bottomAlignGap = scrollableContainerHeight - totalHeight` 作为顶部占位，并保持 root 为满 `containerHeight`。溢出或已上滚的场景不变。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：短内容布局从顶部对齐/折叠改为底部对齐，3 个固定旧行为的测试已更新；滚动数学未动。
- 未验证：iTerm2 真机视觉确认；`totalHeight >= containerHeight` 的高度高估场景（该场景本就通过 `clampedScrollTop = maxScroll` 底部显示）。
- 破坏性变更：无。

</details>

prs.title: feat(core): add a real PTY backend for the Bun runtime
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Enables a POSIX PTY backend for Bun so shell tools and Web Terminal sessions can receive terminal output, resize and observe exits instead of falling back to ordinary child processes. It reads the existing pinned native addon's master descriptor directly, keeps reading while delivery is paused, and bounds the retained output and pending writes. Resource failures become explicit shell errors or WebSocket error frames, rather than successful command exits. Terminal error subscriptions are detached according to their actual return contract so releasing an EventEmitter-backed terminal does not crash the server.

## Why it's needed

With the existing wrapper under Bun, an idle nonblocking read can surface `EAGAIN` as a stream error and close the master descriptor: output stops and resize can fail although the child is still running. The previous runtime gate therefore disabled PTYs under Bun. Direct descriptor reads avoid that wrapper path. Keeping the read pump active during pause requires bounded storage: overflowing a budget now fails the affected session visibly instead of silently dropping output or retaining unlimited memory. This implements the backend and resource-error integration, not a complete runtime migration or a proof of safe cleanup for every process tree.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Review exact head `40f216d1a176f1a467bac61b548d288e2c1ca125` against its actual stacked base #14036. Under Bun 1.3.14 on POSIX, confirm a shell produces Unicode output, responds to a real terminal resize, exits naturally and allows the host to exit naturally. Repeat with Node 24.19.0 as the compatibility control. Bun on Windows should return a load error, not select this backend.
2. Pause/resume and XOFF/XON around a finite flood. Below the cap, compare the entire output byte-for-byte, including default terminal line processing. Verify natural exit and cancellation while paused. Above the retained-output or write budget, expect one structured failure, no fabricated success/exit code, released accounting and no impact on a healthy sibling session. Check admission beyond eight active terminals.
3. Through a real shell execution and `qwen serve` WebSocket connection, check release4004, natural exit4000, and backend-limit error4001 with the same failure on reconnect; the server must remain usable. Route-level input backpressure closes with1013 and must be distinguished from backend4001: a route-level1013 is not proof that the backend4001 path ran.
4. Check all owned child/descendant lifecycles and total FD/thread/accounting return, including TERM-resistant descendants and delayed native exit. A closed master or disappeared root PID is insufficient. Record actual commands, versions, exit codes, skips, raw output and cleanup snapshots; do not subtract known KQUEUE growth.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the author reported the wrapper's `EAGAIN`/closed-master failure under Bun1.3.14/1.4.0 with a working Node control. The earlier d7 head also crashed the real serve process when releasing the Bun terminal because an EventEmitter return value was treated as a disposable. This head includes the subscription-contract fix and tests; the resource-failure contract is implemented in both shell and WebSocket consumers.

Remaining failures are material: independent macOS arm64 testing of d7 completed the 30-minute and eight-PTY/two-hour windows but both runtime legs exited1 on FD checks, with eight additional KQUEUE descriptors per leg in the long window. The native addon is not patched by this diff. Paused-flood strict byte checks also failed (including an extra-CR sample); later successful reruns do not close that failure or establish an OS-only cause. Those predecessor observations require closure on the selected candidate, not an exemption. Later local candidates and native fixes are not code in this PR's current head.

The focused suites are reproducible after normal dependency setup; these are commands to run, not a claim that this edit ran them:

```sh
cd packages/core
BUN_TEST_BIN=/absolute/path/to/bun-1.3.14 NODE_TEST_BIN=/absolute/path/to/node-24.19.0 corepack pnpm exec vitest run src/utils/bun-pty.test.ts src/utils/getPty.test.ts src/utils/bun-pty.node-bun.test.ts src/utils/runtime-boundary.node-bun.test.ts src/services/shellExecutionService.test.ts src/services/web-terminal-registry.test.ts
cd ../cli
corepack pnpm exec vitest run src/serve/routes/terminal.test.ts
cd ../..
npm run preflight
```

The unit suites include mocked consumers; their pass counts do not establish real product lifecycle or native resource acceptance. A current-head terminal recording/raw end-to-end report and complete cross-platform/resource evidence are still needed; this edit adds no new E2E run or visual demo.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | Author focused Node/Bun checks reported; independent predecessor FD/byte failures retained; current head not independently accepted |
| 🪟 Windows | Bun backend disabled; ConPTY not validated by this PR |
| 🐧 Linux | No complete local product/resource acceptance claimed for this head; CI jobs do not substitute for it |

### Environment (optional)

Historical macOS arm64 comparisons use Node24.19.0 and Bun1.3.14; author probes also used Bun1.4.0. The same pinned `@lydell/node-pty` addon is used, not a new native fix. No tests were run for this description-only update.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: pause stops delivery while reads continue. Defaults are 4MiB retained per PTY, 32MiB retained process-wide, eight active PTYs and a 1MiB write queue per PTY. Exceeding the relevant budget rejects admission or terminates the affected session with a structured error. Termination attempts TERM then KILL after500ms; complete tree cleanup, PID-reuse safety, native resource release and finalization timing remain acceptance work, not guarantees established by this description.
- Not validated / out of scope: native KQUEUE repair, complete safe descendant cleanup, strict byte/combined-suite stability, Windows Bun PTY, the separate agent-view PTY host, original release-archive execution and full cross-platform acceptance. The apparent FIFO classification of macOS KQUEUE descriptors is not evidence of a distinct helper-pipe leak. No supervisor, owner-token protocol or later Bun Terminal replacement is implemented in this head.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no public command removal or forced npm runtime migration; Node backend selection is retained. Bun changes from unavailable PTY to a terminal backend, and budget exhaustion now visibly fails/terminates commands. Callers must handle structured failures with null exitCode/signal; WebSocket clients must handle the error frame/4001 and failed-session reconnect. Do not describe this as zero behavior change. No user action enables a new default runtime here.

This diff exceeds2,000 changed lines because the backend, bounded-storage tests, shell/WebSocket failure handling and bilingual design are reviewed together; exposing limits without their consumer error handling would misreport failures. This explains the scope, not a waiver of review, preflight or resource gates.

Design pairs: [backend English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/40f216d1a176f1a467bac61b548d288e2c1ca125/docs/design/bun-pty-backend.md) / [后端中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/40f216d1a176f1a467bac61b548d288e2c1ca125/docs/design/bun-pty-backend.zh-CN.md), and [runtime English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/40f216d1a176f1a467bac61b548d288e2c1ca125/docs/design/bun-runtime-boundary.md) / [运行时中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/40f216d1a176f1a467bac61b548d288e2c1ca125/docs/design/bun-runtime-boundary.zh-CN.md). Both language pairs are in the diff; historical claims must be read with the failure qualifications above, not as full acceptance.

## Linked Issues

Stacked on #14036 (`feat/bun-runtime-boundary`); review/merge the prerequisite first. Related: #11607 and #11881. No issue is auto-closed. This PR remains subject to requested changes and is not ready merely because it is open.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

为 Bun 启用 POSIX PTY 后端，使 shell 工具与 Web Terminal 会话能够接收终端输出、调整尺寸和观察退出，而非回退普通子进程。后端直接读取现有锁定 addon 的 master fd，暂停投递时持续读取，并限制保持输出及待写入数据。资源失败转换为明确 shell 错误或 WebSocket 错误帧，不伪装成功退出。终端错误订阅按真实返回契约解绑，避免释放 EventEmitter 后端时崩溃服务。

## 为什么需要

Bun 下原包装层可能把非阻塞空闲读取的 EAGAIN 当流错误并关闭 master，导致子进程仍运行但输出停止、resize失败。因此此前禁用 Bun PTY。直接读取描述符避开这条包装路径；暂停时持续读取则必须限制存储，超过预算应明确失败，而不是静默丢字节或无限占用内存。本 PR 实现后端与资源错误接线，不代表整体迁移完成或所有进程树均已安全回收。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 对照实际堆叠base #14036审阅精确head `40f216d1a176f1a467bac61b548d288e2c1ca125`。POSIX下用Bun1.3.14确认shell输出Unicode、真实resize、自然退出及宿主自然退出；用Node24.19.0作兼容对照。Windows Bun应返回加载错误，不选该后端。
2. 在有限洪流中pause/resume及XOFF/XON。上限内逐字节比较全部输出，保留默认行规程；验证暂停自然退出及取消。超过保持/写预算应仅一次结构化失败，无伪造成功或退出码，账本释放，不影响健康会话；验证第九个终端准入拒绝。
3. 经真实shell执行及qwen serve WebSocket检查release4004、自然退出4000、后端超限错误4001与重连同错误，服务仍可用。区分registry输入背压与后端：路由1013不证明后端4001已执行。
4. 检查自有child/全部子孙、总FD/线程/账本回收，覆盖抵抗TERM的后代与迟到native exit。master关闭或root PID消失不足以通过。保存真实命令、版本、退出码、skip、输出和清理快照，不扣除已知KQUEUE增长。

### 证据（Before & After）

修复前，作者报告Bun1.3.14/1.4.0包装层EAGAIN/master关闭，Node对照正常；早期d7在释放真实Bun终端时因将EventEmitter返回值当disposable而崩溃服务。当前head含订阅契约修复与测试，并在shell/WS消费方实现资源错误合同。

重要失败仍保留：独立macOS arm64的d7测试完成30分钟及8PTY两小时窗口，但两运行时均因FD检查exit1，长窗各增加8个KQUEUE。当前diff未修补native addon。paused-flood严格字节检查也失败（含额外CR保全样本）；后来重跑成功不能关闭失败或证明仅为OS原因。须在选定候选关闭这些前序观察，不作豁免。后续本地候选与native修复并非当前PR head中的代码。

正常安装依赖后可复现以下定向检查；它们是待运行命令，不代表本次已执行：

```sh
cd packages/core
BUN_TEST_BIN=/absolute/path/to/bun-1.3.14 NODE_TEST_BIN=/absolute/path/to/node-24.19.0 corepack pnpm exec vitest run src/utils/bun-pty.test.ts src/utils/getPty.test.ts src/utils/bun-pty.node-bun.test.ts src/utils/runtime-boundary.node-bun.test.ts src/services/shellExecutionService.test.ts src/services/web-terminal-registry.test.ts
cd ../cli
corepack pnpm exec vitest run src/serve/routes/terminal.test.ts
cd ../..
npm run preflight
```

单测含mock消费方，计数不代表真实产品生命周期或native资源验收。仍需当前head的终端录像/原始端到端报告及完整跨平台、资源证据；本次未新跑E2E或补视觉演示。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :--- | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | 作者报告定向Node/Bun检查；独立前序FD/字节失败保留，当前head未独立验收 |
| 🪟 Windows | Bun后端禁用，本PR未验证ConPTY |
| 🐧 Linux | 不声称当前head本机完整产品/资源通过，CI job不替代 |

### 环境（可选）

历史macOS arm64对照使用Node24.19.0/Bun1.3.14，作者另用Bun1.4.0；仍为同一锁定@lydell/node-pty addon，不是新native修复。本次描述更新未运行测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：pause停止投递而持续读取。默认每PTY保持4MiB、进程总保持32MiB、8个活动PTY、每PTY写队列1MiB；相应超限会拒绝准入或结构化失败并终止该会话。终止尝试TERM后500ms升级KILL；完整树清理、PID复用安全、native资源及最终化时限仍待验收，不是本描述确立的保证。
- 未验证/范围外：native KQUEUE修复、完整安全树、严格字节/组合稳定、Windows Bun PTY、独立agent-view PTY host、原样发布归档执行及完整跨平台验收。macOS KQUEUE被粗分类为FIFO不证明另有helper管道泄漏。当前head未实现supervisor、owner-token协议或后来的Bun Terminal替代。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：不删除公开命令、不强制npm迁移，保留Node后端选择。Bun从不可用PTY变为终端后端，预算超限现在会明确失败/终止命令。调用方须处理exitCode/signal为null的结构化失败；WS客户端须处理错误帧/4001与失败重连。不能称为零行为变化；本PR不启用新默认运行时。

diff超过2000变更行，是将后端、有界存储测试、shell/WS失败接线与双语设计共同审阅；只有上限而没有消费方错误处理会误报失败。这仅解释范围，不豁免review、preflight或资源门槛。

设计文档：[backend English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/40f216d1a176f1a467bac61b548d288e2c1ca125/docs/design/bun-pty-backend.md) / [后端中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/40f216d1a176f1a467bac61b548d288e2c1ca125/docs/design/bun-pty-backend.zh-CN.md)，以及[runtime English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/40f216d1a176f1a467bac61b548d288e2c1ca125/docs/design/bun-runtime-boundary.md) / [运行时中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/40f216d1a176f1a467bac61b548d288e2c1ca125/docs/design/bun-runtime-boundary.zh-CN.md)。两组语言版本均在diff内；历史主张须结合上述失败限定阅读，不代表完整验收。

## 关联 Issue

堆叠于#14036（feat/bun-runtime-boundary），须先审阅/合入前置。相关#11607与#11881，不自动关闭issue。当前仍需处理请求修改，OPEN不代表可合并。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): preview PDFs with the native browser viewer
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Workspace PDFs opened from @ references, the Files extension (inline or in a standalone tab), and artifact cards now use the existing native browser PDF viewer. Attachments also recognize `.pdf` filenames when their MIME type is generic. The viewer retains download access, with a download fallback when the browser reports no inline PDF support.

PDFs load through the existing binary file reader and the resolved workspace, with retry, cancellation, version refresh, and Blob URL cleanup. Literal `#` and `?` characters in workspace paths remain intact, including in directories whose names contain misleading extensions. Existing Sources PDF previews are preserved.

## Why it's needed

Workspace PDFs currently reach a text reader from @ references and Files, while PDF artifacts are treated as download-only. Reusing the attachment viewer makes PDF access consistent across these entry points without adding a rendering library or daemon API.

Designs: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/7daf340bbb3b7f784c89f0ee127bedef0dad02eb/docs/design/web-shell-native-pdf-preview.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/7daf340bbb3b7f784c89f0ee127bedef0dad02eb/docs/design/web-shell-native-pdf-preview.zh-CN.md). Both versions include matching decisions, constraints, and acceptance criteria.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open a valid PDF as a draft attachment, a persisted message attachment, an @file reference, and an artifact. Each should show its page in the native viewer; a `.PDF` attachment with generic MIME should also work.
2. In Files, select a PDF for inline preview, then use Preview from its context menu. A standalone PDF tab should open and keep the existing Files tab available.
3. On a filesystem that supports these names, repeat with `reports/Q3#final.pdf`, `reports/Q3?final.pdf`, and `reports.xlsx#approved/report.pdf`. The PDF should render from @ references, Files, and Sources; the exact path should reach binary reads, with no text read.
4. Download a previewed PDF and compare its bytes with the original. A failed workspace read should offer retry; missing/expired artifacts should not be read. Switching artifact versions or workspaces should load the corresponding file.

Local validation passed: 288 focused unit tests, 11 Chromium PDF E2E tests, the full build script, root typecheck, bundle, CLI version smoke (`0.25.3`), focused ESLint, Prettier, and whitespace checks. The final additional code review found no blocking defects. The branch merges cleanly with the fetched upstream main.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: @ references and Files routed workspace PDFs to text preview, and artifact PDFs offered downloads. PDF-MIME attachments and Sources already supported native previews. After: the following browser captures show actual PDF content across all requested entry points and the preserved Sources path.

**All screenshots use a simulated daemon and a valid one-page PDF in full Chromium. They verify browser integration, request routing, and the tested download bytes; they do not verify real daemon filesystem or Git backend operations.** All captured states were visually inspected. Images are stored only on a separate branch in the fork and linked at immutable commit `c5d8ebe16b767ab209f40d29408af9f92cb7aa33`; no images are included in the implementation branch.

| Attachment | Artifact |
| --- | --- |
| ![Draft attachment PDF preview, mock daemon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/c5d8ebe16b767ab209f40d29408af9f92cb7aa33/attachment.png) | ![Artifact PDF preview, mock daemon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/c5d8ebe16b767ab209f40d29408af9f92cb7aa33/artifact.png) |

| @file reference | Files inline preview |
| --- | --- |
| ![@file PDF preview, mock daemon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/c5d8ebe16b767ab209f40d29408af9f92cb7aa33/reference.png) | ![Files inline PDF preview, mock daemon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/c5d8ebe16b767ab209f40d29408af9f92cb7aa33/files-inline.png) |

| Files standalone tab | Sources with literal # path |
| --- | --- |
| ![Files standalone PDF tab, mock daemon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/c5d8ebe16b767ab209f40d29408af9f92cb7aa33/files-tab.png) | ![Sources PDF preview preserving #, mock daemon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/c5d8ebe16b767ab209f40d29408af9f92cb7aa33/source-literal-path.png) |

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node.js 22.14.0, local Web Shell served by Vite, full Chromium with simulated daemon responses. The full build used an 8 GiB Node heap without changing repository build settings.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: native viewer behavior varies by browser; complete-file loading retains the existing 100 MiB size limit and can consume memory for large PDFs. Host CSP must allow Blob frames.
- Not validated / out of scope: real daemon filesystem operations, Windows/Linux, other browser viewers, editing, OCR, and streaming large files.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No new dependency, daemon route, or public API.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的变更

通过 @ 引用、文件扩展区（内嵌或独立页签）及 artifact 卡片打开的工作区 PDF，统一复用现有浏览器原生 PDF 阅读器。附件在 MIME 为通用类型时也能通过 `.pdf` 文件名识别。阅读器保留下载入口，浏览器明确不支持内嵌 PDF 时回退到下载。

PDF 通过现有二进制读取流程和解析后的所属工作区加载，支持重试、取消、版本刷新与 Blob URL 释放。工作区路径中的原始 `#` 和 `?` 得以保留，也覆盖目录名包含误导扩展名的情况。Sources 已有的 PDF 预览继续可用。

## 为什么需要

目前 @ 引用和 Files 打开的工作区 PDF 会进入文本读取，而 PDF artifact 被视为仅下载。复用附件阅读器可统一这些入口的 PDF 体验，无需新增渲染库或 daemon API。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/7daf340bbb3b7f784c89f0ee127bedef0dad02eb/docs/design/web-shell-native-pdf-preview.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/7daf340bbb3b7f784c89f0ee127bedef0dad02eb/docs/design/web-shell-native-pdf-preview.zh-CN.md)。两个版本的决策、约束与验收标准完整同步。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 分别以草稿附件、已发送的消息附件、@file 引用和 artifact 打开有效 PDF，均应在原生阅读器中显示页面；MIME 为通用类型的 `.PDF` 附件也应正常。
2. 在 Files 中选择 PDF 查看内嵌预览，再使用右键菜单的 Preview。应打开独立 PDF 页签，并保留现有 Files 页签。

prs.title: fix(core): widen the agent workspace lock retry budget (#14028)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Raises the cross-process workspace lock's acquisition retry budget from 10 retries (5–100ms randomized exponential backoff, ~0.65–1.3s worst case) to 30 retries (~5s worst case), matching the budget the Agent Board lock already uses for the same two-tier locking pattern. Everything else about the lock is unchanged: the in-process mutex still serializes same-process writers, and stale-lock breaking (`stale: 10_000`) still recovers a dead holder's lock after 10 seconds.

## Why it's needed

`main` CI failed on `agent workspace lock > loses no roster update when two processes write at once` (#14028). The test spawns two child processes that each perform 8 read-modify-write roster updates under the store's file lock. On an oversubscribed CI host, one holder's critical section — an fsync-bound atomic JSON write — can outlast the ~1s retry budget, so the competing process exhausted its retries, exited with `ELOCKED: Lock file is already being held`, and failed the test. CI's `--retry=2` does not help because every attempt on a badly placed host hits the same contention. I reproduced this locally: pinned to 2 CPUs with CPU and fsync competitors, the pre-fix code failed 6 of 30 rounds with ELOCKED; with this change, 30 of 30 rounds passed. A longer wait is strictly safer here: the lock guards a low-frequency roster/registry store, so waiting a few seconds for a slow live holder is always preferable to erroring.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm the change is confined to the workspace store's lock options and that the concurrency test passes: run `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/agents/workspace-agents/workspace-lock.test.ts` and expect 1 passed test. To observe the original failure mode, revert the one-line change (`retries: 30` back to `10`) and run the same test on a heavily loaded machine (or pinned to few CPUs with competing load): the worker processes intermittently exit 1 with `ELOCKED: Lock file is already being held`. With the fix, the waiters simply wait out the slow holder instead of erroring.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (no user-visible behavior change; the observable difference is CI stability under host contention: before, 6/30 contended probe rounds failed with ELOCKED; after, 0/30 failed).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests under `packages/core` (vitest), plus a local contention harness pinning the test scenario to 2 CPUs with busy CPU/fsync competitors.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a waiter now holds on for up to ~5s (was ~1s) before failing lock acquisition when a live holder is slow; a dead holder's lock is still broken after 10s via the unchanged stale detection, so crash recovery latency is unaffected.
- Not validated / out-of-scope: macOS and Windows lanes (left to CI; the change is a platform-independent timing budget). A deeper hardening — aborting a transaction whose lock is compromised mid-flight instead of only warning — is deliberately out of scope for this flake fix.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14028

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

将跨进程 workspace 锁的获取重试预算从 10 次(5–100ms 随机指数退避,最坏约 0.65–1.3 秒)提高到 30 次(最坏约 5 秒),与 Agent Board 锁在相同双层锁模式下已有的预算一致。锁的其他行为完全不变:进程内互斥锁仍然串行化同进程写入者,过期锁打破机制(`stale: 10_000`)仍然会在 10 秒后回收已崩溃持锁者留下的锁。

## 为什么需要

`main` 分支 CI 在 `agent workspace lock > loses no roster update when two processes write at once` 上失败(#14028)。该测试派生两个子进程,各自在存储的文件锁下执行 8 次 roster 读-改-写更新。在超额订阅的 CI 主机上,持锁者的一次临界区——带 fsync 的原子 JSON 写入——可能超过约 1 秒的重试预算,导致竞争进程重试耗尽后以 `ELOCKED: Lock file is already being held` 退出,测试失败。CI 的 `--retry=2` 帮不上忙,因为在被调度到繁忙主机时,每次尝试都会遇到同样的争用。我已在本地复现:固定到 2 个 CPU 并加入 CPU 与 fsync 竞争负载时,修复前的代码在 30 轮中有 6 轮以 ELOCKED 失败;应用本改动后,30 轮全部通过。此处更长的等待严格更安全:该锁守护的是低频的 roster/注册表存储,为一个缓慢的活跃持锁者多等几秒永远优于直接报错。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

确认改动仅限于 workspace 存储的锁参数,且并发测试通过:运行 `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/agents/workspace-agents/workspace-lock.test.ts`,预期 1 个测试通过。若要观察原始失败模式,可将这一行改动回退(`retries: 30` 改回 `10`),并在负载较重的机器上(或绑定到少量 CPU 并施加竞争负载)运行同一测试:worker 进程会间歇性地以退出码 1 失败,报 `ELOCKED: Lock file is already being held`。应用修复后,等待者会等待缓慢的持锁者完成,而不是报错。

### 前后对照证据

N/A(无用户可见的行为变化;可观察的差异是主机争用下的 CI 稳定性:修复前,30 轮带载探测有 6 轮以 ELOCKED 失败;修复后,30 轮无一失败)。

### 已测试平台

|     系统    |  状态  |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境(可选)

`packages/core` 下的单元测试(vitest),以及一个将测试场景固定到 2 个 CPU 并施加 CPU/fsync 竞争负载的本地争用 harness。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍:当活跃持锁者较慢时,等待者现在最多坚持约 5 秒(原来约 1 秒)才会放弃锁获取;已崩溃持锁者的锁仍会通过未改动的过期检测在 10 秒后被打破,因此崩溃恢复延迟不受影响。
- 未验证 / 超出范围:macOS 与 Windows 通道(交由 CI 覆盖;本改动是平台无关的计时预算)。更深一层的加固——在锁中途被夺时中止事务而不是仅告警——刻意不纳入本次抖动修复的范围。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明:无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #14028

</details>
