prs.title: feat(runtime): add K2 offline installation and cold bootstrap
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Extract the fourth review slice from #13526: offline image and executable inputs, policy generation and explicitly pinned no-load compilation, closed installation-artifact assembly, deterministic cold-initrd packaging, and the Linux original-PID1 loader ending at a fixed empty systemd target. This is a software extraction; generated candidates do not authorize installation.

This PR is stacked on #14758 at `1656cf02fd8419ce7baf608adcfb21a2d28a3dfc`, with only the installation/cold-bootstrap increment in its review diff. Merge that dependency first, then rebase and retarget this PR to `main`. It does not duplicate the merged cold-recovery/application-retirement slices or add physical retirement coordination.

## Why it's needed

The preceding slice supplies strict installed-byte readers and controlled creation, but intentionally provides no producer or installation authority. This slice supplies the matching offline producer and cold-bootstrap implementation while preserving the same closed graph and refusal behavior, making the installation increment reviewable independently from the cumulative K2 branch.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Review that the producers bind the reviewed executable, image, configuration and generator bytes; changed pins, missing or extra graph members, unsupported versions and reused outputs must refuse. A valid synthetic graph should produce exactly 26 installed files and preserve all original source-configuration bytes except the one derived policy-digest token.
- Review that compilation fixes the parser, feature inputs and empty configuration, disables kernel loading and caching, and retains failed attempts. A successful metadata record alone is never native policy evidence.
- Verify deterministic packaging and the fixed empty systemd endpoint. Original PID1/thread/namespace checks, helper closure, capability reduction, descriptor verification, policy readback/locking and original-thread exec must remain mandatory, with failure stopping the sequence. Software failure tests must use package-private fakes rather than a selectable production bypass.
- Check the software CI for the offline suite and Linux tests/builds. Native installation, actual AppArmor parser/enforcement and real PID1/systemd handoff require separate qualification.

### Evidence (Before & After)

No TUI change. Before this slice, the node-evidence dependency provides readers but no offline producer or cold-PID1 entry. The ordinary global CLI help does not expose this private pipeline. The extracted software passes the 90-case Python suite, 47 top-level portable Go tests (466 passing test/subtest events), module verification, Linux amd64/arm64 cross-builds, coldboot Linux test compilation, the workflow meta-test, and root build/typecheck/bundle. Independent command-level verification passed 107 observation assertions over two valid assemblies and 41 refusals; earlier six fake-operation compiler-failure cases and a 13-assertion archived-evidence audit are retained separately. The final CI-only rebase changes no Go/Python production or test bytes. YAML/action lint, workflow-size checks and related meta-tests pass (298 passed, 23 environment-dependent skips); the report identifies the exact execution commit and final attribution.

The standard root build hit its hard-coded 4 GiB Node heap limit; running the same build script directly with an 8 GiB process heap passed. The Linux-only root Go package cannot run on macOS; focused portable tests passed, and Linux execution remains a CI gate. Cross-compilation is not native boot acceptance. A separate comment records exact candidate-specific commands, outcomes and limits.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Offline software, portable Go, repository checks and CLI help boundary |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A for the Linux cold-init lane; not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Cross-built for amd64/arm64 and coldboot tests compiled; local Linux execution/native boot not run |

### Environment (optional)

Owned macOS worktree with pinned pnpm dependencies and Go 1.26.3. Tests use inert ELF/image/boot/policy metadata fixtures and owned temporary directories; no fixture ELF or real PID1 entry is executed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: this is security-sensitive boot and policy code requiring maintainer review; software correctness does not qualify the real host policy set or boot environment.
- Not validated / out of scope: native installation, actual parser execution, policy load/export/lock, reboot and first systemd handoff, continuous actor/CSI confinement, physical release, safe reuse and public CSI selection. Native acceptance remains `NOT_RUN`.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no Java, SQL, public CLI or existing retirement behavior change in this stacked delta. The supported first boot lane remains Ubuntu 24.04.5 amd64 with the fixed kernel/systemd inputs; an arm64 build adds no boot lane.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/63ac8bf6c75c24e46e8a89f21b69676603a58f1e/docs/design/2026-10-20-k2-installation-cold-bootstrap.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/63ac8bf6c75c24e46e8a89f21b69676603a58f1e/docs/design/2026-10-20-k2-installation-cold-bootstrap.zh-CN.md), with matching decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria and follow-up work.

## Linked Issues

Fourth extraction from #13526. Depends on #14758. Related merged slices: #14695 and #14698. No closing keyword applies to the cumulative PR.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

从 #13526 提取第四块评审范围：离线镜像及可执行输入、策略生成和显式固定且不加载内核的编译、闭合安装物组装、确定性冷启动 initrd 打包，以及以固定空 systemd target 为终点的 Linux 原始 PID1 loader。这是软件提取；生成候选不授予安装权限。

本 PR 堆叠于 #14758 的 `1656cf02fd8419ce7baf608adcfb21a2d28a3dfc`，评审差异只包含安装物与冷启动增量。须先合入依赖，再 rebase 并将本 PR 目标改为 `main`。不重复已经合入的冷恢复、应用退役，也不加入物理退役协调。

## 为什么需要

前一块提供严格的安装字节读取器与受控创建，有意不提供生产工具或安装权限。本块补齐使用相同契约的离线生产工具及冷启动实现，保留闭合图与拒绝行为，使安装增量可以脱离累计 K2 分支独立评审。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

- 检查生产工具是否绑定经过审查的可执行文件、镜像、配置及 generator 字节；变化的 pin、缺失或多余图成员、不支持版本及复用输出必须拒绝。合法合成图应生成精确 26 个安装文件，且原始 source 配置仅改动一个派生 policy-digest token，其余字节原样保留。
- 检查编译是否固定 parser、feature 输入和空配置，禁止内核加载及缓存，并保留失败尝试。成功的元数据记录本身绝不是原生策略证据。
- 验证确定性打包和固定空 systemd 终点。原始 PID1、线程、namespace 校验，helper 关闭、能力降低、描述符核验、策略回读及锁定、原线程 exec 必须保持强制；任何失败都停止序列。软件失败测试只能使用包私有 fake，不能通过生产开关选择旁路。
- 检查软件 CI 的离线测试与 Linux 测试、构建。原生安装、真实 AppArmor parser/策略执行及真实 PID1/systemd 交接需要单独认证。

### 前后证据

没有 TUI 改动。此前节点证据依赖提供读取器，但没有离线生产工具或冷启动 PID1 入口。普通全局 CLI help 不暴露这条私有流水线。提取后通过 Python 90 项测试、47 项顶层 portable Go 测试（466 个 test/subtest 通过事件）、模块校验、Linux amd64/arm64 交叉构建、coldboot Linux 测试编译、workflow meta-test 和根 build/typecheck/bundle。独立命令级验证通过两次合法组装与 41 次拒绝的 107 项观察断言；较早执行的六类编译失败假操作和 13 项归档证据审计单独保留。最终只涉及 CI 的 rebase 未改变 Go/Python 产品及测试字节。YAML/action lint、workflow 大小检查和相关 meta-tests 均通过（298 项通过、23 项因环境条件跳过）；报告区分准确执行提交和最终归属核对。

标准根构建触及硬编码的 Node 4 GiB 堆限制；使用 8 GiB 进程堆直接运行同一构建脚本后通过。Linux 根 Go 包无法在 macOS 执行；定向 portable 测试已通过，Linux 执行仍为 CI 门槛。交叉构建不代表原生启动验收。单独评论记录绑定准确候选的命令、结果和限制。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 离线软件、portable Go、仓库检查及 CLI help 边界 |
| 🪟 Windows | Linux cold-init 通道不适用；未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 已交叉构建 amd64/arm64 并编译 coldboot 测试；未进行本地 Linux 执行或原生启动 |

### 环境

独立 macOS worktree、固定 pnpm 依赖及 Go 1.26.3。测试使用惰性 ELF、镜像、启动及策略元数据 fixture 和自有临时目录；不执行 fixture ELF 或真实 PID1 入口。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险及取舍：启动及策略代码涉及安全边界，需要维护者评审；软件正确性不认证真实宿主策略集或启动环境。
- 未验证及范围外：原生安装、实际 parser 执行、策略加载/导出/锁定、重启和首次 systemd 交接、持续 actor/CSI 约束、物理释放、安全复用及公开 CSI 选择。原生验收保持 `NOT_RUN`。
- 兼容性及迁移：本堆叠增量不改 Java、SQL、公开 CLI 或现有退役行为。唯一首启动通道仍是固定内核/systemd 输入的 Ubuntu 24.04.5 amd64；arm64 构建不增加启动通道。

设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/63ac8bf6c75c24e46e8a89f21b69676603a58f1e/docs/design/2026-10-20-k2-installation-cold-bootstrap.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/63ac8bf6c75c24e46e8a89f21b69676603a58f1e/docs/design/2026-10-20-k2-installation-cold-bootstrap.zh-CN.md)，决策、约束、验收标准及后续工作完整同步。

## 关联事项

#13526 的第四块提取，依赖 #14758。相关已合入切片为 #14695 和 #14698；不使用关闭累计 PR 的关键字。

</details>

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): Preserve original owners for owed Hosted cleanup
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Records outstanding Hosted cleanup references atomically with the native journal and keeps their exact original Runtime binding families available to retention. Confirmation releases only the matching debt. Permanently retired Sessions release any remaining cleanup references after native journal collection and before physical resource collection. Legacy journals remain conservatively protected until their cleanup coverage can be proven or their journals are permanently collected.

## Why it's needed

A released binding can age out while its cleanup confirmation is still owed. Replaying the original release then changes from released=true to runtime_session_conflict, so recovery cannot confirm the debt. Retaining the original owner avoids an arbitrary expiry for success markers and preserves all existing refusal checks for a missing, foreign or mismatched owner.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Persist an owed descriptor, release and age the original binding family, sweep retention, and confirm the same release still succeeds after reopening stores and in a fresh JVM. Confirming one of two debts must keep the family; confirming both makes it collectible. Rolled-back journal commits must leave no cleanup reference. Never-existing bindings, foreign Harness or Runtime Sessions, and a different generation must still fail. A legacy head with unknown cleanup coverage must stay protected across subsequent commits. For permanent Session GC, verify the native transactions disappear before cleanup references, and references disappear before descriptor bytes and exact collection accounting.

Independent H2 and MySQL 8.4 probes reproduced the baseline failure and verified the fix. The fresh-JVM MySQL probe also succeeds. The six cleanup cases pass on both engines, the existing retention-guard suite passes 16 cases, schema parity checks pass 24 cases, V13 configuration/upgrade coverage passes six H2 tests, and the new collection-order case passes on both engines. Native V12-to-V13 ordinary head/reference preservation also passes. The downstream CSI inventory catalogue is synchronized with both new columns; 63 H2 cases and a MySQL catalogue regression pass. Final unfiltered mvn verify passes 4,967 cases with zero failures/errors and 18 existing skips; both Checkstyle gates and SpotBugs pass.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — server persistence and retention behavior, with no UI change. The independent baseline guard removes one Runtime Session and binding, after which exact release fails with runtime_session_conflict. The new guard preserves both while owed; exact release returns true after restart, and confirmation makes the family collectible.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested; MySQL server only |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, Node.js 22.22.3, JDK 21.0.8, Maven 3.9.14, disposable MySQL 8.4.11 in a local Linux VM. Each native case creates and drops its own schema. The internal SQL path uses test-script fallback because the CLI does not expose Runtime retention. Exact-main Core/CLI/bundle artifacts and frozen-lock dependencies are prepared for the full Java module checks.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: unconfirmed debts intentionally retain the complete original binding family without expiry. Legacy unverified heads also retain their families rather than backfilling incomplete history. Existing placement serialization and binding lock order are preserved; the journal never takes a binding lock while holding its head.
- Not validated / out of scope: MariaDB qualification, the real Hosted crash between turn settlement and cleanup confirmation, complete client recovery without turn_blocked, deployment acceptance and enabling retention. Retention remains disabled by default. Two historical MySQL upgrade fixtures also fail on unchanged main and are recorded separately from the passing fresh-schema probes. Local full-module checks pass; independent source review found and fixed the CSI catalogue mismatch and has no remaining confirmed correctness finding. This partial delivery still requires the stated Hosted/cross-engine acceptance before #13992 is complete.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: additive V13 migration, strict catalog projections and 32-table parity are updated together. Existing heads receive unknown coverage. Upgrade all Java catalog readers and writers together; a pre-V13 binary is not a compatible rollback. Follow the existing new-database cutover policy: quiesce old admissions, settle in-flight work and retain the old environment for history. V12 frozen/cut/drained CSI inventories cannot resume under V13; the native upgrade fixture does not qualify in-flight CSI operation replay or an in-place production migration. No public API, descriptor, release route or default switch changes.

The [English design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/13992-cleanup-debt/docs/design/2026-10-20-hosted-cleanup-retention.md) and [Chinese design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/13992-cleanup-debt/docs/design/2026-10-20-hosted-cleanup-retention.zh-CN.md) describe the same decisions, constraints, lifetime and acceptance criteria.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13992 and #12380. No closing keyword: cross-engine and Hosted acceptance remain outstanding.

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

Binding 已释放后，仍可能欠 cleanup 确认，却因过龄被删除。此时重放原释放会从 released=true 变成 runtime_session_conflict，使恢复无法确认欠账。保留原 owner 避免为成功 marker 设置任意有效期，并保留缺失、外来身份及不匹配 owner 的全部拒绝检查。

### How to verify

独立 H2 与 MySQL 8.4 探针已复现基线失败并验证修复，全新 JVM 的 MySQL 探针也成功。六个 cleanup 用例在两种引擎均通过；已有 retention guard 测试通过 16 项，schema 一致性通过 24 项，V13 配置与升级覆盖通过六项 H2 测试；新增回收顺序用例在两种引擎通过。原生 V12 到 V13 的普通 head/reference 保留用例也通过。下游 CSI 退役清单已同步两个新增字段，63 项 H2 测试和一项 MySQL 清单回归通过。最终未过滤的 mvn verify 通过 4,967 项，零失败、零错误，18 项既有跳过；两道 Checkstyle 和 SpotBugs 均通过。

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — 服务端持久化与留存行为，没有 UI 变化。独立基线 guard 删除一条 Runtime Session 和一条 binding 后，精确释放返回 runtime_session_conflict；新 guard 在 owed 期间保留二者，重启后精确释放仍返回 true，确认后家族才可回收。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ 未测试；仅 MySQL 服务端 |

macOS arm64、Node.js 22.22.3、JDK 21.0.8、Maven 3.9.14，以及本地 Linux 虚拟机中的一次性 MySQL 8.4.11。每个原生用例创建并删除自有 schema。CLI 不暴露 Runtime retention，因此使用测试脚本降级验证内部 SQL 路径。完整 Java 模块检查已准备与 main 源码一致的 Core/CLI/打包产物及冻结锁文件依赖。

- 主要风险或取舍：未确认欠账会有意保留完整的原 binding 家族且不设过期时间。旧的未验证 head 也保留家族，不根据不完整历史回填。保持已有 placement 串行化和 binding 锁顺序；journal 不在持有 head 时获取 binding 锁。

prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the existing `updatedInput` hook integration suite to ordinary pull requests' no-API-key test selection and its exact-list regression contract. The change is two added entries.

## Why it's needed

The suite existed but was omitted from ordinary PR checks, so hook input-rewrite regressions could escape that coverage.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm ordinary PR test discovery includes the existing hook input-rewrite suite and that removing its selection entry fails the wiring contract. After a fresh build, run its six integration cases and confirm their existing behavioral expectations still hold.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Refreshed native Vitest discovery selects **32 files without the target** using the new base selection and **33 files including the target** with this change. Only the target suite is added; none is removed. The new mainline daemon ancestor trust entry is preserved. These counts replace the earlier 31 → 32 result.

Historical pre-fix reproduction on the earlier base reported **1 failed, 13 skipped**; that negative check was not rerun on the new base. The refreshed complete contract suite reports **12 passed, 2 Linux-only skips**. Formatting, lint, diff checks, exact-patch secret scanning, and the full two-entry diff audit passed.

All **six existing integration cases passed in 26.12 seconds**: headless replacement read, denied replacement command, rejection of non-object input, nested execution, interactive ask/write, and ACP ask/write. They used a fake local OpenAI server without a real API key. The unchanged suite ran against the freshly built Unicode-fix worktree on the earlier `628ab5c1afb3a7b4d67552377b0b77b658be1e04` base. These six cases were not rerun after rebasing onto `de20ab6a306034e37d776361852e18ecc4aba204`; refreshed discovery and wiring checks cover the selection change.

Local CI review-engine rehearsal did not complete within the bounded run; no final verdict is claimed.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Refreshed discovery and wiring checks on the new base; six integration cases passed earlier on the old base |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not run locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not run locally; two Linux-only contract cases skipped on macOS |

### Environment (optional)

Local macOS candidate `35e2a52be6269b6500b4a5077bcd3eaf9986a9a2`, rebased onto `de20ab6a306034e37d776361852e18ecc4aba204`; refreshed native Vitest discovery and workflow wiring contracts. Exact `git diff origin/main HEAD` SHA-256: `9c652cab21e287e9d22152ed334076de2c83a8948788d939277307a786ad9e5e`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: ordinary PR checks now include one additional existing suite and its runtime cost.
- Not validated / out of scope: build, typecheck, the six integration cases, and the remaining allowlist suites were not rerun during this rebase-only verification; local review-engine verification remains incomplete and the engine was not rerun.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no hook behavior changes.

## Linked Issues

Closes #13860.

prs.title: fix(acp): avoid splitting surrogate pairs when truncating turn text
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keeps the 32,768 UTF-16 code-unit limit without splitting a valid astral character. Both existing truncation paths back off one code unit when a surrogate pair crosses the boundary, covering ACP live and terminal prompt status plus recorded prompts and results. Truncation flags and result codes keep their existing meaning.

## Why it's needed

#14510 fixed sanitization, but subsequent truncation can still create a lone surrogate from valid input. This closes the remaining truncation gap in #13913.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Check four boundaries: BMP overflow, a surrogate pair crossing the cap, a pair ending exactly at the cap, and a complete pair before overflow. Confirm the exact text and truncation flags for both live and completed prompt status and for recorded prompts and results. A crossing pair should be omitted whole; a pair that fits should remain intact.

### Evidence (Before & After)

For `"x".repeat(32767) + "🙂y"`, the previous truncation produces 32,768 code units ending in lone `\uD83D`; the candidate produces the complete 32,767-character `x` prefix. This is string-boundary evidence, not HTTP or live-provider evidence.

Against unfixed production, each expanded target test reports **1 failed, 3 passed**: only the crossing-pair case fails. The cases exercise package integration with mocked channel/model behavior. Changed production lint and formatting passed.

The default 4 GB build exhausted memory; the full build using the same entry with an 8 GB heap passed, as did root typecheck with an 8 GB heap and bundling. The complete bridge test file passed **1,019 tests in 25.77 seconds**, and the complete Session test file passed **1,248 tests in 209.79 seconds**.

The two complete target files passed **2,267 tests** in total.

Local CI review-engine rehearsal did not complete within the bounded run; no final verdict is claimed.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Local boundary regressions, production lint/format, full build, typecheck, bundle, and all 2,267 tests across both complete target files |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not run locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not run locally |

### Environment (optional)

Local macOS worktree based on `628ab5c1afb3a7b4d67552377b0b77b658be1e04`; mocked channel/model package integration.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a crossing pair leaves the output one code unit below the cap so the prefix remains valid.
- Not validated / out of scope: HTTP and live-provider E2E; local review-engine verification is incomplete as described above.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; the cap and truncation indicators are unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Closes #13913. Related: #14510.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

保留 32,768 个 UTF-16 代码单元的上限，同时避免拆开有效的补充平面字符。两个现有截断路径都会在代理对跨越边界时回退一个代码单元，覆盖 ACP 实时和终态的提示词状态，以及记录的提示词和结果。截断标志和结果码保持原有含义。

## 为什么需要

#14510 修复了文本清理，但后续截断仍可能把有效输入变成含有孤立代理项的文本。这次补齐 #13913 中剩余的截断问题。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

检查四种边界：BMP 文本超长、代理对跨越上限、代理对恰好在上限结束，以及完整代理对后还有超长文本。确认实时和已完成的提示词状态、记录的提示词和结果，其文本内容及截断标志都符合预期。跨越边界的代理对应被整体舍弃；能够完整容纳的代理对应保持完整。

### 证据（修改前后）

对于 `"x".repeat(32767) + "🙂y"`，原有截断会产生 32,768 个代码单元，并以孤立的 `\uD83D` 结尾；候选改动产生完整的 32,767 个 `x` 字符前缀。这是字符串边界证据，不是 HTTP 或真实模型服务的验证证据。

使用未修复的生产代码时，两个扩展后的目标测试各得到 **1 项失败、3 项通过**，仅跨边界代理对这一项失败。这些用例通过模拟通道和模型行为验证包内集成。修改的生产代码已通过 lint 和格式检查。

默认 4 GB 堆内存的构建因内存不足而失败；相同入口使用 8 GB 堆内存的完整构建已通过，根目录使用 8 GB 堆内存的类型检查及打包也已通过。完整桥接测试文件在 **25.77 秒内通过 1,019 项测试**，完整 Session 测试文件在 **209.79 秒内通过 1,248 项测试**。

两个完整目标文件合计通过 **2,267 项测试**。

本地 CI 评审引擎演练未在限定运行内完成，不声明最终评审结论。

### 本地测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已在本地运行边界回归、生产代码 lint/格式检查、完整构建、类型检查、打包，并通过两个完整目标文件的全部 2,267 项测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地运行 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地运行 |

### 环境（可选）

本地 macOS 工作树，基于 `628ab5c1afb3a7b4d67552377b0b77b658be1e04`；使用模拟通道和模型的包内集成测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：代理对跨边界时，输出比上限少一个代码单元，以保持前缀有效。
- 未验证或范围之外：HTTP 和真实模型服务 E2E；本地评审引擎验证未完成，详见上文。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无；上限和截断标识保持不变。

## 关联问题

Closes #13913。相关：#14510。

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): allow fault gates to outlive the Surefire fork timeout
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Raises the Runtime Broker fault-gate step timeout from 10 to 20 minutes so the 600-second Surefire fork has time for compilation and report teardown. The enclosing job timeout stays coupled to the summed step ceilings plus the 13-minute setup allowance; on current main the sum is 251 minutes, so the job timeout is 264 minutes.

The existing timeout contract now covers all four Maven-fork steps in the job, including fault gates and admission gates, and derives each step's minimum budget from its configured fork timeout plus a 600-second allowance.

## Why it's needed

The previous step limit equaled the fork timeout, leaving no room for work around the test process. The workflow could kill the step before the fork completed and reports were collected.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm the fault-gate step can outlive the configured fork by at least 600 seconds, and the enclosing job still covers all capped steps plus 13 minutes for setup. Reducing the step back to 10 minutes should fail the timeout contract. A future Actions run should confirm the fault gates can finish and report within the new budget.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI evidence. With the previous timeout, the targeted contract check reports **1 failed, 62 skipped**. With the candidate, all nine workflow meta-test files report **498 passed, 10 skipped**. prs.title: fix(hosted): bind execution to the final hook input
prs.body:
## What this PR does

In Hosted sessions that run tools in a remote Workspace, each tool call now goes through its Hooks in the order the Hooks documentation describes, and only the input that comes out of that order is approved and run. PreToolUse runs once on the model's input A. An object it returns, B, replaces the whole input and passes the same admission checks as any tool input (arguments, Workspace paths, profile and plan-mode limits, mount ownership). Where the approval mode asks about the call, PermissionRequest then runs once on B; only its allow can replace the input again, with C, which is admitted again. The owner is asked at most once, after the last replacement, and sees exactly the input that will run: the Action, the saved tool input, the Runtime intent and reservation, the publication binding and the child-agent launch all use that final input. When nothing needs a question, nothing is asked.

The decisions keep their current meaning. A PreToolUse stop, block or deny refuses the call before PermissionRequest runs, and its replacement is never used; a PreToolUse replacement that is not a JSON object is still ignored. A PermissionRequest stop, block or deny refuses the call and keeps B; an allow with a replacement that is not a JSON object now refuses the call instead of running B; an updatedInput without an allow is ignored. A PreToolUse ask still requires the owner even when PermissionRequest allows, a PreToolUse allow still does not skip the approval mode, and which calls fire PermissionRequest is unchanged. A replacement that fails admission refuses its call; an earlier input never runs in its place. Every call is admitted again after its last Hook even when no Hook changed it, because a Hook can take the Workspace mount (a foreground child agent is then refused as before). A Hook replacement too large for the Session Store refuses its call instead of leaving the turn in recovery, and a Hook that turns a call into a background Shell now gets the Session's background lane. A batch that fails admission on the model's own input is still refused before any Hook runs.

The PreToolUse and PermissionRequest records of a call in this order carry a marker in their saved plan. Recovery reads them by that marker: the PreToolUse record must prove the model's input, the PermissionRequest record must prove the input PreToolUse left, and PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure and PostToolBatch are reported with the last valid input. Records without the marker are read exactly as before (PermissionRequest first), so turns saved by the previous release resume unchanged. Unknown markers, mixed old and new records, or records that do not prove their input stop recovery instead of guessing.

## Why it's needed

Hosted ran PermissionRequest on the model's input, asked the owner, and only then ran PreToolUse. A PreToolUse replacement triggered a second question, so the owner could approve an input that never ran, PermissionRequest never saw what PreToolUse produced, and a PermissionRequest replacement was overwritten by the later PreToolUse. On the real Hosted chain, with PreToolUse replacing A by B and PermissionRequest abstaining, the base asked twice (about A, then about B); with PermissionRequest allowing C, it ran PreToolUse on C, ran B, and asked about B although the Hook had allowed C. The reader that rebuilds a call's input for after Hooks and recovery also assumed the old order, so changing the order alone would have misread the new records.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- In a Hosted session in `default` approval mode with PreToolUse and PermissionRequest Hooks, let PreToolUse replace a write A with B and let PermissionRequest return nothing. Expect PreToolUse to see A, PermissionRequest to see B, exactly one Action that shows B, and the write to run once with B. Before this change there were two Actions, the first about A.
- Let PermissionRequest instead allow with replacement C. Expect no Action and the write to run with C; PostToolUse and PostToolBatch report C.
- Make PreToolUse also answer `ask`. Expect one Action that shows C, even though PermissionRequest allowed.
- Let PreToolUse deny with a replacement: PermissionRequest does not run, nothing is asked or run, and PostToolBatch reports A. Let PermissionRequest deny with C, or allow with a non-object, or allow with a C outside the Workspace: the call is refused, B never runs, and PostToolBatch reports B (or the refused C for the admission failure).
- Kill the Harness after the PostToolBatch record is saved, both on the base (earlier order) and on this branch, and load the Session on this branch: the turn completes, no tool Hook runs again, no tool runs again, the Batch context appears once, and a second load runs nothing.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI. Real Hosted run: packaged Harness, the managed agent server's embedded Runtime Broker and worker, H2-backed SQL Session Store, loopback HTTP Hooks, a controlled model. Base `f8b3031f73` vs this branch `eb24417438` (bundle built from the clean commit). Tool executions were counted in `ma_tool_execution`.

| Scenario | Base | This branch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PreToolUse A→B, PermissionRequest abstains | Permission(A), Pre(A); Actions about A then B; runs B | Pre(A), Permission(B); one Action about B; runs B |
| PreToolUse A→B, PermissionRequest allows C | Permission(A), Pre(C); one Action about B; runs B | Pre(A), Permission(B); no Action; runs C |
| PreToolUse ask + B, PermissionRequest allows C | — | one Action about C; runs C once |
| PreToolUse deny + B (batch with a read) | — | no PermissionRequest, no Action; only the read runs; Batch reports A |
| PermissionRequest deny + C (batch with a read) | — | refused; only the read runs; Batch reports B |
| PermissionRequest allows C outside the Workspace | — | refused; B never runs; no file escapes; Batch reports the refused C |
| Base saves records (full, and a digest-only PreToolUse plan), SIGKILL after the Batch, load on this branch | — | turn completes; 0 tool Hooks and 0 tool starts on resume; context once; second load runs nothing |
| This branch saves Pre(A)→B, Permission(B)→C, SIGKILL after the Batch, load again | — | same: C ran once (2 executions incl. the read); nothing reruns |
| SIGKILL once the PermissionRequest decision is saved, or while the final Action waits | — | Session stays recovery-blocked; no Hook reruns; 0 executions |
| This branch's records loaded on the base Harness (downgrade probe) | `turn_error` from "Hook occurrence input conflict"; nothing reruns | — |

Unit tests cover each decision and input shape, the approval-mode matrix, admission after each Hook, mount and child-agent admission, the background lane, MCP grant renewal, earlier-order records (full and oversized), new-order records (full and oversized), and unknown, mixed or unproven records. Each key rule was reverted once to confirm a test fails. The 26 Hosted suites that depend on the changed modules pass (1894 tests; 4 skipped for missing cgroup delegation).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux, Node 24.21.0, JDK 21, Maven 3.9.16. The real Hosted run used the existing Hosted integration harness with a local driver and test method that are not part of this PR. The integration-test typecheck ran with a 4 GiB Node heap, because the default heap ran out of memory on this machine; the workspace typechecks ran with the default.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Sessions that saved records in the new order must stay on a Harness that has this reader. The previous release ignores the marker, so loading such a Session on it is not supported; in the probe it ended the turn with an input conflict. Rolling back the binary is safe for Sessions that never ran a Hook turn on this release.
- Not validated / out of scope: a turn interrupted before its tool results are saved still needs recovery as before (it is not resumed automatically); core, headless, ACP, legacy Managed and private CSI paths are unchanged; MySQL, cgroup command isolation, macOS and Windows were not run locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for saved data; earlier records are read as they are and never rewritten. Behavior changes for Hosted Hook turns: one approval after the Hooks instead of up to two, PermissionRequest sees the PreToolUse result, a PermissionRequest allow with a non-object replacement refuses the call, and a batch that fails admission on the model's input no longer runs PermissionRequest.

## Linked Issues

None. Builds on #14650 (its reader is kept for records saved by earlier releases). Related, independent: #13398 (PreToolUse input on the core and ACP path).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在远端 Workspace 运行工具的 Hosted 会话中，每个工具调用现在按 Hooks 文档描述的顺序经过 Hook，只有按此顺序得到的输入才会被审批和执行。PreToolUse 在模型输入 A 上运行一次。它返回的对象 B 整体替换输入，并经过与任何工具输入相同的准入检查（参数、Workspace 路径、profile 与 plan mode 限制、mount 归属）。在审批模式会询问该调用时，PermissionRequest 随后在 B 上运行一次；只有它的 allow 可以再次以 C 替换输入，C 会再次准入。所有者最多被询问一次，且在最后一次替换之后，看到的正是将要运行的输入：Action、保存的工具输入、Runtime intent 与预留、publication 绑定以及 child agent 启动都使用这个最终输入。不需要询问时不会询问。

各决策保持现有含义。PreToolUse 的 stop、block 或 deny 在 PermissionRequest 运行前拒绝调用，其替换永不采用；PreToolUse 非 JSON 对象的替换仍被忽略。PermissionRequest 的 stop、block 或 deny 拒绝调用并保留 B；带非 JSON 对象替换的 allow 现在会拒绝调用，而不是运行 B；没有 allow 的 updatedInput 被忽略。PreToolUse ask 即使 PermissionRequest allow 仍需所有者确认，PreToolUse allow 仍不跳过审批模式，哪些调用触发 PermissionRequest 不变。准入失败的替换会拒绝其调用，更早的输入绝不会代替它运行。每个调用在最后一个 Hook 之后都会再次准入，即使没有 Hook 改动它，因为 Hook 可能取得 Workspace mount（此时前台 child agent 照旧被拒绝）。超过 Session Store 限制的 Hook 替换会拒绝其调用，而不是让 Turn 进入恢复；把调用变成后台 Shell 的 Hook 现在会得到 Session 的后台通道。模型自身输入未通过准入的批次，仍在任何 Hook 运行前被拒绝。

按此顺序运行的调用，其 PreToolUse 和 PermissionRequest 记录在保存的计划中带有标记。恢复按该标记读取：PreToolUse 记录必须证明模型输入，PermissionRequest 记录必须证明 PreToolUse 留下的输入，PostToolUse、PostToolUseFailure 和 PostToolBatch 报告最后的有效输入。没有标记的记录完全按以前的方式（PermissionRequest 在先）读取，因此上一版本保存的 Turn 照旧恢复。未知标记、新旧记录混合或不能证明其输入的记录会停止恢复，而不是猜测。

## 为什么需要

Hosted 原先在模型输入上运行 PermissionRequest、询问所有者，之后才运行 PreToolUse。PreToolUse 的替换会触发第二次询问，所有者可能批准了一个从未运行的输入；PermissionRequest 看不到 PreToolUse 的结果，PermissionRequest 的替换又会被之后的 PreToolUse 覆盖。在真实 Hosted 链路上，当 PreToolUse 把 A 换成 B 且 PermissionRequest 不表态时，基线问了两次（先 A 后 B）；当 PermissionRequest 以 C 允许时，基线在 C 上运行 PreToolUse、执行了 B，并就 B 询问，尽管 Hook 允许的是 C。为后置 Hook 和恢复重建调用输入的 reader 也假设旧顺序，所以只改顺序会误读新记录。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 在 `default` 审批模式、带 PreToolUse 和 PermissionRequest Hook 的 Hosted 会话中，让 PreToolUse 把写入 A 换成 B，PermissionRequest 不返回任何内容。预期 PreToolUse 看到 A，PermissionRequest 看到 B，只有一个显示 B 的 Action，写入以 B 运行一次。修改前有两个 Action，第一个关于 A。
- 改为让 PermissionRequest 以替换 C 允许。预期没有 Action，写入以 C 运行；PostToolUse 和 PostToolBatch 报告 C。
- 让 PreToolUse 同时回答 `ask`。预期即使 PermissionRequest 允许，仍有一个显示 C 的 Action。
- 让 PreToolUse 连同替换一起 deny：PermissionRequest 不运行，不询问也不执行，PostToolBatch 报告 A。让 PermissionRequest 带 C deny，或带非对象 allow，或允许一个 Workspace 之外的 C：调用被拒绝，B 从不运行，PostToolBatch 报告 B（准入失败时报告被拒绝的 C）。
- 在 PostToolBatch 记录保存后杀掉 Harness（分别在基线即旧顺序、以及本分支上），再用本分支加载 Session：Turn 完成，工具 Hook 不再运行，工具不再运行，Batch context 只出现一次，第二次加载不运行任何东西。

### 证据（修改前后）

UI 不适用。真实 Hosted 运行：打包的 Harness、managed agent server 内嵌的 Runtime Broker 与 worker、H2 支撑的 SQL Session Store、回环 HTTP Hook、受控模型。基线 `f8b3031f73` 对比本分支 `eb24417438`（bundle 由干净提交构建）。工具执行数取自 `ma_tool_execution`。

| 场景 | 基线 | 本分支 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PreToolUse A→B，PermissionRequest 不表态 | Permission(A)、Pre(A)；先问 A 再问 B；运行 B | Pre(A)、Permission(B)；只问一次 B；运行 B |
| PreToolUse A→B，PermissionRequest 允许 C | Permission(A)、Pre(C)；问一次 B；运行 B | Pre(A)、Permission(B)；不询问；运行 C |
| PreToolUse ask + B，PermissionRequest 允许 C | — | 一个关于 C 的 Action；C 运行一次 |
| PreToolUse deny + B（批次含一个 read） | — | 无 PermissionRequest、无 Action；只运行 read；Batch 报告 A |
| PermissionRequest deny + C（批次含一个 read） | — | 拒绝；只运行 read；Batch 报告 B |
| PermissionRequest 允许 Workspace 之外的 C | — | 拒绝；B 从不运行；没有文件逃逸；Batch 报告被拒绝的 C |
| 基线保存记录（完整、以及只留摘要的 PreToolUse 计划），Batch 后 SIGKILL，用本分支加载 | — | Turn 完成；恢复时 0 次工具 Hook、0 次工具启动；context 一次；第二次加载不运行任何东西 |
| 本分支保存 Pre(A)→B、Permission(B)→C，Batch 后 SIGKILL，再加载 | — | 同上：C 只运行一次（含 read 共 2 次执行）；无任何重跑 |
| PermissionRequest 决策保存后、或最终 Action 等待时 SIGKILL | — | Session 保持 recovery-blocked；不重跑 Hook；0 次执行 |
| 本分支记录由基线 Harness 加载（降级探针） | "Hook occurrence input conflict" 导致 `turn_error`；无重跑 | — |

单元测试覆盖每种决策与输入形状、审批模式矩阵、每个 Hook 之后的准入、mount 与 child agent 准入、后台通道、MCP grant 续期、旧顺序记录（完整与超限）、新顺序记录（完整与超限），以及未知、混合或不能证明输入的记录。每条关键规则都单独回退过一次，确认有测试失败。依赖改动模块的 26 个 Hosted 测试文件全部通过（1894 个测试；4 个因缺少 cgroup 委派而跳过）。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

Linux、Node 24.21.0、JDK 21、Maven 3.9.16。真实 Hosted 运行使用现有的 Hosted 集成测试框架，以及不属于本 PR 的本地 driver 和测试方法。integration-test 类型检查在 4 GiB Node 堆下运行，因为默认堆在本机内存不足；各 workspace 的类型检查使用默认设置。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：已按新顺序保存记录的 Session 必须留在具备此 reader 的 Harness 上。上一版本会忽略该标记，因此不支持在上一版本上加载这类 Session；探针中它以输入冲突结束了 Turn。对于从未在本版本上运行过 Hook Turn 的 Session，回滚二进制是安全的。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：工具结果保存前就被中断的 Turn 仍像以前一样需要恢复（不会自动继续）；core、headless、ACP、legacy Managed 和私有 CSI 路径不变；未在本地运行 MySQL、cgroup 命令隔离、macOS 和 Windows。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：已保存数据无变更；旧记录按原样读取，从不改写。Hosted Hook Turn 的行为变化：Hook 之后至多一次审批（原先最多两次）、PermissionRequest 看到 PreToolUse 的结果、带非对象替换的 PermissionRequest allow 会拒绝调用、模型输入未通过准入的批次不再运行 PermissionRequest。

## 关联 Issue

无。基于 #14650（为早先版本保存的记录保留其 reader）。相关但独立：#13398（core 与 ACP 路径上的 PreToolUse 输入）。

auto_merge.commit_title: fix(hosted): bind execution to the final hook input (#14708)
auto_merge.commit_message:
Run PreToolUse once on the model's input and admit the input it leaves;
then, where the approval mode asks, run PermissionRequest once on that
input, where only an allow may replace it again, and admit the result.
Ask the owner at most once, after the last replacement, so the Action,
the saved input, the Runtime binding and the child launch all use the
input that runs. A PermissionRequest allow with a replacement that is
not an object now refuses the call instead of running the earlier input.

Save the new order on the PreToolUse and PermissionRequest plans and
read each call's records by it: the new order must prove each Hook's
input, while untagged records keep the earlier PermissionRequest-first
reading, so turns saved by earlier releases resume unchanged.

prs.title: fix(core): keep a producer-declared truncation bit when raw size is unknown
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Tool results now carry an explicit truncation bit from the producer that bounded its own output, and both the scheduler and the shared converter (ACP, speculation) report it instead of inferring truncation solely from a raw-vs-processed size comparison. The raw size stays unknown for these producers, as the design says it must.

## Why it's needed

Self-bounded producers (grep, ripGrep, read_file paging, read_mcp_resource, shell capture) declare the raw size unknown because the pre-reduction size is unrecoverable. The size accounting then folded that declaration into `rawSize === undefined` and derived `truncated` from raw vs processed, so the truncation bit was lost on exactly the tools that cut most often — the opposite of what a truncation signal is for. The design promises that each shortening layer is accounted for; this makes that promise hold for producers that shorten in place.

## Reviewer Test Plan

A reviewer can confirm the change from the added assertions alone; no user-visible behavior changes.

### How to verify

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): treat hosted_turn_active as a lifecycle wait (#14492)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A close operation that reaches the Hosted Harness while it is still draining the previous turn now waits for that work instead of being published as a permanent `recovery_blocked` operation. The daemon's busy lifecycle refusal (`hosted_turn_active`) joins its recovery refusal (`hosted_lifecycle_recovery_required`) in the coordinator's self-clearing wait set: each attempt is budget-exempt, and past the retry budget the wait is published with the daemon's own code while the recovery scan keeps re-driving it.

## Why it's needed

Main CI failed in `HostedExtensionsIT.publishedExtensionsSurviveHarnessReplacementCancellationAndCloseOnMySql`: the test closed the Session, expected the close operation to reach `completed`, and instead observed `recovery_blocked` for its whole 40-second window. The daemon returns `409 hosted_turn_active` whenever a turn, MCP call or hook is still settling; that condition clears on its own, but the coordinator classified the refusal as a permanent hook failure, published the close as blocked with a charged attempt, and the lifecycle store then refused the row on every later attempt. A close that only had to wait for the daemon was stranded, which is the same failure class the earlier recovery-refusal fix addressed for `hosted_lifecycle_recovery_required`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the focused coordinator test from `packages/managed-agent-server` with `mvn -Dtest=OperationRetryTerminalStateTest test`. It covers both daemon refusal codes, direct and wrapped in the SDK's unknown-outcome exception, below and past the retry budget. Expect 81 tests to pass and, for each code, a budget-exempt retry below the budget and a budget-exempt `recovery_blocked` publication carrying that same code past it. The new arms fail if `hosted_turn_active` is removed from the wait set.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible or TUI change. Before this change, a close that received `hosted_turn_active` was published as `recovery_blocked` with `workspace_lifecycle_hooks_unsettled` and a charged attempt. After it, the close is re-driven budget-exempt and, past the budget, reports `hosted_turn_active` itself.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Java 21 / Maven for the module suite and Node 22 for the root build, typecheck, lint and the WebShell generated-API test, in the CI sandbox.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a daemon that never clears its busy state now keeps the close waiting and visible as `recovery_blocked` with `hosted_turn_active`, instead of failing it. That matches the existing semantics for a live journal writer, a stale Harness generation, and the daemon's recovery refusal.
- Not validated / out of scope: the exact `HostedExtensionsIT` run needs a delegated cgroup v2 subtree, the bundled CLI and MySQL 8.4, which this sandbox does not provide. The module suite's three errors are the sandbox's missing `/etc/machine-id` in untouched runtime-broker tests. No schema or route changes.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The OpenAPI contract advances to v1.72 and the generated WebShell types are regenerated.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14492

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的作用

当 Hosted Harness 仍在收尾上一轮对话时到达的关闭操作，现在会等待该工作完成，而不是被发布为永久的 `recovery_blocked` 操作。daemon 的繁忙生命周期拒绝（`hosted_turn_active`）与其恢复拒绝（`hosted_lifecycle_recovery_required`）一起进入协调器的自行清除等待集合：每次尝试都不计入重试预算，超出预算后以 daemon 自己的错误码发布等待，恢复扫描仍会持续重新驱动它。

## 为什么需要

主分支 CI 在 `HostedExtensionsIT.publishedExtensionsSurviveHarnessReplacementCancellationAndCloseOnMySql` 中失败：测试关闭 Session，期望关闭操作进入 `completed`，却在整整 40 秒窗口内观察到 `recovery_blocked`。当一轮对话、MCP 调用或 Hook 仍在收尾时，daemon 会返回 `409 hosted_turn_active`；该状态会自行清除，但协调器把该拒绝当成永久 Hook 失败，把关闭发布为阻塞并消耗一次尝试，随后生命周期存储在之后每次尝试中都拒绝该记录。一个只需等待 daemon 的关闭因此被搁死；这与更早的恢复拒绝修复针对 `hosted_lifecycle_recovery_required` 所处理的失败属于同一类。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在 `packages/managed-agent-server` 下运行聚焦的协调器测试：`mvn -Dtest=OperationRetryTerminalStateTest test`。它覆盖两种 daemon 拒绝码，既覆盖直接抛出，也覆盖被 SDK 未知结果异常包装；既覆盖预算内，也覆盖超出预算。预期 81 个用例通过；对每种错误码，在预算内应进行不计预算的重试，超出预算后应发布携带同一错误码且不计预算的 `recovery_blocked`。如果从等待集合中移除 `hosted_turn_active`，新增用例会失败。

### 证据（修复前后）

N/A — 没有用户可见或 TUI 变化。修复前，收到 `hosted_turn_active` 的关闭会以 `workspace_lifecycle_hooks_unsettled` 发布为 `recovery_blocked` 并消耗一次尝试。修复后，关闭会不计预算地重新驱动，超出预算后报告 `hosted_turn_active` 本身。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境

在 CI 沙箱中使用 Java 21 / Maven 运行模块测试，使用 Node 22 运行根构建、类型检查、Lint 和 WebShell 生成 API 测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：如果 daemon 永远不清除其繁忙状态，关闭现在会继续等待并以 `hosted_turn_active` 显示为 `recovery_blocked`，而不是直接失败。这与活跃日志写入者、过期 Harness 代次以及 daemon 恢复拒绝的既有语义一致。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：精确的 `HostedExtensionsIT` 运行需要被委派的 cgroup v2 子树、打包后的 CLI 和 MySQL 8.4，本沙箱不提供这些条件。模块测试的三个错误是沙箱缺少 `/etc/machine-id` 导致的、位于未改动过的 runtime-broker 测试中。没有 schema 或路由变更。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。OpenAPI 契约升至 v1.72，并重新生成了 WebShell 类型。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #14492

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): Preview collapsed Home content on hover
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Hovering Home while the sidebar is collapsed opens the complete Home content in a popover to its right, with a thin outline and an 8 px gap from the rail. When the sidebar is expanded, Home keeps its existing text tooltip. The preview shares the current search and session controls while leaving the selected page, collapse preference, and composer draft intact.

## Why it's needed

The collapsed rail currently shows only a Home label, so users must expand the sidebar to reach projects and sessions. A temporary Home preview makes that content accessible without permanently taking space from the conversation.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Collapse the sidebar and hover Home. Confirm the popover includes branding, New task, projects and sessions, and any custom navigation and footer. It should sit 8 px from the rail with one thin outline and stay within the available viewport height.
- Move the pointer into the popover and use search or a session action menu. Focused search and open menus should remain usable; Escape and an outside click should dismiss the preview appropriately. Moving away without focusing a control should close it after the hover grace period.
- Open Channels, Live, or Plugins, collapse the sidebar, and hover Home. Confirm the preview shows Home content while the selected page remains unchanged. Clicking Home should still expand it; an unsent draft and the saved collapse preference should survive hovering.
- With the sidebar expanded, hover Home and confirm only its text tooltip appears. Check the existing compact drawer, Home-only host layout, and split-view navigation still work.

Local validation: 66 focused unit tests and all 9 Chromium navigation E2E tests passed on the final UI. Web Shell build/typecheck, formatting, and ESLint passed after the visual refinement. The earlier repository-wide build completed with a CLI-only retry using an 8 GiB Node heap after the default 4 GiB limit was exhausted; repository-wide typecheck and bundle also passed before the final two-line visual refinement. The built CLI version smoke check returned 0.25.3.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Actual Chromium screenshots, captured with a **mock daemon** and visually inspected. They demonstrate UI presentation and interaction only; they do not verify real daemon backend or Git operations. Images live on a separate asset branch in the fork, and every link is pinned to the same immutable asset commit; no images are included in the implementation branch.

prs.title: fix(core): preserve compressed context during recovery
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Treat restored compression context as a structural prefix rather than unfinished user input. A successful `/compress` with restored files or images no longer offers an unnecessary Continue action, and retry keeps that context while resubmitting the actual failed input.

Preserve the boundary across checkpoint reload, edit rollback, saved-request replay, and numeric fork/rewind selection. The compression prompt, summary/acknowledgment/attachment layout, provider conversion, and token-accounting formulas remain unchanged. Boundary metadata stays outside model request JSON. Review follow-up removes an import cycle and aligns the hosted persistence validator with the optional boundary metadata already emitted by the client, while extending existing regression cases.

## Why it's needed

Restored attachments are ordinary user-role history entries. Recovery could mistake them for an unanswered prompt, then strip them together with a genuinely failed request. Re-inferring the boundary after JSON serialization could also hide a real anonymous user turn that happened to look like a generated restoration block, including after `/compress-fast` saved another checkpoint.

The fix retains the known boundary and persists it alongside checkpoints. Older snapshots without the optional field remain readable, and invalid saved boundaries fall back to the existing detection rules.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Load or compress a session containing file/image context. Once compression has completed and no real request is unfinished, confirm that no interruption banner or Continue action appears and restored context remains available.
2. Make a real request fail, then Continue after the provider recovers. Confirm that the failure offers recovery, completion removes the recovery banner, and the file/image context is retained exactly once.
3. After a two-entry checkpoint, retain an anonymous real prompt whose text matches a full restoration block. Run `/compress-fast`, save and reload. Confirm that the real turn remains counted and selectable by rewind/numeric fork. Also check startup reminders and outstanding tool calls.
4. Confirm that ordinary model request JSON keeps the existing message structure and contains no boundary fields. Recovery intentionally differs from the old broken retry by retaining context that was previously dropped.

Local validation of the review fix passed: 2,938 related TypeScript tests, all seven previously affected Core test files, 22 Java recovery-validator tests, 23 actual TypeScript-to-Java contract cases, repository build/typecheck/bundle, and targeted lint/format checks. Eight deliberate regressions made the new assertions fail and were restored before the final green run. Eighteen deterministic actual send/checkpoint/retry comparisons preserve model request JSON and converted OpenAI/Anthropic messages. After preserving the latest main merges, all 2,938 related TypeScript tests and regular repository build/typecheck/bundle passed again at `26aa287d09`; all 23 cross-language cases and browser states were also repeated on this merged build. Full default Java verification is in progress; the E2E report records the final result. One hook process-start readiness timeout under concurrent build/load passed when its full file was rerun without changing its timeout or code.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: restored user-role context could be classified as an interrupted request or removed by retry cleanup. After: the screenshots below show the final merged Web Shell build (`26aa287d09`) loading a serialized synthetic compression checkpoint, a genuine failed browser request, and completion through its actual Continue button. They are final merged-build states, not baseline screenshots.

**Local mock only (2026-10-20):** isolated Codex in-app browser, real daemon and Web Shell, loopback fake OpenAI provider. The checkpoint was generated with the real composer from entirely synthetic data; this browser run did not ask a model to summarize. Screenshots were visually checked. prs.title: fix(permissions): AUTO destructive guard follows shell semantics and ask rules
prs.body:
## What this PR does

In AUTO mode, shell and monitor calls go through a deterministic destructive-command guard before the classifier. This PR changes how that guard decides and what can lift it. It adds no new kind of protected operation (hard reset, a checkout that discards the working tree, forced clean, stash drop, amend of a commit the agent did not make, and terraform/pulumi/cdk destroy), but it recognizes more spellings of them, such as `git checkout .`, `git checkout -f` or `git stash -q drop`. The design is written up in `docs/design/2026-10-18-auto-mode-destructive-guard.md` (with a Chinese version).

The guard now reads the command the way the shell runs it, using the bash parser that already backs the read-only shell check. For programs and syntax the guard understands, inert printed text, comments, quoted data, commit messages and data heredocs no longer trigger it unless another part of the call can execute that data. Git global options (`-C`, `-c`, `--git-dir`), option order and abbreviations, option values, `--`, command substitutions, `bash -c` / `sh -c` bodies, heredocs and here-strings fed to a shell, `eval`, and wrappers (`env`, `sudo`, `xargs`, `timeout`, `find -exec`, `npx`, …, followed at the position where they run their command, with `env -S`, `flock -c`, `su -c` and `watch` read as command lines) no longer hide a protected operation, while programs that only read their arguments, such as `grep` or `rg`, keep patterns and file names as data. When the guard cannot tell — the program or a deciding argument only exists at run time (an unquoted expansion that may split into several words, arguments `xargs` reads), the parser cannot read the command, or the command runs code the guard cannot read (a script file, a program a shell reads from a pipe or file, code handed to `python`, `node`, `perl`, `ruby`, `php` or `awk`, a git alias or setting) — it uses the existing denial path. Unknown deciding words are conservative; opaque code is blocked when the remaining text names a protected program and operation. If the parser fails entirely or nesting exceeds the limit, an operation word alone is sufficient. Comments and the names of already-checked Git/IaC operations are excluded from opaque-code evidence; their arguments remain because Git can print them into a shell. These fallbacks can reject harmless commands, as listed under Risk & Scope. That also covers a script the same command writes and then runs, however it is copied or invoked. The amend exemption is granted only when the directory whose HEAD is checked is provably the one the amend runs in: the call's directory plus any `git -C` chain. A `cd`, a repository variable, a wrapper or an unknown directory removes the exemption, and the host process directory is never used as a stand-in.

An explicit `permissions.ask` rule now reaches the manual confirmation it promises, also for a call the guard would block. That confirmation is human-only: a PermissionRequest hook allow cannot approve it, and where no human can answer (non-interactive runs, SDK hosts, background agents) the call is denied without being offered to the host. Ordinary ask rules keep their current behavior, including hook approval, and a matching deny rule still wins.

Words in the user's prompt no longer lift the guard. Previously "discard", "clean up", "wipe", "丢弃", "清除", "重置", or a tool name plus "destroy" anywhere in the last message unlocked it, including in negations such as "Do not discard my changes". The classifier still receives the full transcript; only the lexical exemption is gone. Block messages now name the operation and point at real manual paths — run it yourself, approve it outside AUTO mode, or add a matching ask rule — instead of telling the agent to get a keyword into the prompt.

## Why it's needed

The guard matched raw text. It blocked harmless commands such as `printf ok # git reset --hard` or a commit whose message mentions `git reset --hard`, while letting real destructive commands through as soon as anything sat between `git` and the subcommand: with the classifier answering allow, `git -C <repo> reset --hard`, `git -c … reset --hard`, `git clean -d -f`, `git commit -m msg --amend` and `terraform -chdir=infra destroy` all executed. Because it ran before the ask-rule check, a user's `permissions.ask` rule for such a command was never honored, contradicting the documented contract that ask rules force manual confirmation in AUTO mode. And its keyword exemption treated "Do not discard my changes" as permission to discard them.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Use AUTO mode with a model you can script (or a stub) whose classifier answers allow, in a throwaway repository with an uncommitted change and an untracked file.

- Ask for `git -C <repo> reset --hard`, `bash -c 'git -C <repo> reset --hard'`, `git clean -d -f` or `git commit -m msg --amend`: each is blocked before the classifier and nothing changes on disk.
- Ask for `echo 'git reset --hard' >> NOTES.md`, `printf ok # git reset --hard` or `git commit --allow-empty -m 'docs: explain git reset --hard'`: each reaches the classifier and runs.
- With a prompt such as "Do not discard my changes; just fix the bug.", `git reset --hard` is still blocked, and the message no longer mentions prompt wording.
- Add `permissions.ask: ["Bash(git reset *)"]` and ask for `git reset --hard`: the TUI shows the confirmation without an always-allow option; Allow runs it once, Esc runs nothing. With a PermissionRequest hook that answers allow, the confirmation is still shown. In stream-json SDK mode the call is denied and no `can_use_tool` request is sent. Adding the same rule to `permissions.deny` denies it outright.
- With `permissions.ask: ["Bash(git log *)"]` and the same hook, `git log` is still approved by the hook.

### Evidence (Before & After)

An end-to-end report with the exact commands, the scripted model and before/after tables follows in a comment.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux, Node 24.21.0, git 2.43.0; unit tests, the bundled CLI driven by a scripted OpenAI-compatible mock, stream-json and tmux.

## Risk & Scope

- Retained boundaries after review: specific literal checkout paths such as `git checkout -- ./src` remain classifier-eligible; the old raw-text match also blocked this spelling, so this is an intentional narrowing to whole-tree/force protection. Absolute repository-root pathspecs and `git clean` enabled by `clean.requireForce=false` remain preexisting gaps for a separate change. Unknown-program data such as a sed replacement or a gh PR title can still be rejected, and an unparseable `case` containing `npm run clean` can also be rejected. These usability limitations remain open; removing the fallbacks would re-enable verified trap, sed execution and nested dynamic-command bypasses.

- Main risk or tradeoff: the guard is stricter where it cannot tell. Commands that build a protected git or IaC command at run time (`git reset "$MODE"`, `git checkout "$BRANCH"`, `bash -c "git … $X"`) or that the parser cannot read (`case … esac` around a git command) are now blocked with a message asking for literal arguments, and so is a command that runs a script or interpreter code while its other text mentions a protected command (for example a Python one-liner that reads a file the same command wrote with `git reset --hard` in it). Removing the prompt-keyword exemption means a user who wants one of these operations in AUTO mode approves it explicitly (ask rule, Default mode, or running it themselves); the denial-cap escalation to a human-only prompt is unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows/PowerShell and macOS were not run locally; PowerShell and `cmd` bodies are read with the bash parser. Commands handed to a program the guard does not recognize as running them, such as a remote shell running an opaque remote script file, programs that run files of their own accord (`make`, package scripts, git hooks), what a git alias expands to, git's dashed per-command binaries (`git-reset`), text assembled or encoded at run time (string concatenation, base64), and a destructive command split across separate tool calls are left to the classifier, as are operations outside the existing list (`git stash clear`, `git restore .`, `terraform apply -destroy`, `pulumi down`); the last two are aliases of protected destroy commands and are candidates for a follow-up that extends the list. Pending-call re-evaluation, Code Mode and ACP use the same evaluator and are covered by unit tests only.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: prompt wording no longer unlocks the guard. In the core package, the destructive-command check is now asynchronous and no longer takes the user's prompt, and the helper that extracted the last user prompt is no longer exported; nothing else in the repository used either.

## Linked Issues

Builds on #13636 (human-only escalation of repeated guard denials) and #13442 (PreToolUse input revalidation), both unchanged here. Related: #7531 (an earlier attempt to widen the guard's patterns, closed). #12339 also edits the guard's call site in AUTO mode, so whichever lands second needs a small rebase; this PR does not depend on it or on the other open shell-parsing PRs.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

在 AUTO 模式下，shell 与 monitor 调用在分类器之前会经过一个确定性的破坏性命令守卫。本 PR 修改该守卫的判断方式以及能够解除它的途径。它没有新增受保护操作的种类（硬重置、丢弃工作区的 checkout、强制 clean、stash drop、对非本会话 agent 所建提交的 amend，以及 terraform/pulumi/cdk destroy），但能识别它们的更多写法，例如 `git checkout .`、`git checkout -f` 或 `git stash -q drop`。设计文档见 `docs/design/2026-10-18-auto-mode-destructive-guard.md`（附中文版）。

守卫现在按 shell 实际执行的方式读取命令，使用的是已经支撑只读 shell 检查的 bash 解析器。对于守卫能够理解的程序与语法，惰性的打印文本、注释、引号数据、提交信息和数据 heredoc 不再触发它，除非同一次调用的其他部分可能执行这些数据。Git 全局参数（`-C`、`-c`、`--git-dir`）、选项顺序与缩写、选项取值、`--`、命令替换、`bash -c` / `sh -c` 脚本体、喂给 shell 的 heredoc 与 here-string、`eval`，以及包装命令（`env`、`sudo`、`xargs`、`timeout`、`find -exec`、`npx` 等，只在它们真正运行命令的位置跟进，`env -S`、`flock -c`、`su -c` 和 `watch` 的命令行按脚本读取）都不再能隐藏受保护的操作；而 `grep`、`rg` 这类只读取参数的程序，其模式和文件名仍当作数据。当守卫无法判断时——程序或决定性参数只在运行时才存在（可能被拆成多个词的未加引号展开、`xargs` 读入的参数），解析器读不懂该命令，或命令运行了守卫读不到的代码（脚本文件、shell 从管道或文件读取的程序、交给 `python`、`node`、`perl`、`ruby`、`php` 或 `awk` 的代码、git 别名或配置）——它使用现有拒绝路径。决定性参数未知时采用保守判断；对于不透明代码，剩余文本同时提到受保护程序与操作时会拦截。若解析器完全失败或嵌套超过限制，只出现操作名也足以拦截。不透明代码的证据排除注释和已检查的 Git/IaC 操作名称，但保留可能被 Git 打印后送入 shell 的参数。这些回退会误拒绝某些无害命令，具体见风险与范围。这也涵盖同一条命令先写入再运行的脚本，无论它被如何复制或调用。amend 豁免只在被检查 HEAD 的目录可证明就是 amend 实际运行的目录时才给出：即调用目录加上任何 `git -C` 链。`cd`、仓库环境变量、包装命令或未知目录都会取消豁免，且绝不以宿主进程目录代替。

显式的 `permissions.ask` 规则现在能够进入它所承诺的人工确认，守卫本会拦截的调用也一样。该确认只能由人给出：PermissionRequest hook 的 allow 不能批准它；在没有人能应答的地方（非交互运行、SDK 宿主、后台 agent），调用会被拒绝，且不会被交给宿主。普通的 ask 规则保持现有行为（包括 hook 批准），匹配的 deny 规则依然优先。

用户提示词中的字词不再解除守卫。此前最后一条消息中任何位置出现 "discard"、"clean up"、"wipe"、"丢弃"、"清除"、"重置"，或工具名加 "destroy"，都会解锁守卫，包括 "Do not discard my changes" 这样的否定句。分类器仍然收到完整对话；只是去掉了这种词面豁免。拦截信息现在会写明被拦截的操作，并指向真实的人工途径——自己运行、在 AUTO 模式之外批准，或添加匹配的 ask 规则——而不是让 agent 设法把关键词放进提示词。

## 为什么需要

守卫原先匹配的是原始文本。它会拦截无害的命令，比如 `printf ok # git reset --hard`，或提交信息中提到 `git reset --hard` 的提交；而只要 `git` 与子命令之间多出任何内容，真正的破坏性命令就会放行：在分类器回答 allow 的情况下，`git -C <repo> reset --hard`、`git -c … reset --hard`、`git clean -d -f`、`git commit -m msg --amend` 和 `terraform -chdir=infra destroy` 都被执行了。由于它在 ask 规则检查之前运行，用户为这类命令设置的 `permissions.ask` 规则从未生效，与"ask 规则在 AUTO 模式下强制人工确认"的文档约定相矛盾。而它的关键词豁免会把 "Do not discard my changes" 当作丢弃修改的许可。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

使用 AUTO 模式，配合一个可以编排的模型（或桩），让其分类器回答 allow，并在一个含有未提交修改和未跟踪文件的临时仓库中进行。

- 请求 `git -C <repo> reset --hard`、`bash -c 'git -C <repo> reset --hard'`、`git clean -d -f` 或 `git commit -m msg --amend`：每一个都会在分类器之前被拦截，磁盘上没有任何变化。
- 请求 `echo 'git reset --hard' >> NOTES.md`、`printf ok # git reset --hard` 或 `git commit --allow-empty -m 'docs: explain git reset --hard'`：每一个都会到达分类器并运行。
- 使用 "Do not discard my changes; just fix the bug." 这样的提示词，`git reset --hard` 仍被拦截，且信息中不再提及提示词措辞。
- 添加 `permissions.ask: ["Bash(git reset *)"]` 并请求 `git reset --hard`：TUI 显示没有"始终允许"选项的确认；选择允许会运行一次，按 Esc 则什么都不运行。即使有一个回答 allow 的 PermissionRequest hook，确认仍然会显示。在 stream-json SDK 模式下该调用被拒绝，并且不会发送 `can_use_tool` 请求。把同一规则加入 `permissions.deny` 则会直接拒绝。
- 使用 `permissions.ask: ["Bash(git log *)"]` 和同样的 hook，`git log` 仍由 hook 批准。

### 证据（前后对比）

包含确切命令、编排模型和前后对比表的端到端报告将在评论中提供。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

Linux、Node 24.21.0、git 2.43.0；单元测试、由编排的 OpenAI 兼容 mock 驱动的打包 CLI、stream-json 与 tmux。

## 风险与范围

- 本轮核对后保留的边界：`git checkout -- ./src` 等具体字面路径仍交给分类器；旧的原始文本匹配也会拦截这种写法，因此这是有意收窄为整树/强制 checkout 保护。绝对仓库根路径，以及由 `clean.requireForce=false` 启用的不带 `-f` 的 clean，属于原先就存在的缺口，另行处理。未知程序的文本参数（例如 sed 替换文本、gh PR 标题）仍可能误拒绝，解析失败的 `case` 中出现 `npm run clean` 也可能误拒绝。这些易用性问题保留开放；直接删除回退会重新放过已验证的 trap、sed 执行脚本及嵌套动态命令。

- 主要风险或取舍：在无法判断时，守卫更严格。在运行时才构造受保护 git 或 IaC 命令的命令（`git reset "$MODE"`、`git checkout "$BRANCH"`、`bash -c "git … $X"`），或解析器无法读取的命令（包住 git 命令的 `case … esac`），现在会被拦截，并提示改用字面参数；运行脚本或解释器代码、而其余文本又提到受保护命令的命令也是如此（例如一个 Python 单行程序读取同一条命令写入的、内容含 `git reset --hard` 的文件）。移除提示词关键词豁免后，想在 AUTO 模式下执行这些操作的用户需要显式批准（ask 规则、Default 模式或自己运行）；拒绝次数上限升级为仅限人工的确认这一行为保持不变。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：本地未运行 Windows/PowerShell 和 macOS；PowerShell 与 `cmd` 的脚本体用 bash 解析器读取。交给守卫不认识的程序去执行的命令（例如远程 shell 执行不透明的远程脚本文件）、会自行运行文件的程序（`make`、包脚本、git hooks）、git 别名展开后的内容、git 的带连字符子命令程序（`git-reset`）、在运行时拼接或编码的文本（字符串拼接、base64），以及拆分到多次工具调用中的破坏性命令，交给分类器处理；现有列表之外的操作（`git stash clear`、`git restore .`、`terraform apply -destroy`、`pulumi down`）同样如此；后两者是受保护的 destroy 命令的别名，可在后续扩展列表的 PR 中加入。待处理调用的重新评估、Code Mode 和 ACP 使用同一个评估器，仅由单元测试覆盖。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：提示词措辞不再解锁守卫。在 core 包中，破坏性命令检查现在是异步的，不再接收用户提示词；用于提取最后一条用户提示词的辅助函数也不再导出；仓库内没有其他使用者。

## 关联 Issue

基于 #13636（重复的守卫拒绝升级为仅限人工的确认）与 #13442（PreToolUse 输入重新校验），二者在本 PR 中均未改变。相关：#7531（此前拓宽守卫匹配模式的尝试，已关闭）。#12339 也修改了 AUTO 模式中守卫的调用处，因此后合入的一方需要做一次小的 rebase；本 PR 不依赖它，也不依赖其他仍在开放的 shell 解析 PR。

</details>

prs.title: feat(memory): add scoped external import jobs for CLI and HTTP
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Qwen-owned external memory import service for CLI and cloud integrations, starting with Codex. Clients submit relative Markdown paths and contents, inspect a deterministic preview, explicitly select sections and destination scope, then start durable background consolidation using the selected workspace's configured model. Results enter native memory search, fetch, recall and forget. Main checkouts and registered linked worktrees share the imported project layer while ordinary memory isolation remains unchanged.

The service exposes `memory_import_v1`, workspace-qualified HTTP preview/submit/status/source/cancel/retry endpoints, and offline `memory import codex --dry-run --json`. Unknown source scope stays unassigned. The server owns destination paths and validates active workspace trust; it never falls back to the primary runtime. Only selected source snapshots are retained. Journaled publication, idempotency, cancellation and retry protect existing, edited and forgotten memories.

Consolidation uses bounded batches per source project and confirmed scope, a compact same-scope metadata index with relevant evidence, and durable aggregate call/token reservations. Preview exposes usage estimates without reading native memories or invoking a model. Failure, cancellation and retry do not replenish the budget. Saved batch proposals preserve per-source recovery and edit/forget protection; imported repository identity lookups are cached and skipped entirely when no imported layer exists.

## Why it's needed

A cloud runtime cannot read a user's laptop filesystem. Direct per-bullet conversion also loses historical context and does not reconcile old knowledge with existing native memory. This replaces #14149 with shared backend capabilities and model-backed consolidation. No external product UI, independent collector, dependency installation requirement or unrelated CI repair is included.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Submit a synthetic Codex source set containing two projects and a referenced distilled Markdown resource. Preview should return grouped sections, references and assignment reasons without model calls or memory/task writes. An ambiguous section should stay unassigned.
- Select only one project and submit to a trusted non-primary workspace. Observe queued/running/completed results, then fetch its retained source and search the native result. The other project's text must never reach the model or retained snapshot; unknown/untrusted/draining destinations must not fall back to primary.
- Repeat the same request/key and then try another key with the same selected content. Native documents should not multiply. Edit or forget an imported document; another import must return conflict rather than restore it.
- Cancel during consolidation, retry a failed item, and restart after a forced process kill before/after publication. Recovery should wait out a dead worker's lease, preserve accurate counts/refs and publish each document only once.
- Verify the imported project result through a linked worktree, and verify an independent clone remains isolated. Ordinary per-worktree memory must retain its existing behavior.

- Verify a 12-section selected project is processed in two bounded calls, while excluded groups never reach the model. Preview should show group and aggregate usage estimates; retrying a budget-exhausted task must not reset the allowance. Interrupt between publications and verify saved proposals resume without another paid call or restoring edited/forgotten knowledge.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the installed baseline CLI rejected `memory import codex`, and the base daemon did not advertise the capability. After: synthetic shipped-CLI dry-runs (bare, leading debug and safe mode) returned versioned pure JSON with zero network attempts and zero filesystem changes. Confirmed CLI import and the real bundled daemon → real ACP child → loopback OpenAI-compatible model produced native searchable memory without unselected input. Bare/safe confirmed import rejected before source access or authentication.

Initial implementation tests passed: 559 CLI cases, 31 core cases, and the focused cold-workspace ACP bridge case. Full workspace build and typecheck passed; affected packages were rebuilt after final edits, with a final bundle and CLI typecheck. ESLint and formatting passed. Real SIGKILL probes left stale lock directories and recovered automatically after approximately 120 seconds, without manual lock deletion; both interruption points produced one document and correct original-batch counts. Two self-audit passes and a local medium review found no remaining issue; these are not formal approval.

Latest cost update after merging main: 55 focused CLI and 126 core tests passed, along with full build, bundle, typecheck, lint and format. Real bundled CLI/HTTP each processed 12 selected sources as [8, 4], with two requests and no extra request on repetition. Synthetic existing-context payload fell from 199,080 to 2,170 bytes. Interrupted-batch, budget-recovery and cross-group ordering probes passed. Production billing savings are not asserted.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Synthetic CLI, real daemon/ACP/model transport, native memory and process recovery |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Awaiting CI |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Awaiting CI |

### Environment (optional)

Isolated synthetic HOME, runtime, source and repository directories; deterministic loopback provider only. The full build used an 8 GiB Node heap. No actual user memory or production provider was accessed.

## Risk & Scope

- Budget limits: 32 logical invocations and 512,000 conservative reserved token units per task, with 8,192 output tokens per request. These are not guaranteed provider-billed-token or currency caps; oversized metadata/relevant evidence fails closed.
- Main risk or tradeoff: this is a cross-package feature with native memory reader and ACP integration; maintainer architectural review is requested. Model output is schema/native-format checked and cannot overwrite existing documents, but production-model semantic quality still requires evaluation.
- Not validated / out of scope: external product UI, standalone collectors, continuous sync, cross-instance sync and production deployment. SSH workspaces and legacy memory base/local path overrides are rejected in v1. Resource/context limits are documented; oversized context fails instead of silently truncating.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: additive capability and endpoints; ordinary writable memory roots remain unchanged. This does not migrate experimental state from #14149.

Design and API contracts are complete and synchronized in both languages: [Design (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/external-memory-import/docs/design/external-memory-import.md), [设计（中文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/external-memory-import/docs/design/external-memory-import.zh-CN.md), [API (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/external-memory-import/docs/design/external-memory-import-api.md), [接口（中文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/external-memory-import/docs/design/external-memory-import-api.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Supersedes #14149 following the requested backend redesign.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 本 PR 的变更

提供由 Qwen 自身负责的外部记忆导入服务，供 CLI 和云端系统接入，首版支持 Codex。客户端提交相对 Markdown 路径和内容，查看确定性预览，明确选择章节和目标范围后，启动使用目标工作区模型的持久化后台整理任务。结果进入原生记忆搜索、全文、召回和遗忘流程。主检出与已注册 linked worktree 共享导入项目层，普通记忆的既有隔离语义保持不变。

提供 `memory_import_v1`、限定工作区的 HTTP 预览/提交/状态/来源/取消/重试接口，以及离线 `memory import codex --dry-run --json`。未知归属保持待分配。目标路径由服务端管理，检查活动工作区信任状态，不回退主运行时。只保留选中来源快照，通过提交日志、幂等、取消和重试保护已有、已编辑和已遗忘的记忆。

整理按来源项目和确认范围分成有界批次，发送紧凑的同范围元数据索引及相关证据，并持久化总调用/token预留预算。预览展示估算，不读取原生记忆、不调用模型；失败、取消、重试不会重置预算。整批提案持久化后支持逐来源恢复，继续保护编辑和遗忘。仓库身份采用有界缓存，没有导入层时跳过遍历。

### 为什么需要

云端运行时无法直接读取用户电脑的文件系统；逐条转换 Markdown 列表还会丢失历史上下文，无法协调历史知识和已有原生记忆。本 PR 以共享底层能力和模型整理替代 #14149。不包含外部产品界面、独立收集器、额外安装要求或无关 CI 修补。

### 评审测试计划

使用含两个项目和一个引用 Markdown 资源的合成来源，验证预览返回分组、引用和归属原因，不调用模型，不写记忆或任务；歧义章节保持待分配。只选择一个项目并提交到可信次工作区，观察任务状态、查看保留来源并搜索原生结果；未选内容不得进入模型或快照，未知、不可信和退出中的目标不得回退主工作区。

重复同一请求/幂等键，再用新键提交相同内容，文档数量不应增加。编辑或遗忘导入文档后再次导入应返回冲突，不恢复内容。验证取消、失败重试，以及发布前后强制结束进程后的重启恢复：等待旧锁租约后自动继续，计数和引用正确且只发布一次。验证 linked worktree 共享结果、独立 clone 隔离及普通记忆原有行为。

### 前后证据

基线已安装 CLI 不支持该命令，基线 daemon 无此能力标识。实现后，成品 CLI 的普通、前置 debug 和 safe 模式预览均输出版本化纯 JSON，零网络尝试和零文件变化。确认后的 CLI 导入，以及真实 daemon → 真实 ACP 子进程 → 本地 OpenAI 兼容模拟模型的链路，均生成可搜索原生记忆且不包含未选来源。bare/safe 模式确认导入在读取来源或认证前被拒绝。

本地通过 559 项 CLI、31 项 core 测试及冷启动工作区 ACP 专项测试。全工作区构建和类型检查通过；最后修改后重新构建受影响包，完成最终 bundle 和 CLI 类型检查。ESLint、格式检查通过。真实 SIGKILL 遗留锁目录，约 120 秒后自动恢复，无需手工删锁；两个中断点均只生成一个文档，原批次计数正确。两轮自审和本地 medium 审查无剩余问题，不等同正式批准。

最新成本更新同步主线后，55 项 CLI、126 项 core 定向测试及全构建、bundle、typecheck、lint/format 通过。真实 CLI/HTTP 均将 12 条选中来源分成 8＋4，只调用两次，重复提交不增加调用；预览展示每组和总用量估算。合成已有上下文从 199,080 降至 2,170 字节，中断恢复、预算不重置与交错项目顺序验证通过。这不是生产账单节省率。

### 平台与环境

macOS 已完成合成 CLI、真实 daemon/ACP/模型传输、原生记忆和进程恢复验证；Windows、Linux 等待 CI。使用隔离的合成 HOME、运行目录、来源和仓库，以及确定性本地模拟模型；全量构建使用 8 GiB Node 堆。未访问真实用户记忆或生产模型。

每任务上限为 32 次逻辑调用及 512,000 个保守预留 token 单位，每次输出最多 8,192 token；不保证供应商实际计费 token 或金额硬上限。元数据或相关证据超限时明确失败。

### 风险、范围与迁移

本功能跨包并接入原生记忆读取和 ACP，需要维护者架构评审。模型输出经过结构化和原生格式校验且不能覆盖现有文档，但生产模型语义质量仍需评估。不包含外部产品界面、独立收集器、持续同步、跨实例同步或生产部署。v1 拒绝 SSH 工作区及旧式记忆 base/local 路径覆盖；资源和上下文限制已说明，超限失败而不静默截断。

新增能力和接口，普通记忆写入根目录不变。不迁移 #14149 的实验状态。双语设计与接口文档内容完整同步，链接见上方。本 PR 按重新设计要求替代 #14149。
