prs.title: feat: add hybrid code mode
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Codex-aligned `tools.mode` enum with `direct`, `code_mode`, and `code_mode_only`. `code_mode` keeps ordinary tools directly callable while also exposing the isolated `exec` JavaScript tool; each visible ordinary tool carries its nested JavaScript declaration, while `exec` retains compact `ALL_TOOLS` metadata. `code_mode_only` preserves the strict exec-only ordinary-tool surface, and `direct` remains the default.

Updates filtered subagent tool surfaces so direct declarations and nested exec bindings honor the same allowlists, exposes the enum in Settings as Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only, regenerates the settings JSON schema, and removes the former `tools.codeModeOnly` boolean setting entirely.

Adds synchronized [English](docs/design/code-mode.md) and [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md) design documents, and brings the existing CodeModeOnly design up to the repository's bilingual documentation standard ([English](docs/design/code-mode-only.md), [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)).

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code previously offered only the default direct tool surface or the strict CodeModeOnly surface. Models could not combine direct calls for simple operations with `exec` orchestration for multi-tool workflows. A three-value enum matches Codex's `ToolMode` naming and gives users one explicit setting for all supported exposure modes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Leave `tools.mode` unset or set it to `direct`, restart Qwen Code, and confirm ordinary tools remain available while `exec` is absent.
2. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode`, restart, and confirm both ordinary tools and `exec` are available. Confirm ordinary tool descriptions include their `tools.<name>(args)` declaration and deferred tools remain discoverable through `tool_search`.
3. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode_only`, restart, and confirm ordinary tools are available through `exec` rather than as top-level calls, while direct control tools remain available.
4. Open Settings and confirm Tool Mode cycles among Default, Code Mode, and Code Mode Only. Confirm `tools.codeModeOnly` is no longer present in the settings schema.
5. Start with `--safe-mode` or `--bare` while either code mode is configured and confirm the effective mode is `direct`.

Automated verification completed: focused Core tests (121 tests), focused CLI tests (585 tests), a repeated settings-schema regression run (60 tests), full build, full typecheck, full lint, and both installed and branch-built CLI version smoke checks.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: Settings exposed `Code Mode Only (Experimental)` as a boolean with `false` / `true`.

After: Settings exposes `Tool Mode (Experimental)` as an enum displaying Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only. Updated TUI snapshots cover the default display.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node.js v24.18.0; local source build and package-level Vitest suites.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Hybrid mode adds a short nested-call declaration to each ordinary tool description, increasing prompt size slightly; complete schemas are not duplicated in the `exec` description.
- Not validated / out of scope: Live-provider interactive runs and Windows/Linux local execution were not tested; CI covers supported platforms.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: `tools.codeModeOnly` is removed. Replace `{ "tools": { "codeModeOnly": true } }` with `{ "tools": { "mode": "code_mode_only" } }`.

## Linked Issues

Related to #10377.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增与 Codex 对齐的 `tools.mode` 枚举，支持 `direct`、`code_mode` 和 `code_mode_only`。`code_mode` 在保留普通工具直接调用能力的同时提供隔离的 `exec` JavaScript 工具；每个可见普通工具会携带自己的嵌套 JavaScript 声明，而 `exec` 保留精简的 `ALL_TOOLS` 元数据。`code_mode_only` 保持严格的普通工具仅经 `exec` 调用模式，`direct` 仍为默认值。

更新经过过滤的子智能体工具面，使直接声明和 `exec` 嵌套 binding 遵守同一组 allowlist；在设置界面中将该枚举显示为 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only；重新生成 settings JSON schema；并彻底移除原来的 `tools.codeModeOnly` 布尔设置。

新增同步的[英文](docs/design/code-mode.md)和[中文](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md)设计文档，并将现有 CodeModeOnly 设计补齐为仓库要求的双语文档（[英文](docs/design/code-mode-only.md)、[中文](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)）。

## 为什么需要

Qwen Code 此前只提供默认的直接工具面或严格的 CodeModeOnly 工具面。模型无法在简单操作中使用直接调用，同时在多工具工作流中使用 `exec` 编排。三值枚举与 Codex 的 `ToolMode` 命名一致，并为所有支持的暴露模式提供一个明确的统一设置项。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 不设置 `tools.mode` 或将其设为 `direct`，重启 Qwen Code，确认普通工具仍可用且不存在 `exec`。
2. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode` 并重启，确认普通工具和 `exec` 同时可用；确认普通工具描述包含各自的 `tools.<name>(args)` 声明，延迟工具仍可通过 `tool_search` 发现。
3. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode_only` 并重启，确认普通工具通过 `exec` 而不是顶层调用使用，同时直接控制工具仍然可用。
4. 打开设置界面，确认 Tool Mode 可在 Default、Code Mode 和 Code Mode Only 之间切换，并确认 settings schema 中不再存在 `tools.codeModeOnly`。
5. 配置任一 code mode 后用 `--safe-mode` 或 `--bare` 启动，确认有效模式为 `direct`。

已完成自动化验证：Core 相关测试（121 个）、CLI 相关测试（585 个）、再次运行的 settings schema 回归测试（60 个）、完整 build、完整 typecheck、完整 lint，以及已安装版本和分支构建版本的 CLI 版本 smoke 检查。

### 前后对比证据

之前：设置界面以 `false` / `true` 布尔值展示 `Code Mode Only (Experimental)`。

之后：设置界面以枚举展示 `Tool Mode (Experimental)`，可选 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only。更新后的 TUI snapshot 覆盖默认显示。

prs.title: feat(core): honor preview budgets and make truncated previews recoverable
prs.body:
> Split part ② of #13652. Stacked on part ① (`feat/tool-result-size-accounting`); part ③ stacks on this branch.

## What this PR does

This PR makes truncated tool outputs honestly previewed and recoverable. `truncateAndSaveToFile` now treats the caller's preview budget as authoritative: a compact structured JSON sample is only used when the requested preview fits the sample's own size class, so a caller budgeting ~98k of preview (web_fetch) or 4k (shell) is no longer silently shrunk to a ~2k sample. Every bounded body — whether its full output was spilled to disk or skipped for the session disk budget — leads with the same truncation sentinel, embeds the sha256 of the full pre-truncation output so the loop guards keep fingerprinting stable, and carries a read_file paging hint (including the single-line payload case). Spill writes reserve session bytes up front and roll the reservation back if the write fails, and a disk-budget skip produces a sentinel-led preview that does not claim a file that was never written. `isAlreadyTruncated` recognizes the new envelope so downstream passes stay idempotent.

## Why it's needed

Before this, callers that paid for a large preview lost most of it whenever the content happened to be JSON — that one predates this slice. The other two are gaps this slice introduces and closes in the same commit: a body skipped for the session disk budget looked like a successful spill, and a failed spill write leaked the session byte reservation. Stacked on top of the provenance accounting from part ①.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `npm run build` and `npm run typecheck` (both pass), then in `packages/core`: `npx vitest run src/tools/truncation.test.ts src/core/coreToolScheduler.test.ts` — locally 577/577 passed. The new truncation tests cover the JSON sample budget honoring, the sentinel-led disk-budget skip, byte reservation rollback across parallel spills, and the already-truncated recognizer.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (tool-internal preview/telemetry behavior).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the envelope shape changed; recognizers are updated here, and part ③ additionally exempts web_fetch from the starts-with guard in the persistence gate.
- Not validated / out of scope: web_fetch producer changes land in part ③.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Split part ② of #13652. Stacked on #14545.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

本 PR 是 #13652 拆分的第二片，叠加在第一片（`feat/tool-result-size-accounting`）之上：让被截断的工具输出既如实预览又可恢复。`truncateAndSaveToFile` 现在以调用方的预览预算为准：仅当请求的预览落在结构化 JSON 采样自身的体量区间时才使用采样，web_fetch 的 ~98k 预览与 shell 的 4k 预览不再被悄悄压成 ~2k。所有限长后的正文——无论全文已落盘还是因会话磁盘预算被跳过——都以同一个截断哨兵开头，内嵌完整输出的 sha256 供循环检测稳定取指纹，并附带 read_file 分页提示（含单行负载的情形）。落盘写入先预留会话字节、失败回滚；磁盘预算跳过时产出以哨兵开头且不谎称已存文件的预览。`isAlreadyTruncated` 同步识别新 envelope，下游保持幂等。

动机：调用方付费购买的大预览在内容为 JSON 时大幅缩水，这一点在本片之前就存在；另外两处是本片自己引入并在同一次提交里补上的缺口——磁盘预算跳过的正文看起来像成功落盘，落盘失败会泄漏会话字节预留。

验证：`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck` 通过；`npx vitest run src/tools/truncation.test.ts src/core/coreToolScheduler.test.ts` 本地 577/577 通过。无 breaking change。

prs.title: fix(web-shell): prune split panes whose session left the active catalog
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a session that is open in the Split View gets archived, its pane used to stay permanently empty and kept retrying forever. This PR has two parts. First, the session provider now treats the daemon's 409 response with body code `session_archived` as a terminal status, the same way it already treats 401/403/404/410, instead of routing it into the infinite-retry branch: the pane gets an explicit connection error instead of a silent blank, and the endless load retries against a session that cannot be loaded stop. A plain 409 (session-writer conflict) stays retriable because it can clear on its own. Second, the Split View now reconciles its live pane set against the settled active session catalog: a pane whose session left the catalog (archived or deleted) is probed as a standalone session first — a live standalone pane, or any transient probe failure, survives — and only a confirmed not-found session is removed; if it was the last pane, the existing fallback to the session overview applies. Removal goes through the controlled `onPanesChange` (or the uncontrolled setter) against the freshest pane/catalog refs, so a re-unarchived session survives an in-flight round trip, and on a multi-workspace daemon the reconcile waits for the other-workspace session lists to settle before pruning (the other-workspace hook gains a loading flag), so a pane that is merely temporarily invisible is not pruned.

Following the first review round, the prune additionally refuses to conclude anything from a catalog the daemon did not vouch for as complete: it reads `truncated` / `nextCursor` / `liveMergeFailed` off the settled primary page, waits for the other-workspace fan-out to be able to prove absence as well (the hook now separates in-flight `loading` from a `degraded` state covering a landed-with-error list and an unqueried untrusted workspace), never prunes the current session, reads the prop-derived pane set in controlled mode, and records definitive standalone-probe verdicts so a kept-but-stale pane is not re-probed on every catalog commit.

## Why it's needed

Reported bug: archiving a session that is open in the Split View leaves a permanently empty pane — the header still shows the session title, the content area is blank, no error, no banner — and the same empty pane comes back on every re-entry into the Split View, because the pane set is persisted across view switches. While the pane sits there, its load requests loop on the 409 response with backoff forever, invisibly. A silent dead-end UI state plus wasted requests; closing the pane by hand was the only escape.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

New unit tests: `SplitView.test.tsx` (a pane whose session left the settled active catalog is pruned; last pane → existing onExit to the session overview; a live standalone pane survives the standalone probe; a transient probe error keeps the pane (fail-safe); a settled-but-incomplete page — truncated, cursor-pending, or merge-degraded — does not prune; an unqueried (untrusted) other workspace does not prune; the current session is never pruned even if it leaves the catalog; removal works in both controlled and uncontrolled modes; a re-unarchived session is not pruned; a pane the parent closed while a probe is in flight is not resurrected; a kept-but-stale pane is probed at most once; the probe is skipped when the capability is absent), `DaemonSessionProvider.test.tsx` (409 with `session_archived` body code is terminal — visible error, no retry; a plain 409 stays retriable; existing terminal statuses unchanged), and `useOtherWorkspaceSessions.test.tsx` (a failed first fetch settles as degraded rather than pinning `loading`, and settles once the retry lands).

- Run the tests: `pnpm --filter @qwen-code/web-shell exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts client/components/SplitView.test.tsx client/daemon/session/DaemonSessionProvider.test.tsx client/hooks/useOtherWorkspaceSessions.test.tsx` — all green on the final head (per-OS runs in the table below).
- Manual check: start a daemon with the Web Shell, open the Split View with two sessions, archive one of them (session row menu → Archive). Expected: the archived pane closes (last pane → session overview); re-entering the Split View does not bring the empty pane back. Also: a standalone session in the split survives (it is probed before removal), and a deleted session is pruned by the same path.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: user-reported empty pane (screenshot from the report, 2026-10-17) — pane header alive, content blank, no banner.
After: E2E run on a build of this branch: Split View with two sessions → archive one → the pane closes; re-enter Split → no empty pane (screenshots to be added after the macOS E2E run).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | In progress: re-run on a build of this branch + the user's real Chrome via CDP; results and screenshots to follow (body will be updated) |
| 🪟 Windows | Queued: UTM Win11 ARM (node 22.23.3 + pnpm 11.24.0); results to follow |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 514/514 (3 files: SplitView 77 + DaemonSessionProvider 430 + useOtherWorkspaceSessions 7) + tsc clean — Docker `node:22-bookworm`, head bb07cd2457 |

### Environment

macOS: daemon built from this branch + the user's real Chrome via CDP. Windows: UTM Win11 ARM (WinOnArm x64 emulation), node 22.23.3 + pnpm 11.24.0. Linux: Docker `node:22-bookworm` + `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: over-pruning a pane that is only temporarily invisible. Mitigations: the prune waits for a page the daemon vouched for as complete (`truncated` / `nextCursor` / `liveMergeFailed`) and for the other-workspace fan-out to be able to prove absence (`loading` + `degraded`), never prunes the current session, probes every other pane as standalone before removal, and any transient probe error keeps the pane — only a confirmed not-found on a proven-complete catalog is pruned.
- Not validated / out of scope: read-only viewing of archived sessions is a separate feature (tracked in #13018); the side-task archive surface (#14300) is untouched; the TUI is unaffected.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14576

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

当 Split View 中打开的会话被归档时，其面板此前会永久空白并无限重试。本 PR 分两部分。第一，会话 provider 现在把 daemon 返回的 body code 为 `session_archived` 的 409 响应视为终止状态（与既有的 401/403/404/410 一致），而不是进入无限重试分支：面板显示明确的连接错误而不是静默空白，针对无法加载的会话的无尽加载重试停止。普通 409（session-writer 冲突）保持可重试，因为它可能自行消解。第二，Split View 现在用已结算的 active 会话目录对活动面板集做对账：会话离开目录（归档或删除）的面板先做 standalone 探测——活的 standalone 面板或任何瞬时探测失败都保留——只有确认 not-found 的会话才移除；若它是最后一块面板，走既有的回落到 Session Overview 路径。移除通过受控的 `onPanesChange`（或非受控 setter）按最新的面板/目录引用执行，因此归档后恢复（re-unarchive）的会话不会在途中的往返中被误删；在 multi-workspace daemon 上，对账会先等其他 workspace 的会话列表结算（other-workspace hook 增加 loading 标志）再做剪枝，因此只是暂时不可见的面板不会被误删。

在第一轮评审之后，剪枝还拒绝从守护进程未担保完整的目录得出任何结论：它从已结算的主分页读取 `truncated` / `nextCursor` / `liveMergeFailed`，等其他 workspace 扇出也能证明缺席（hook 把 in-flight 的 `loading` 与 `degraded` 状态分开，后者覆盖"已到达但出错"的列表和从未查询的 untrusted workspace），永不剪枝当前会话，在受控模式下读取 props 派生的面板集合，并记录 standalone 探测的确定性结论——被保留但过期的面板不会在每次目录提交时被重复探测。

## 为什么需要

报告的缺陷：归档一个在 Split View 中打开的会话，会留下一块永久空白的面板——标题栏仍显示会话名，内容区空白，无错误、无 banner——并且每次重新进入 Split View，同一块空面板都会回来，因为面板集在视图切换间被持久化。面板空挂期间，其加载请求以退避方式对 409 响应无限循环重试，用户不可见。静默的死胡同 UI 状态加浪费的请求；手动关闭面板是唯一的出路。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

新增单元测试：`SplitView.test.tsx`（会话离开已结算 active 目录的面板被剪枝；最后一块面板 → 既有 onExit 回落到 Session Overview；活的 standalone 面板通过 standalone 探测保留；瞬时探测错误保留面板（fail-safe）；已结算但不完整的页面——truncated、游标未决或 merge 降级——不剪枝；未查询的（untrusted）其他 workspace 不剪枝；当前会话永不剪枝，即使它离开目录；受控与非受控两种模式都能移除；re-unarchive 的会话不被误删；探测在途时父组件关闭的面板不被复活；被保留但过期的面板最多探测一次；capability 缺失时跳过探测）、`DaemonSessionProvider.test.tsx`（body code 为 `session_archived` 的 409 为终止状态——可见错误、不重试；普通 409 保持可重试；既有终止状态不变）以及 `useOtherWorkspaceSessions.test.tsx`（首次拉取失败以 degraded 结算，而不是把 `loading` 钉死，重试到达后结算）。

- 运行测试：`pnpm --filter @qwen-code/web-shell exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts client/components/SplitView.test.tsx client/daemon/session/DaemonSessionProvider.test.tsx client/hooks/useOtherWorkspaceSessions.test.tsx` — 最终 head 上全部通过（分平台结果见下表）。
- 手动验证：启动带 Web Shell 的 daemon，打开含两个会话的 Split View，归档其中一个（会话行菜单 → Archive）。预期：被归档的面板关闭（最后一块面板 → Session Overview）；重新进入 Split View 不会带出空面板。另外：split 中的 standalone 会话存活（移除前会先探测），删除的会话由同一路径剪枝。

### 证据（前后对比）

之前：用户报告的空白面板（报告中的截图，2026-10-17）——标题栏存活，内容空白，无 banner。
之后：在本分支构建上的 E2E 运行：Split View 两个会话 → 归档一个 → 面板关闭；重新进入 Split → 无空面板（macOS E2E 运行后补截图）。

### 已测试平台

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | 进行中：本分支构建 + 用户真实 Chrome 经 CDP 复跑；结果与截图随后更新 |
| 🪟 Windows | 排队中：UTM Win11 ARM（node 22.23.3 + pnpm 11.24.0）；结果随后更新 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 514/514（3 个文件：SplitView 77 + DaemonSessionProvider 430 + useOtherWorkspaceSessions 7）+ tsc 0 — Docker `node:22-bookworm`，head bb07cd2457 |

### 环境

macOS: 由本分支构建的 daemon + 用户真实 Chrome 通过 CDP。Windows: UTM Win11 ARM (WinOnArm x64 模拟), node 22.23.3 + pnpm 11.24.0。Linux: Docker `node:22-bookworm` + `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：误剪枝只是暂时不可见的面板。缓解：剪枝等待守护进程担保完整的页面（`truncated` / `nextCursor` / `liveMergeFailed`）及其他 workspace 扇出能证明缺席（`loading` + `degraded`），永不剪枝当前会话，每块其他面板移除前先做 standalone 探测，任何瞬时探测错误都保留面板——只有对已证明完整的目录确认 not-found 才剪枝。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：归档会话的只读查看是独立特性（#13018 跟踪中）；side-task 归档表面（#14300）未改动；TUI 不受影响。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #14576

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): delete selected message groups from session history
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds grouped message deletion to Web Shell. The message action row keeps Copy and an overflow menu; Delete selects the current prompt and its complete reply group, with linked checkboxes and optional non-contiguous groups before or after the entry. The entry determines only the initial selection; during selection its Delete messages menu item remains visible but disabled. Reply selection stays beside the Processed header when present, including after expanding thoughts or tools.

Deletion removes the selected original records from JSONL and retained raw compression context, refreshes live model context and connected clients, and preserves every existing summary unchanged. Slash-command display groups can be removed without undoing command effects or files; frontend-only commands retain their position and identity across reloads and recovery.

## Why it's needed

Web Shell cannot currently remove arbitrary conversation groups. Rewind removes a suffix and retains abandoned history, so it does not satisfy physical deletion of selected turns. Users also need consistent behavior when deleting the only group, working around compression checkpoints, or recovering from stale snapshots and partially completed requests.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In an idle local daemon session, open a user message's overflow menu and choose Delete messages. The current prompt/reply group should be selected; toggling either checkbox must toggle the group. Enter from a middle group and select groups before or after it; during selection Delete messages must remain visible but disabled and must not restart selection. Confirm a non-contiguous selection and verify only the chosen groups disappear after reload and in other connected clients.
2. Expand thoughts/tools and verify a reply group still has one checkbox beside Processed, or beside its first reply when no status header exists. Run a local display command between turns; deleting another group must preserve the command's order and identity. Repeat at narrow viewport width and with keyboard/touch menu interaction.
3. Delete the only/all groups and continue the same session. Inspect persisted history and reopen the session: selected originals and paired tool records must remain absent, while files and command effects remain unchanged.
4. Compress a conversation, then delete groups before and after compression. Existing summaries must remain identical; only selected retained raw context should change later model input. A full compression followed by fast compression must retain the summary boundary and allow safe deletion.
5. Change history from another client while a selection is open. A conflict must clear stale selection and explain re-selection without automatically resubmitting deletion. A busy session must refuse deletion. If persistence succeeds but context installation fails, deleted identities must still reach the originator, its UI must reconcile, and further prompts must explicitly require reopening. Failed reloads must retain unselected saved messages and local commands and explain that deletion succeeded but refresh failed. Reopening must recover context without repeating deletion, and lifecycle close must remain available. Historical transcript pages must not offer deletion.

6. Let two successive turns edit the same file, then delete the second. The first turn’s diff should still show only its own edits; later surviving turns must keep their correct rewind ordinal. Repeat after reopening and creating another turn. During failed context installation, recap and automatic background turns must wait for recovery; recovering the session must resume retained notifications without consuming their retry budget.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: there is no grouped physical-deletion action, and the initial hover menu implementation redirected item focus to the composer. After: the current captures show the hovered menu item focused and highlighted, selection extending after the middle entry with a visible disabled Delete messages item, a retained middle turn from non-contiguous deletion, and surviving rows after deletion succeeds but history reload fails.

**Captured with Playwright Chromium and simulated daemon HTTP/SSE responses; all four images were visually inspected. These screenshots establish UI states only. Earlier real-daemon/ACP/JSONL/model evidence remains in the PR discussion; the current repairs additionally have independent controlled-handler/store probes.** Images live only in an independent fork asset branch, pinned to commit `6fefb8c9eb37588c906c9d3314699dbc3ada0585`.

![Hover menu with the hovered item focused and highlighted (simulated daemon)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/6fefb8c9eb37588c906c9d3314699dbc3ada0585/menu.png)

![Middle entry with its following group selected and Delete messages visible but disabled (simulated daemon)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/6fefb8c9eb37588c906c9d3314699dbc3ada0585/selection-all.png)

![Unselected middle turn retained (simulated daemon)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/6fefb8c9eb37588c906c9d3314699dbc3ada0585/after-deletion.png)

![Deletion persisted, reload failed, surviving saved and local rows retained (simulated daemon)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/6fefb8c9eb37588c906c9d3314699dbc3ada0585/reload-failed.png)

[Bilingual evidence notes](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/6fefb8c9eb37588c906c9d3314699dbc3ada0585/README.md).

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Node.js 22; build, bundle, typecheck, focused unit tests and browser/backend E2E |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Local macOS / Node.js 22.14.0 validation: 252 focused unit cases passed (Core 93, session/agent 7, bridge 13, resolved hook file 112, Web Shell 27). After merging main d21060e8, the complete simulated-daemon Chromium deletion suite passed 26/26 without retries; after the final cache correction, the three relevant browser cases and an independent exact cache regression also passed. All four Summary images were recaptured and visually inspected. Full build and typecheck passed with a temporary 6 GiB heap after the default 4 GiB local CLI compiler exhausted memory; repository/CI heap settings were not changed. Bundle, staged-file format/lint checks, bundled version/help checks and independent review passed. Current backend repair evidence uses focused tests with temporary filesystem storage and controlled handler/store probes; the earlier real-daemon/ACP/JSONL/local-model evidence remains in the PR discussion and was not rerun in this round. A separate E2E report records these validation layers.

## Risk & Scope

- Physical deletion is irreversible. Existing summaries may still contain information from deleted originals by design; summary text is never regenerated or edited.
- Scope is ordinary local daemon sessions. Managed authoritative storage, SSH workspaces and the hosted harness profile do not support this operation. Ambiguous legacy compression identities fail closed.
- Busy sessions are rejected. A failure after persistence keeps prompt admission closed until the session is reopened; it cannot continue with stale model context.
- This feature touches transcript persistence and cross-package session contracts; maintainer review is requested. It introduces no dependency or history migration and preserves normal append/resume behavior.
- Local verification did not cover Windows, Linux or live external model providers.

Design: [English](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/ca6c9abed06372f450ac322b3205c87475ae6f14/docs/design/2026-10-15-web-shell-message-group-deletion.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/ca6c9abed06372f450ac322b3205c87475ae6f14/docs/design/2026-10-15-web-shell-message-group-deletion.zh-CN.md). Both versions include matching decisions, constraints and acceptance criteria.

## Linked Issues

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

1. 在空闲的本地 daemon 会话中，打开用户消息的更多操作菜单并选择删除消息。当前提问与回复组应默认选中；切换任一 checkbox 都必须联动整组。从中间组进入，验证前后各组均可选择；选择期间菜单中的删除消息入口应保持可见但禁用，点击不重启选择。非连续选择后确认，验证仅所选组消失，重新加载和其他连接客户端中也保持一致。
2. 展开思考与工具，验证每个回复组仍只有一个 checkbox，位于「已处理」旁；没有状态栏时位于首条回复旁。在两轮之间执行前端展示命令，删除其他组后命令顺序与身份必须保留。再验证窄视口及键盘、触屏菜单交互。
3. 删除唯一组或全部组，再继续当前会话。检查持久化历史并重新打开会话：所选原文和配对工具记录仍应不存在，文件及命令效果保持不变。
4. 压缩会话后，分别删除压缩前后的组。已有摘要必须完全相同；只有所选、仍保留的原文上下文会改变后续模型输入。正常压缩后再快速压缩，仍必须保留摘要边界并允许安全删除。
5. 选择期间由另一客户端改变历史。冲突必须清除旧选择并提示重新选择，不能自动重发删除。会话忙碌时必须拒绝删除。若持久化成功而上下文安装失败，已删除身份仍必须返回发起方，界面必须对账，后续发送明确要求重新打开会话。重新加载失败时必须保留未选的已保存消息和本地命令，并明确提示删除成功、重载失败。重新打开后应恢复上下文，不重复删除，会话也必须能够正常关闭。历史分页不得提供删除入口。

6. 让相邻两轮修改同一文件，再删除后一轮。前一轮的文件差异仍只能包含自己的修改，其后保留轮次的回退序号必须正确。重开会话并继续新轮次后重复验证。上下文安装失败期间，recap 和自动后台轮次必须等待恢复；恢复后应继续处理已保留的通知，不消耗通知重试预算。

prs.title: test(managed-agent): gate FG12f result and catalog delivery
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the FG12f result-and-catalog delivery gate as a new `HostedMcpResultDeliveryIT` class with three cases, plus the fixture triggers they need:

- **Committed-result replay.** The same MCP operation id is submitted twice; the second answer must equal the published `resultRef` response, add no `mcp-invoke` control and no Broker exchange, and leave exactly one committed record.
- **Output limit.** A 61 KiB resource read settles `managed_mcp_output_limit`; the committed record is `failed`/`settled`, the fixture records exactly one effect, and the following close reaches `released` without another invoke, so no hold remains.
- **Catalog change during a call.** The stdio fixture announces `notifications/tools/list_changed` before answering a read; the in-flight call is not resent, the effect happens once, and the operation keeps the `catalogRevision` it started on.

## Why it's needed

The FG12f row in #14447 asks for delivery guarantees on the Hosted MCP path that no gate covered: a settled result must replay from the committed record rather than the Runtime, an oversized response must settle at the limit instead of hanging, and a catalog change must not disturb a call already in flight.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
JAVA_HOME=<jdk21> mvn failsafe:integration-test \
  -Dit.test='HostedMcpResultDeliveryIT' \
  -Dmysql.url=jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3307/hosted_harness_test -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password= \
  -Dnode.executable="$(which node)" -Dqwen.cli.entry=<repo>/packages/cli/dist/index.js
```

Expected: three tests, zero failures. The replay case shows one `mcp-invoke` on the Broker proxy for two submissions; the output-limit case shows `managed_mcp_output_limit` in the committed record; the catalog case shows one invoke and one effect across the notification.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — integration test only.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Local evidence: `Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` in 14.08 s on MySQL 8.0.46 with JDK 21 and the package build at `packages/cli/dist`. The hosted Linux lane will re-run it in CI.

### Environment

MySQL 8.0.46 with a temporary datadir, JDK 21, local `packages/cli/dist`.

## Risk & Scope

- **What the gate does not claim.** The issue's list-change row also expects a new configuration generation. In this tree the notification only bumps the connection's `catalogRevision` and marks discovery stale; it does not rewrite the `mcp_configuration` record, so the case pins the no-resend property instead of asserting a rewrite that does not happen.
- **Out of scope.** A late conclusive reply after `outcome_unknown` has no settle path today: `unknown()` marks the state and `client.onclose` drops the pending map with the connection, so a reply can only land through a same-id re-dispatch. Adding that path is a production change and stays a recorded gap.
- **Budget.** The new class measured 14.08 s; at 2× it adds 30 s, moving the healthy sum to 8481 s, the fork to 9081 s, Verify to 162 minutes and the job ceiling to 265 minutes. `scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` is 65/65.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** none; test-only.

## Linked Issues

Part of #14447 (FG12f residual cells).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增 `HostedMcpResultDeliveryIT`，三格：

- **已提交结果重放**：同一 operation id 提交两次，第二次必须等于已发布的 `resultRef` 内容，且不新增 `mcp-invoke` 控制、不新增 Broker 交换，落库记录仍为一条。
- **输出上限**：61 KiB 资源读取结算为 `managed_mcp_output_limit`，落库记录为 `failed`/`settled`，夹具恰好一次副作用；随后关闭到达 `released` 且不再补发 invoke，没有留下 hold。
- **调用期间的 catalog 变更**：夹具在回答读取前发出 `notifications/tools/list_changed`；在飞调用不被重发、副作用恰好一次，操作保持启动时的 `catalogRevision`。

## 为什么需要

#14447 的 FG12f 行要求的投递保证此前没有门禁：已结算结果必须从落库记录重放而不是再打 Runtime；超大应答必须在上限处结算而不是挂住；catalog 变更不得扰动已在飞的调用。

## 评审测试计划

用上文命令运行该类，预期三个用例、零失败。重放格在代理上只看到一次 `mcp-invoke`；输出上限格的落库记录含 `managed_mcp_output_limit`；catalog 格在通知前后只有一次 invoke、一次副作用。

### 测试环境

MySQL 8.0.46 临时 datadir、JDK 21、包内 `packages/cli/dist`。本机证据：`Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`，14.08 s。

## 风险与范围

- **不声称的部分**：issue 的列表变更行还要求「新的配置代际」。本树的通知只自增连接内的 `catalogRevision` 并把 discovery 标为 stale，不回写 `mcp_configuration` 记录，因此该格钉的是「不重发」，不是并不存在的回写。
- **范围外**：`outcome_unknown` 之后的迟到结论目前没有结算路径——`unknown()` 置状态后 `client.onclose` 连同 pending 一起关闭连接，迟到应答只能通过同 id 重新派发落地。补该路径属生产改动，仍记为缺口。
- **预算**：新类实测 14.08 s，按 2 倍计 30 s；健康总和 8481 s、fork 9081 s、Verify 162 分钟、job 上限 265 分钟；`hosted-process-ci.test.js` 65/65。
- **破坏性变更**：无，仅测试。

## 关联 Issue

#14447 的一部分（FG12f 剩余格）。

</details>

prs.title: test(managed-agent): Verify MCP retention through Session retirement
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an executable retention witness for private MCP catalogs, arguments, responses and domain records stored as immutable SQL resources. Both resource reads and prompt gets preserve their original evidence after the record reader restarts and after connection release, reject a missing referenced result atomically, retain all owners with GC disabled, and collect exact bytes only after permanent Session retirement releases record and journal owners. Bilingual documentation reconciles the original P1 design with the generic collector already present after schema consolidation.

## Why it's needed

The MCP retention issue was filed against the earlier kind-limited collector. Current main already reclaims unreferenced `MYSQL_INLINE` bodies in both `PUBLISHED` and `REFERENCED` states, so adding another producer adapter would duplicate production behavior. The missing deliverable is proof that the real MCP transaction closure survives recovery and is released in the right order, together with documentation that no longer describes these SQL bytes as permanently pinned.

## Reviewer Test Plan

Verify that restarting the record reader returns the exact catalog, arguments, complete MCP response and release state, and that releasing the connection does not collect live Session evidence. A missing result must reject the entire transaction. After permanent retirement, the default-disabled GC must preserve both references and bytes; enabling GC in the isolated fixture must release owners before byte removal and record the exact original byte sum once, including after the collector restarts.

### How to verify

Run the two producer-specific cases on H2 and disposable MySQL 8.4, then the complete collector suite. Review the English [lifecycle contract](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/mcp-retention-lifecycle-witness/docs/design/managed-mcp-retention-lifecycle.md) and its complete [Chinese version](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/mcp-retention-lifecycle-witness/docs/design/managed-mcp-retention-lifecycle.zh-CN.md) alongside the current-state corrections to the original P1 design. A temporary mutation that bypasses owner release makes both MCP cases fail with incomplete journal collection; restoring production source restores the passing behavior.

Final independent verification passed on JDK 21: the default-profile full module `mvn clean verify` reported 4,962 tests, zero failures/errors and 18 unchanged platform/profile/engine-specific skips; both Checkstyle gates and SpotBugs passed. The complete H2 collector class ran 71 tests with its two engine-specific skips; both MCP cases independently passed on MySQL 8.4 with zero skips. The broader inherited MySQL results remain separately reported under Risk & Scope.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A. This PR adds server-side lifecycle tests and documentation without changing production behavior or the UI.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested; the MySQL 8.4 server ran in a Linux VM |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, JDK 21.0.8, Maven 3.9.14, Node 22.22.3; disposable MySQL 8.4.11 over the local VM-forwarded port. The global Qwen CLI 0.24.1 help was checked first; it has no internal SQL collection scheduler, so the real Java producer/transaction/retirement fixture supplies the server-only fallback evidence. The SQL lifecycle cases do not load Core/CLI JavaScript. Source-matched Core/CLI artifacts and all other workspace runtime prerequisites were prepared before the successful full-module run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: these are SQL lifecycle witnesses; they do not prove Hosted process crash recovery or target-deployment acceptance. The physical GC default remains disabled.
- Not validated / out of scope: private CSI Sessions, local filesystem retention, external MCP object-storage results, media/shared-output retention in #13884, and the deployment gates in #13090. The broad inherited MySQL suite reported one failure in the unchanged reader/grace case; its isolated rerun passed, and the new fixture was made independent of first-tick timestamp rounding. Two historical catalog-upgrade fixtures also reproduce their failures on unchanged main production source and are documented separately. Independent review found no confirmed defects. Independent test-engineer verification passed both producer cases on H2 and MySQL 8.4 and the full default-profile module verification with the 18 skips counted above; the entire inherited native MySQL profile is not claimed green.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no production code, schema, API contract or default changes.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13883; part of #13534 and #12380. Completion evidence is limited to the supported SQL-private MCP producer.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

为以不可变 SQL 资源存储的私有 MCP catalog、参数、响应和 domain 记录补充可执行的保留见证。资源读取与 prompt 获取两种路径，在记录读取器重启及连接释放后都保留原始证据；缺少被引用的结果会原子拒绝提交；GC 关闭时保留全部 owner；只有 Session 永久退役、记录与 journal owner 释放后才按实际字节回收。双语文档将原始 P1 设计与 schema 整合后已经存在的通用回收器对齐。

## Why it's needed

MCP 保留 issue 针对的是早期限制 kind 的回收器。当前 main 已回收 `PUBLISHED` 与 `REFERENCED` 两种状态中没有引用的 `MYSQL_INLINE` 资源体，因此再增加生产者 adapter 会重复已有生产行为。缺少的交付物是证明真实 MCP 事务闭包能在恢复后保留、按正确顺序释放，以及不再把这些 SQL 字节描述成永久钉住的准确文档。

## Reviewer Test Plan

验证重启记录读取器后，仍然返回完全相同的 catalog、参数、完整 MCP 响应和释放状态；连接释放不回收存活 Session 的证据。缺少结果必须拒绝整个事务。永久退役后，默认关闭的 GC 必须同时保留引用和字节；仅在隔离 fixture 中开启 GC 后，必须先释放 owner 再清空字节，并将原始字节总和只计数一次，包括回收器重启后。

### How to verify

在 H2 与一次性 MySQL 8.4 上运行两种生产者专属用例，再运行完整回收器测试。结合原始 P1 设计的当前状态修订，审阅英文[生命周期契约](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/mcp-retention-lifecycle-witness/docs/design/managed-mcp-retention-lifecycle.md)及其完整[中文版本](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/mcp-retention-lifecycle-witness/docs/design/managed-mcp-retention-lifecycle.zh-CN.md)。临时绕过 owner 释放的 mutation 使两个 MCP 用例都因 journal 回收未完成而失败；恢复生产源代码后测试重新通过。

JDK 21 上的最终独立验证通过：默认 profile 的完整模块 `mvn clean verify` 共 4,962 个测试，零失败、零错误，18 个未修改的平台、profile 或数据库引擎专属用例跳过；两道 Checkstyle 门禁与 SpotBugs 均通过。完整 H2 回收器类共 71 个测试，其中两个引擎专属用例跳过；MySQL 8.4 上两个 MCP 用例独立通过且无跳过。更大范围继承 MySQL 测试的结果在 Risk & Scope 中单独保留。

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A。此 PR 增加服务端生命周期测试和文档，不改变生产行为或 UI。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ 未测试；MySQL 8.4 服务端运行于 Linux 虚拟机 |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64、JDK 21.0.8、Maven 3.9.14、Node 22.22.3；通过虚拟机转发到本地端口的一次性 MySQL 8.4.11。先检查全局 Qwen CLI 0.24.1 的帮助；该 CLI 不暴露内部 SQL 回收调度器，因此采用真实 Java 生产者、事务和退役 fixture 作为服务端路径的替代证据。SQL 生命周期用例不加载 Core/CLI JavaScript。成功的完整模块运行前已准备与源码一致的 Core/CLI 产物及其他全部 workspace 运行时前提。

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff：这些是 SQL 生命周期见证，不证明 Hosted 进程崩溃恢复或目标部署验收通过。物理 GC 继续默认关闭。
- Not validated / out of scope：私有 CSI Session、本地文件系统保留、外部 MCP 对象存储结果、#13884 的媒体与共享输出保留，以及 #13090 的部署门禁。完整继承的 MySQL 测试中，未修改的 reader/grace 用例失败一次，单独重跑通过；新增 fixture 已不再依赖首个调度 tick 的时间戳舍入边界。两个历史 catalog 升级 fixture 也在未修改的主干生产代码上复现既有失败，并已单独记录。独立代码评审未发现可确认缺陷。独立 test-engineer 在 H2 与 MySQL 8.4 上均通过两种生产者用例，默认 profile 的完整模块验证也通过，并计入上述 18 个跳过；不宣称整个继承的原生 MySQL profile 已通过。
- Breaking changes / migration notes：无；不改变生产代码、schema、API 契约或默认值。

## Linked Issues

关联 #13883，属于 #13534 与 #12380 的一部分。完成证据仅限受支持的 SQL 私有 MCP 生产者。

</details>

prs.title: feat(core): shrink tool results to the headroom left before auto-compaction
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a session is close to auto-compaction, shrink the next request's tool results to its remaining headroom. Use only the same chat's last successful usage report for the current provider route and unchanged history prefix. System instructions, session context and tool declarations must match that report; equivalent refreshes preserve it, while changed inputs and obsolete in-flight responses invalidate it without clearing usage counters. Explicit truncation settings take priority.

Measure headroom against auto-compaction and share the selected budget across the batch, charging protected text, media and framing first. Keep the tighter aggregate budget and avoid cutting results twice. If an allocation cannot fit a complete truncation notice, preserve the batch for normal compaction and hard-limit admission. When an artifact path cannot fit, use a complete pointerless notice. Save full originals through the existing best-effort persistence path whenever results are shortened. Before persistence, resolve any read that the selected preview would shorten. If a regular-chat read cannot be traced to a path in model history, preserve the entire batch for normal compaction and overflow handling so worker cache residency still matches the full content the model receives.

Defaults stay at 25,000 characters / 1,000 lines. Result-size accounting moved to #13652. Design: [English](docs/design/pressure-aware-tool-output.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/pressure-aware-tool-output.zh-CN.md).

## Why it is needed

#2566: static tool budgets can push a long session over the compaction trigger prematurely. A hard-ceiling anchor cuts too late; an obsolete usage anchor cuts against the wrong context. At the other extreme, sub-notice allocations erased failure diagnostics and could advertise a nonexistent partial artifact path. A supported PreToolUse repair can supply a read path while recorded model arguments remain `{}`; shortening that result without notifying the worker could then make a later read incorrectly omit the full body.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Near the auto trigger, return a large result: it should shrink to available headroom. Far from or past auto, or after restore/route change/explicit settings, it should keep the static behavior.
- Change fixed inputs, including during a held response: stale usage should not reanchor. Equivalent refreshes should retain the headroom anchor and usage counters.
- Leave only enough headroom for an empty or incomplete notice: original output and error should reach normal compaction admission. A larger but path-insufficient preview should contain a complete notice, a nonempty error indication and no partial recovery path.
- Check the complete persisted original after a meaningful cut and verify user/protected text and previous file-read rights survive.
- Repair an empty-argument read through PreToolUse: the full result should remain in request/history before persistence, and a later unchanged-file placeholder should be valid. With a resolvable original path, normal shortening should notify the worker, preserve prior-read rights and allow a subsequent full reread.

### Evidence (Before & After)

[Current before/after report and actual tmux excerpts](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13599#issuecomment-6080873864). The current repair passed 35 focused pressure cases, affected Core build/typecheck and static checks. The first full-file run passed 589/590; a media fixture lacking its recorded read call was corrected, and its original media headroom assertions plus inode invalidation passed in the final pressure group. No fresh all-590 pass is claimed.

Actual compiled-Core API/tmux controls exercise the hook and separate worker cache: repaired original `{}` preserves 20,033 characters, while resolvable original path still shortens to 2,576 characters, notifies the worker and rereads the full body. Each makes two controlled generation calls; all 11 watched compiled modules loaded with matching hashes. The generator and compaction boundary are controlled (NOOP), with observer loader/assertion failures retained. The resolved-control mutable cache receipt reflects a later reread, not a frozen after-cut snapshot. Earlier tiny-budget and CLI/TUI evidence stays tied to its tested commit.

### Tested on

macOS, Node 22.22.0, current commit `6579f3c3ec543c4da693dfc2548aa4752d206859`. Current necessary CI is tracked separately.

## Risk & Scope

The tiny-budget fallback and unresolved-read whole-batch preservation can require normal compaction instead of suppressing text. The latter deliberately may exceed the selected finite character budget; existing compaction, hard admission and overflow handling apply, potentially adding text or compaction. It does not guarantee exact token admission. A pointerless preview omits detailed content when it cannot fit; persistence remains best effort under existing disk limits. Shortened file reads disarm quote-back residency while retaining prior-read rights; uniquely correlated shell shortening leaves file-read residency intact. Existing fork ownership remains unchanged. Unresolved would-cut reads in regular chat now preserve the full batch before persistence; there is no worker API change or blanket cache clear that revokes prior-read rights. The current controlled-Core fixture does not establish a new CLI, browser, real-model or cross-platform result. Line caps and defaults do not adapt.

## Linked Issues

Closes #2566
Result-size accounting split to #13652 (#11536).

<details><summary>中文说明</summary>

接近自动压缩时，根据同一聊天、同一路由且固定输入和历史仍有效的成功用量报告缩小下一请求的工具结果；等价刷新保留依据，内容变化或在途旧响应不重建过期依据，也不清空用量计数。保护文本、媒体和结构先计入余量，与聚合预算取较紧值且不重复裁剪。放不下完整提示时保留原文交给压缩/硬上限准入；完整路径放不下时只发送完整无指针提示，正常裁剪仍尽力保存完整原文。默认25k字符/1000行保持不变，结果统计另在#13652。

本次修复 PreToolUse 补齐实际读取路径、历史原始参数仍为 `{}` 的缓存缺口。落盘前先检查最终预览将裁剪的读取，普通聊天无法定位路径时保留整个批次，确保 worker 驻留状态与模型实际收到的内容一致；可定位读取仍正常裁剪、通知 worker 并保留先读权限，没有新增 worker API。例外批次可能超过有限字符预算，交由正常压缩、硬准入或溢出处理，可能增加文本和压缩，不能声称精确 token 准入。双语设计同步记录。

当前提交 `6579f3c3ec543c4da693dfc2548aa4752d206859` 的35项压力测试及Core构建/类型/静态检查通过。首次全文件589/590通过，媒体fixture未记录读取调用；补齐路径关联后，原媒体预算断言和inode解除断言在最终压力组通过，未冒称全590重新通过。实际编译Core API/tmux中，修正读取保留20,033字符；可定位读取仍裁到2,576字符、通知worker，随后完整重读。每种两次受控生成调用、11个加载模块散列匹配；generator/NOOP压缩是控制边界。保留loader和观察断言失败及修正后的结果。控制中二次读取会更新缓存对象，不能将序列化结果视为裁剪后的冻结快照。历史极小预算及CLI/TUI证据保留原提交，本轮不冒称新CLI、Docker、浏览器、真实模型或真实压缩验收。CI、人工批准、合并和发布独立判断。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): improve token usage hierarchy
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Reorganizes session Token Usage into a two-column overview, compact model rows and an expandable By agent section. Models and agents show input with cache rate and total output above a bar whose percentage uses the session total; tooltips expose cache counts, reasoning, request counts and latency, plus streamed first-token latency, generation time and output speed when available. Main Agent appears first with the normalized usage remaining after attributed subagent calls, followed by individual invocations. Token Usage translations stay in the interactive entry and are excluded from read-only transcript exports through the existing build boundary; the upstream transcript build policy is preserved.

## Why it's needed

Repeated multi-line metric cards made it difficult to compare consumption, especially in a narrow sidebar. The new hierarchy keeps the main counts visible, puts detailed information behind accessible hover/focus/touch tooltips, and keeps text sizes fixed while resizing. It also improves small-text and keyboard-focus contrast and keeps refresh metadata right aligned when the header wraps. Tooltips share one initial 300ms delay so moving between rows opens subsequent hints immediately; tapped share hints persist without intercepting adjacent rows. English name/type dedup ignores capitalization, and accessible-name/cache-value composition belongs to each language catalog.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open Token Usage for a session with model and subagent usage. Check that the overview retains the session input, cache, output and reasoning values; cached tokens remain included in input and reasoning remains included in output.
2. Compare models in descending normalized-total order. Each compact row should show input/cache rate and total output, with its session share to the right of the bar. Hover, focus or tap a metric row to see all four metrics on separate lines, including when the row is not truncated.
3. Hover, focus or tap the Info button after a model name. It should expose request count and average latency, plus first-token latency and, when generation duration is positive, generation time and output speed for timed streams; each metric occupies its own line and the accessible name identifies the model. Escape or an outside touch should dismiss the tooltip.
4. Expand By agent. Main Agent should be first; remaining invocations should stay separate and sorted by normalized consumption. A differing localized type should appear at the right of the name; identical name/type text should appear once, ignoring capitalization. Agent percentages use the session total; actual over-reported values are not silently capped.
5. Resize the sidebar down to 320px and widen it again. Model names, shares and metric text should keep their fixed sizes; long metric rows should remain on one line with ellipsis, and wrapped refresh metadata should stay right aligned. Check light/dark text and focus visibility and matching section-heading styles.
6. Refresh the panel and check that updated values are rendered. The regression test pauses polling before page load, requires exactly one initial read, then requires the click to produce a second request and changed visible values; an intentionally blocked click must fail that assertion.

### Evidence (Before & After)

**Before — user-provided reference of the original repeated-card layout; earlier usage snapshot:**

![Original token usage layout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/ad1f8cde9c7b253d8679412bb0c1dca4d0fc6b24/token-usage/before-reference.png)

**After — current merge UI checked by browser E2E with simulated daemon stats (no model prompts):**

These screenshots use simulated daemon statistics and browser touch emulation; no model prompts were sent. They show the current merged UI, not real provider telemetry. Images are stored only on the fork's separate asset branch and linked at a fixed commit.

**Desktop · light**

![After: desktop light theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/ebb97e2c48f1e6639ba3508eb9f8d493c1f3b61d/token-usage/desktop-light.png)

**Desktop · dark**

![After: desktop dark theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/ebb97e2c48f1e6639ba3508eb9f8d493c1f3b61d/token-usage/desktop-dark.png)

**390px · Chinese touch layout**

![After: 390px Chinese touch layout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/ebb97e2c48f1e6639ba3508eb9f8d493c1f3b61d/token-usage/touch-tooltip.png)

**Model Info · desktop and 390px touch**

![After: desktop model Info timing metrics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/ebb97e2c48f1e6639ba3508eb9f8d493c1f3b61d/token-usage/model-info-timing-desktop.png)

![After: Chinese touch model Info timing metrics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/ebb97e2c48f1e6639ba3508eb9f8d493c1f3b61d/token-usage/model-info-timing-touch.png)

Both Info captures show requests, average latency, time to first token, generation time and output speed. The original reference is an earlier usage snapshot; these fixture-based captures verify layout and disclosure, not a before/after accounting comparison or provider billing.

Validation: 97 focused tests (55 component, 36 build-artifact, 6 translation); six Chromium browser cases (1200px English/light, Chinese/light, English/dark; 390px English touch/light, Chinese touch/light and touch/dark); repository workspace builds (CLI retried with an 8GB heap after exhausting the default 4GB limit), root typecheck and bundle; targeted ESLint, Prettier and diff checks. The current browser matrix checks label/focus contrast, 320px sidebar/viewport alignment and tooltip contents. Fresh real-session capture was blocked: the existing preview did not finish loading, and a temporary current-bundle daemon reported a busy shared extension store followed by ACP initialization timeout. The temporary daemon was stopped; the existing previews remain running. Current screenshots use simulated stats and do not claim real-session or provider telemetry verification. An ignored negative copy of the refresh E2E fails as expected when the click is blocked (expected two reads, observed one). The interactive/transcript boundary regression remains checked, including the newly integrated timing translations; the upstream removal of the old fixed-size ceiling is preserved. Review coverage adds cached-only source subtraction, nonnegative remainder floors, exact overview captions and localized tooltip label/value pairs; earlier review validation confirmed five logic and six browser negative controls fail at their intended assertions; this merge preserves the guarded calculations and interactions.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Node 22.14.0, Chromium desktop and touch emulation |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

The six-case UI matrix and current screenshots use a simulated daemon transport. The real saved-session recapture attempt was blocked by local extension-store contention and initialization timeout; earlier real captures are not presented as evidence for this merge. Touch screenshots use browser device emulation, not physical hardware.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Main Agent is a frontend remainder derived from normalized session totals minus reported subagent usage, with nonnegative bounds and cache/reasoning caps. Tests cover legacy totals, cached-only input, zero/oversized attribution and complete tooltip values.
- Not validated / out of scope: WebKit, physical touch devices and provider billing; no daemon routes, telemetry contracts or backend Git operations are changed or claimed by these screenshots.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. Missing legacy attribution still hides By agent; an explicit empty source list shows only Main Agent.
- Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/3540fd1f7511e826f75a7bcbf03f0fdb70ea1963/docs/design/token-usage-hierarchy.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/3540fd1f7511e826f75a7bcbf03f0fdb70ea1963/docs/design/token-usage-hierarchy.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

将会话 Token 消耗整理为两列总览、紧凑模型行和可展开的“按agent”区域。模型和 agent 在进度条上方显示输入及缓存率、总输出，条右侧百分比以会话总量为分母；提示框展示缓存数量、思考、请求次数和延迟，以及数据可用时的流式首 token 延迟、生成耗时和输出速度。主 Agent 固定排在首位，展示会话归一化用量扣除已归属子 agent 调用后的剩余量，后面逐条展示实际执行记录。 Token 消耗文案仅保留在交互入口，沿用现有构建边界从只读 transcript 导出包中排除，保留上游 transcript 构建策略。

## 为什么需要

原有多行指标卡片重复信息，窄侧栏里难以比较。新的信息层级保留主要数值，通过支持悬停、键盘聚焦和触屏的提示展示细节，拖动侧栏时字号固定。同时提高小字和键盘焦点对比度，并让顶部换行后的刷新信息保持右对齐。提示统一分组，首次延迟 300ms，跨行查看即时打开；触屏占比提示持续显示且不拦截相邻行。英文名称和类型忽略大小写去重，可访问名称及缓存数值由各语言字典完整组合。

## 评审验证计划

### 验证方法

1. 打开有模型及子 agent 消耗的会话 Token 面板。确认总览仍保留会话输入、缓存、总输出和思考数值；缓存仍包含在输入中，思考仍包含在总输出中。
2. 检查模型按归一化总量降序排列。紧凑行显示输入/缓存率和总输出，进度条右侧显示占会话总量的比例。无论是否截断，悬停、聚焦或触屏点击指标行都应按四行展示完整指标。
3. 悬停、聚焦或触屏点击模型名后的 Info 按钮，确认显示请求次数和平均延迟，以及有流式计时时的首 token 延迟，生成时长为正时还显示生成耗时和输出速度；每项独占一行，且可访问名称包含模型名。Escape 或外部触屏点击应关闭提示。
4. 展开“按agent”。主 Agent 应固定在首位；其他执行记录保持独立，并按归一化消耗排序。与名称不同的本地化类型位于标题右侧，相同的名称/类型忽略大小写后只显示一次。agent 占比使用会话总量，异常超额数值不会被静默截断。
5. 将侧栏拖到 320px 后再拉宽。模型名称、占比和指标字号应保持固定；过长指标行保持单行省略，换行后的刷新信息仍右对齐。检查明暗主题的小字及焦点可见性，以及分区标题样式一致。
6. 刷新面板并确认新数值可见。回归测试在页面加载前暂停自动轮询，要求初始恰好读取一次，再要求点击产生第二次读取并显示新数值；故意拦截点击时，该断言必须失败。

### 改动前后证据

**改动前——用户提供的原始重复卡片布局参考，来自较早的用量快照：**

![原始 Token 消耗布局](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/ad1f8cde9c7b253d8679412bb0c1dca4d0fc6b24/token-usage/before-reference.png)

**改动后——浏览器 E2E 验证当前合并版本，使用模拟 daemon 统计，未发送模型请求：**

以下截图使用模拟 daemon 统计和浏览器触屏模拟，未发送模型请求，展示当前合并版本的界面，不代表真实供应商遥测。图片仅存放在 fork 的独立素材分支，并使用固定提交链接。

**桌面 · 浅色**

![改动后：桌面浅色主题](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/ebb97e2c48f1e6639ba3508eb9f8d493c1f3b61d/token-usage/desktop-light.png)

**桌面 · 深色**

![改动后：桌面深色主题](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/ebb97e2c48f1e6639ba3508eb9f8d493c1f3b61d/token-usage/desktop-dark.png)

**390px · 中文触屏布局**

![改动后：390px 中文触屏布局](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/ebb97e2c48f1e6639ba3508eb9f8d493c1f3b61d/token-usage/touch-tooltip.png)

**模型 Info · 桌面和 390px 触屏**

![改动后：桌面模型 Info 耗时指标](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/ebb97e2c48f1e6639ba3508eb9f8d493c1f3b61d/token-usage/model-info-timing-desktop.png)

![改动后：中文触屏模型 Info 耗时指标](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/ebb97e2c48f1e6639ba3508eb9f8d493c1f3b61d/token-usage/model-info-timing-touch.png)

两张 Info 截图均展示请求、平均延迟、首 Token 延迟、生成耗时和输出速度。原始参考图来自较早的用量快照；当前 fixture 截图验证布局和提示交互，不作前后计费比较或供应商账单验证。

验证包括：97 条定向测试（55 条组件、36 条构建产物、6 条翻译）；6 个 Chromium 场景（1200px 英文浅色、中文浅色、英文深色；390px 英文触屏浅色、中文触屏浅色和深色）；各工作区构建（CLI 默认 4GB 内存耗尽后以 8GB 重试通过）、全仓类型检查和打包；定向 ESLint、Prettier 及 diff 检查。当前浏览器矩阵验证小字及焦点对比度、320px 侧栏/视口右对齐和提示内容。本轮真实会话截图受阻：现有预览未完成加载，临时的最新打包版 daemon 报告共享扩展商店忙，随后 ACP 初始化超时。临时服务已停止，原有预览保留；当前截图明确使用模拟统计，不宣称验证真实会话或供应商遥测。另有忽略目录中的刷新 E2E 反例：拦截点击后按预期失败，期望读取两次而实际只有一次。 仍验证交互入口与 transcript 的文案隔离，新增耗时翻译同样纳入边界检查；保留上游移除旧固定体积上限的变动。此前评审已增加仅缓存来源扣除、余量非负下限、精确总览小字和本地化提示标签/数值配对覆盖，并通过 5 个逻辑及 6 个浏览器反例确认断言有效；本轮保留所保护的计算与交互。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Node 22.14.0，Chromium 桌面及触屏模拟 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境

prs.title: fix(core): stop the session LSP client on Config shutdown
prs.body:
## What this PR does

`Config.shutdown()` never stopped the session's LSP client: `shutdownResourcesOnce()` cleaned up the skill manager, tool registry and the registries but had no reference to `this.lspClient`, the `LspClient` interface exposed no `stop`/`dispose`, and `NativeLspService.stop()` (which drains and stops every server) had no production caller. In the ACP/daemon shape each `newSession` builds its own `LspServerManager` with language-server subprocesses, so every closed session leaked its servers until the host child exited.

Changes:

- `packages/core/src/lsp/types.ts`: add optional `stop(): Promise<void>` to `LspClient`.
- `packages/core/src/lsp/NativeLspClient.ts`: implement it by delegating to `NativeLspService.stop()` (which already calls `serverManager.stopAll()`).
- `packages/core/src/config/config.ts`: `shutdownResourcesOnce()` now awaits `this.lspClient?.stop?.()` as the first step of the initialized-config cleanup block.

`Config.reinitializeLsp()` is untouched, so the hot-reload path keeps working; uninitialized/derived Configs never installed a client, so the optional call is a no-op for them.

## Why it's needed

In the ACP/daemon deployment, sessions come and go while the host process stays up. Without a stop call on session teardown, each closed session leaves its language-server subprocesses running until the whole host exits, which is the leak reported in the linked issue.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- `packages/core/src/config/config.test.ts`: a fake `lspClient` with a `stop` spy is called exactly once by `config.shutdown()`; deleting the call turns the test red (verified locally).
- `packages/cli/src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts`: driving the session-cleanup seam (`cleanupUnstoredConfig`) on a real `Config` with a fake `lspClient` stops the client (the ACP session-close path reaches `config.shutdown()` through `shutdownSessionConfig`). The core-module mock in that file now re-exports the real `Config` class to allow this.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: `shutdownResourcesOnce()` had no reference to `this.lspClient`, and `NativeLspService.stop()` had no production caller, so session teardown never reached the server manager. After: `config.shutdown()` awaits `lspClient.stop()`, which drains and stops every server for that session.

Not done locally (no LSP servers configured here): the process-listing verification from the issue's acceptance criteria. The unit-level evidence above covers the wiring that was missing; a live-server run is the remaining check on the host side.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS (this machine) | Core test passes and goes red with the call removed. The acp-level test could not run in this environment: the vitest global guard requires every cli workspace dependency built, and `packages/channels/base` plus two pre-existing core test files fail `tsc` here on a `Buffer`/`BodyInit` types friction that is unrelated to this change (same friction exists on untouched main files in this env). It runs in CI where the workspace builds. |
| Linux / Windows | Covered by CI. |

## Risk & Scope

`Config.shutdown()` gains a new awaited subprocess-draining step. It deliberately goes first in the cleanup block: a failure in a sibling cleanup step is swallowed into `resourceError`, and stopping the subprocesses must not be hostage to that (this actually happened in the test env, where the mocked tool registry has no `stop`). Scope is limited to the shutdown path; `reinitializeLsp()` and the uninitialized-Config path are untouched. Not validated: live-server run (see Evidence).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14751.

prs.title: fix(ci): skip failure reports for superseded run attempts (#14768)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The failure-reporting workflow now ignores a stale `workflow_run` event when the same run has already moved on to a later attempt. Before choosing a destination, it reads the run's current attempt; when that is newer than the attempt the event describes, it warns and skips the issue, PR comment, and infrastructure rerun, because the later attempt's own completion event is the authoritative report. A failed read falls back to the existing behavior and still reports.

## Why it's needed

Issue #14768 was filed for `Managed Agent gate` run 39237270547 even though that run was green. Attempt 1 failed at 11:33 UTC because the fast Java job could not acquire the per-host sdk-java lock; attempt 2 succeeded at 13:18 UTC. The `Main CI Failure Issue` run triggered by attempt 1 sat in the hosted-runner queue until 14:30 UTC, by which point the run's latest attempt had no failed jobs. The analyzer's fail-closed rule treated that empty failure list as a code failure and filed a per-commit issue at 18:40 UTC. A late event for a superseded attempt must not report a failure the run has already cleared.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run the workflow meta-tests: `npx vitest run scripts/tests/main-ci-failure-issue-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/ci-platform-lanes.test.js`. All 96 tests pass.
2. Inspect the new `Skip a superseded attempt` step: it queries `repos/${REPO}/actions/runs/${WORKFLOW_RUN_ID}` and sets `superseded=true` only when the live `run_attempt` is greater than the event's `run_attempt`.
3. Confirm the `Select the failure destination` step is gated on `steps.live.outputs.superseded != 'true'`; without that gate the other jobs would still file.
4. On a real delayed event, expect a warning naming both attempts and no issue, comment, or rerun.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: a delayed attempt-1 event for run 39237270547 ran after attempt 2 was green, read the green attempt's empty failure list, and filed issue #14768.

After: the same event sets `superseded=true` and the destination step is skipped, so the later attempt's completion event is the only reporter.

### Tested on

|     OS     |        Status        |
| :--------: | :------------------: |
|  🍏 macOS  |    ⚠️ not tested     |
| 🪟 Windows |    ⚠️ not tested     |
|  🐧 Linux  |      ✅ tested       |

### Environment (optional)

Workflow meta-tests and repository checks ran on Linux; no CLI runtime is involved.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: suppressing a report when a later attempt exists relies on that attempt's completion event being delivered. GitHub delivers a `workflow_run` event for every completed attempt, and a failed read falls back to reporting, so the suppression window is limited to a run that has genuinely moved on.
- Not validated / out of scope: the per-host lock budget that caused attempt 1's failure is tracked separately in the open fix for issue #14754. This PR does not change lock sizing.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14768

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的作用

失败上报工作流现在会忽略过期的 `workflow_run` 事件：如果同一个运行已经进入后续 attempt，旧事件不再上报。在选择上报目标之前，工作流会读取该运行当前的 attempt；如果它比事件描述的 attempt 更新，则输出警告并跳过 issue、PR 评论和基础设施重跑，因为后一个 attempt 自己的完成事件才是权威上报。读取失败时回退到原有行为，仍然上报。

## 为什么需要

Issue #14768 是为 `Managed Agent gate` 运行 39237270547 创建的，但该运行最终是绿色的。Attempt 1 在 11:33 UTC 失败，因为快速 Java 任务在 60 分钟内无法获取每主机 sdk-java 锁；attempt 2 在 13:18 UTC 成功。由 attempt 1 触发的 `Main CI Failure Issue` 运行在托管 runner 队列中一直等到 14:30 UTC，此时该运行的最新 attempt 已经没有失败任务。分析器的 fail-closed 规则把这个空的失败列表当作代码失败，并在 18:40 UTC 创建了按提交跟踪的 issue。对于已被后续 attempt 取代的旧事件，不能上报该运行已经消除的失败。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 运行工作流元测试：`npx vitest run scripts/tests/main-ci-failure-issue-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/ci-platform-lanes.test.js`。全部 96 个测试通过。
2. 检查新增的 `Skip a superseded attempt` 步骤：它查询 `repos/${REPO}/actions/runs/${WORKFLOW_RUN_ID}`，仅当实时 `run_attempt` 大于事件的 `run_attempt` 时设置 `superseded=true`。
3. 确认 `Select the failure destination` 步骤受 `steps.live.outputs.superseded != 'true'` 门控；没有该门控时其他任务仍会上报。
4. 在真实的延迟事件中，预期看到同时点名两个 attempt 的警告，并且不会创建 issue、评论或重跑。

### 证据（修改前与修改后）

修改前：运行 39237270547 的延迟 attempt-1 事件在 attempt 2 已经变绿之后执行，读取了绿色 attempt 的空失败列表，并创建了 issue #14768。

修改后：同一事件会设置 `superseded=true` 并跳过目标选择步骤，因此只有后续 attempt 的完成事件会上报。

### 测试平台

|    操作系统     |       状态        |
| :-------------: | :---------------: |
|    🍏 macOS     |    ⚠️ 未测试     |
|   🪟 Windows    |    ⚠️ 未测试     |
|    🐧 Linux     |      ✅ 已测试    |

### 环境（可选）

工作流元测试和仓库检查在 Linux 上运行；不涉及 CLI 运行时。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：当存在后续 attempt 时抑制上报，依赖该 attempt 的完成事件被投递。GitHub 会为每个完成的 attempt 投递 `workflow_run` 事件，且读取失败会回退到上报，因此抑制窗口仅限于确实已经进入后续 attempt 的运行。
- 未验证 / 范围外：导致 attempt 1 失败的每主机锁预算由 issue #14754 的开放修复单独跟踪。本 PR 不改变锁的大小。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #14768

</details>

prs.title: feat(telemetry): Record reasoning effort on LLM spans
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the standard `gen_ai.request.reasoning.level` attribute to LLM spans using the `reasoning_effort` value from the first provider-final OpenAI-compatible request. Non-empty strings are preserved exactly, including provider-specific tiers and `none` when actually sent. Missing, empty, non-string, and inherited values are omitted.

Updates regression coverage, the telemetry guide, and the complete synchronized design documents: [English](docs/design/gen-ai-arms-field-alignment.md) and [中文](docs/design/gen-ai-arms-field-alignment.zh-CN.md).

## Why it's needed

Reasoning effort affects latency, token usage, and cost, but it is currently missing from LLM spans even when present in the request. Recording the actual request value lets telemetry consumers distinguish calls with different reasoning levels without inferring them from settings.

The attribute uses the name defined by the repository's pinned OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Enable telemetry while leaving sensitive-content capture disabled. Make OpenAI-compatible requests with `high` and `xhigh`, then confirm the exported LLM span's `gen_ai.request.reasoning.level` matches the final request's `reasoning_effort`.
2. Disable reasoning for a model that sends `reasoning_effort: "none"`, such as GPT-5.5. Confirm the span retains `none`.
3. Repeat with a provider path that removes `reasoning_effort`, or a request without that field. Confirm the span omits the attribute instead of recovering a value from settings.
4. Confirm existing request attributes and first-request snapshot behavior remain unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the source-observer regression reproduced a request containing `reasoning_effort: "high"` whose span omitted the reasoning-level attribute.

After: the same regression passes. On both macOS and Docker Linux, 353 focused tests, five streaming CLI scenarios, and four non-streaming integration scenarios passed. Runtime verification compared actual HTTP requests with real exported spans using isolated local mock services.

The full workspace build, workspace and integration typechecks, CLI bundle, changed-file lint, formatting, and documentation checks also passed on macOS.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Tested in local Docker |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64 with Node 22.22.0; Docker Linux arm64 with Node 22.23.3; pnpm 11.24.0 on both. Linux dependencies were installed independently, and the new CLI bundle was executed with Linux-native dependencies. The host full build required an 8 GiB Node heap.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: adds one observable span attribute using the existing first-request snapshot semantics. It does not change model requests or retry behavior.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows, live provider services, ARMS dashboard rendering, and mappings from nested provider-specific reasoning fields or other protocols.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The attribute is additive and does not require sensitive-content capture.

## Linked Issues

Closes #14508

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

为 LLM Span 添加标准属性 `gen_ai.request.reasoning.level`，取值来自经过提供方适配后的首个最终 OpenAI 兼容请求中的 `reasoning_effort`。非空字符串原样保留，包括提供方特有档位，以及实际发送时的 `none`。缺失、空字符串、非字符串和继承的属性值均省略。

补充回归测试、遥测指南及完整同步的设计文档：[English](docs/design/gen-ai-arms-field-alignment.md) 和 [中文](docs/design/gen-ai-arms-field-alignment.zh-CN.md)。

## 为什么需要

推理强度会影响延迟、token 用量和成本，但目前即使请求中包含该值，LLM Span 也不会记录。记录实际请求值后，遥测消费者可以区分不同推理档位的调用，无需从设置中推断。

属性名称采用仓库锁定版本的 OpenTelemetry GenAI 语义约定。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 启用遥测，保持敏感内容采集关闭。分别以 `high` 和 `xhigh` 发起 OpenAI 兼容请求，确认导出的 LLM Span 中 `gen_ai.request.reasoning.level` 与最终请求的 `reasoning_effort` 一致。
2. 对禁用推理时会发送 `reasoning_effort: "none"` 的模型，例如 GPT-5.5，确认 Span 保留 `none`。
3. 使用会移除 `reasoning_effort` 的提供方路径，或不包含该字段的请求，确认 Span 省略该属性，不从设置中恢复值。
4. 确认现有请求属性及首个请求快照语义保持不变。

### 证据（修改前后）

修改前：源代码观察器回归测试复现了请求包含 `reasoning_effort: "high"`，但 Span 缺少推理强度属性的情况。

修改后：同一回归测试通过。macOS 和 Docker Linux 均通过 353 项相关测试、5 个流式 CLI 场景和 4 个非流式集成场景。运行时验证使用隔离的本地模拟服务，对照实际 HTTP 请求与真实导出的 Span。

macOS 上的完整工作区构建、工作区及集成测试类型检查、CLI 打包、修改文件的 lint、格式及文档检查也全部通过。

### 已测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 已在本地 Docker 中测试 |

### 环境

macOS arm64 使用 Node 22.22.0；Docker Linux arm64 使用 Node 22.23.3；两端均使用 pnpm 11.24.0。Linux 独立安装依赖，并使用 Linux 原生依赖运行新构建的 CLI bundle。本机完整构建需要将 Node 堆内存上限提高到 8 GiB。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：沿用现有首个请求快照语义，新增一个可观测的 Span 属性，不改变模型请求或重试行为。
- 未验证或范围之外：Windows、真实供应商服务、ARMS 仪表盘展示，以及提供方特有嵌套推理字段或其他协议的映射。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无。该属性为增量添加，不要求启用敏感内容采集。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #14508

prs.title: test(managed-agent): gate the FG11f refusing arms (FG11f)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Completes the FG11f in-process fault slice. The first PR added one arm and a case whose arm was chosen by a system property, so CI only ever exercised whichever arm the default picked. This adds the two refusing arms as their own methods — a put that throws before the bytes land, and a put that stays silent past the operation timeout — and turns the arm into a parameter of a shared helper so each method gates on `selected()` the way fg11b and fg11c do: an unset property runs all three arms, and naming one runs only that one.

Both refusing arms assert that nothing was stored, that the `OBJECT_PUT` operation stays unresolved, that the Shell runs once, and that the run settles once. The design documents move to slice 1 delivered.

## Why it's needed

An arm selected by a property is an arm CI cannot see. The lost-ack shape was pinned, but the two refusing shapes — a write that never happened, and a write that outlived its timeout — were scoped in the design and unexercised by any lane. Those are the shapes that must end in an honest failure rather than a fabricated success, so leaving them to a property default is the same as not having them.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff.** This raises the shared failsafe fork budget every other hosted gate runs inside: the healthy sum moves to 8775 s, the fork to 9375 s, the Verify step to 167 minutes and the `hosted-harness-mysql` job ceiling to 270. The fork sits exactly at its fit boundary — 8775 healthy plus the largest 600 s ceiling equals the fork — so the next cell added anywhere in that fork has to raise the budget in the same diff or the ceiling relation reddens. Test-only change; no production code moves.
- **Not validated / out of scope.** Neither arm runs in this PR's CI: the base is a feature branch, and `ci.yml` and `managed-agent-gate.yml` filter `pull_request` to `main`/`release/**`/`omni-experiment`, so every `sdk-java` lane and the unit/lint suite are skipped. Both timings and the 64/64 meta-test result are local runs against real MySQL. The publisher-death slice is untouched.
- **Breaking changes / migration.** None.

## Linked Issues

References #14446 (the FG11 tracker) without a closing keyword. Stacked on #14819, position 2 of the FG11 chain: the case body, the `PublicationFaults` stub and the storage-guard registration fix live there, and re-creating them here would collide on the same lines rather than reuse them. It retargets to `main` once #14819 lands.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run either method through the hosted automation profile with real MySQL, a built bundle and Node 22. Each boots the packaged stack, fires an automation against a definition whose tools name the hosted workspace Shell, answers the wake turn's permission request, and injects the arm's fault at the physical put.

Expect `fg11fPublicationFailsBeforeWriteOnMySql` around 41 s and `fg11fPublicationTimesOutOnMySql` around 80 s, both green. To see they are not vacuous, remove the injection from `beforePut` for one arm and rerun it: with the write allowed through, `fg11fPublicationFailsBeforeWriteOnMySql` fails at `[a refused write stays unresolved]` in 56.6 s, which is the assertion that the refusal came from the store rather than from an unreachable branch.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: only `drop-ack-after-write` ran, and only when the property selected it; the two refusing arms' assertions could not execute. After: all three arms have their own method and ceiling, and CI runs every one of them.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A  |

Measured locally against MySQL 8.0.46 and Node 22: 41.22 s and 79.96 s, both green, plus the mutation witness above. `scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` passes 64/64 after the merges and the budget recomposition.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

完成 FG11f 的进程内故障切片。前一个 PR 只加了一条臂，且用例按系统属性选择臂，所以 CI 只会跑到默认那条。本 PR 把两条 refusing 臂各自独立成方法——一条在字节落盘前抛错，一条沉默超过操作超时——并把「臂」改成共享 helper 的参数，使每个方法像 fg11b、fg11c 那样用 `selected()` 收窄：属性未设置时三条臂全跑，指定某一条时只跑那一条。

两条 refusing 臂都断言：没有任何对象被存储、`OBJECT_PUT` 保持未决、Shell 只执行一次、run 恰好结算一次。设计文档同步改为「第 1 片已交付」。

## 为什么需要

被属性选中的臂就是 CI 看不见的臂。丢失 ack 的形态已经钉住，但两条 refusing 形态——写入根本没发生、以及写入超出了超时——只在设计里定界，没有任何 lane 执行过。它们恰恰必须收敛为如实失败而非伪造成功，因此交给属性默认值等于不存在。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或取舍。** 本 PR 抬高了所有 hosted gate 共用的 failsafe fork 预算：healthy 到 8775 s、fork 到 9375 s、Verify 到 167 分钟、`hosted-harness-mysql` job 上限到 270。fork 正好处在贴合边界——8775 healthy 加最大 600 s ceiling 恰好等于 fork——因此此后在该 fork 里任何位置再加 cell，都必须在同一 diff 内抬预算，否则 ceiling 关系会报红。纯测试改动，不触碰生产代码。
- **未验证 / 超出范围。** 两条臂都不在本 PR 的 CI 中执行：base 是特性分支，而 `ci.yml` 与 `managed-agent-gate.yml` 的 `pull_request` 只覆盖 `main`/`release/**`/`omni-experiment`，所以所有 `sdk-java` lane 与单测/lint 均被跳过。耗时与 64/64 元测试结果都是本机对真实 MySQL 的实跑。publisher-death 未触碰。
- **破坏性变更 / 迁移。** 无。

## 关联 Issue

引用 #14446（FG11 tracker），不使用关闭关键字。堆叠在 #14819 之上，为 FG11 链的第 2 条：用例体、`PublicationFaults` 桩与存储闸注册修复都在那里，在本 PR 重建会撞同一批行而不是复用。父 PR 合入后 retarget 到 `main`。

## 评审方式

用 hosted automation profile 跑任一方法，需要真实 MySQL、构建好的 bundle 与 Node 22。每个方法都会启动打包栈，对以 hosted workspace Shell 为工具的 definition 触发 automation，应答 wake turn 的权限请求，并在物理 put 上注入该臂的故障。

预期 `fg11fPublicationFailsBeforeWriteOnMySql` 约 41 秒、`fg11fPublicationTimesOutOnMySql` 约 80 秒，均绿。验证非空洞的方法：把某条臂在 `beforePut` 里的注入去掉后重跑——写入被放行后，`fg11fPublicationFailsBeforeWriteOnMySql` 会在 `[a refused write stays unresolved]` 处失败（56.6 秒），这正是「拒绝来自 store 而非不可达分支」的那条断言。

## 证据（Before & After）

修复前：只有 `drop-ack-after-write` 会跑，且仅在属性选中它时；两条 refusing 臂的断言无法执行。修复后：三条臂各有方法与独立 ceiling，CI 会全部执行。

## 平台

本机 macOS 对 MySQL 8.0.46 + Node 22 实跑：41.22 s 与 79.96 s 均绿，外加上述变异见证。合并与预算重算后 `scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` 64/64 通过。

</details>

prs.title: test(managed-agent): settle a landed turn reply without a cold load
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Updates the FG6b store-fault driver to the post-#14570 shape of a lost turn reply. When the settle's answer is dropped but the commit landed durably, the settle now applies that transaction: the Turn completes on the live Session, its `turn_complete` and the one committed `tool_result` appear in the transcript, `recoveryBlocked` clears, and a further prompt is no longer refused. The driver waits for that applied state before asserting it, and skips the still-blocked prompt probe only for that one fault; the other reply-lost faults keep the blocked shape because only their `tool_result` lands.

## Why it's needed

The nightly full suite on main (run 39314221838) shows three of the four gates aligned by #14716 now passing (`HostedSessionRelayFaultGatesIT` 6/6, `HostedAutomationFaultGatesIT` 5/5, `HostedWorkflowRelayFaultGatesIT` 5/5) and one remaining failure: `HostedWorkspaceToolTurnIT.sessionStoreFailuresNeverReplayEffectsOnMySql` fails on its `turn-reply` case because the driver still expects `recoveryBlocked: true` after the fault, while the settled transaction has already completed the Turn. Issue #14699 and #14781 carry the failing-test signature.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the Hosted MySQL lane and confirm `HostedWorkspaceToolTurnIT` is 9/9 green, with the `turn-reply` case now reporting a completed Turn (one `turn_complete` for the prompt, one `tool_result`) instead of a blocked one. The other reply-lost cases (`result-reply`, `result-checkpoint`) should keep their blocked shape. A useful negative check is to make the settle skip applying the landed transaction: the `turn-reply` case must still fail, so the wait has not made the case vacuous.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change, no user-visible behavior.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

The Java class cannot run on macOS: the Hosted fixture registers its storage guard only on Linux and the driver's Workspace acquisition answers `workspace_unavailable`. Static checks pass locally (ESLint, Prettier). Runtime verification is the full `SDK Java` dispatch on this branch.

### Environment (optional)

N/A.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the driver now waits for the settled state instead of reading it immediately, so a settle that never applies would surface as a 30 s wait timeout rather than a specific assertion; the failure message would name the fault but not the missing record.
- Not validated / out of scope: a local Linux run of the class; the other failures in the same nightly run (`HostedExtensionsIT`, `HostedHookFaultGatesIT` FG13c, `HostedTeamMemberCommandMySqlIT`) which are unrelated to #14699.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14699, #14781
